game.name: 007 - Blood Stone
game.desc: Blood Stone 007 est un jeu d'action sur Nintendo DS. Truffée de gunfights et de courses-poursuites en bateau ou en voiture, l'aventure ici présente nous fait voyager aux quatre coins du monde afin de stopper une menace terroriste. On y trouve également un mode multijoueur pour quatre espions en herbe.

game.name: 007 - Quantum of Solace
game.desc: El nuevo episodio de la saga de James Bond, Quantum of Solace te permite encarnar a los agentes secretos más famosos en Nintendo DS. El título cuenta la historia de Casino Royale y Quantum of Solace, íntimamente vinculados en sus escenarios. Las fases de infiltración, combate y fuego, y el entorno destructible, todo debe tenerse en cuenta para convertirse en el agente más formidable del MI-6.

game.name: 100 Classic Book Collection
game.desc: 100 Livres Classiques est une compilation d'oeuvres littéraires majeures regroupées sur une seule cartouche DS. Ce programme contient 100 ouvrages de Jules Verne, Victor Hugo, Emile Zola, Jules Renard, Molière, Stendhal, etc. La DS se tient comme un livre et on peut marquer ou tourner les pages à l'aide du stylet.

game.name: 100 Classic Games
game.desc: 100 Classic Games est une compilation de jeux traditionnels sur Nintendo DS. Que l'on soit fan de jeux de cartes, amateur de puzzles ou dingue de machine à sous, on trouvera forcément son bonheur dans cette profusion d'épreuves réparties en trois catégories distinctes. Les règles des jeux sont accessibles à tout moment et le stylet assure un confort d'utilisation optimal.

game.name: 101 Dino Pets
game.desc: 101 Dino Pets sur Nintendo DS est un jeu de simulation qui vous propose de vous occuper d'un petit dinosaure ! Alimentation, soins, toilette... Vous devrez prendre soin de lui au cours de sa croissance. Plusieurs espèces de dinosaures sont disponibles et personnalisables : choisissez ses couleurs, accessoires, vêtements, etc.

game.name: 101 in 1 Sports Megamix
game.desc: 101 in 1 : Sports Megamix est une compilation de jeux sur DS. Cette compilation propose de nombreuses épreuves (101 pour être exact) qui combinent réflexes et coordination. Bowling, boxe, tennis, basket ou même équitation seront ainsi au rendez-vous pour notre plus grand plaisir en solo ou multijoueur.

game.name: 18 Card Games
game.desc: 18 Jeux de Cartes est un jeu de cartes sur Nintendo DS. On y trouve entre autres le rami, le solitaire, le black jack, le bridge ou bien encore la belote. A vous de voir quel jeu choisir avant d'affronter les cinq adversaires virtuels du titre, contrôlés par l'ordinateur.

game.name: 2 Games In 1 - Jewel Master - Cradle Of Egypt Mahjongg - Ancient Egypt
4 Elements
game.desc: 4 Elements sur DS est un jeu de réflexion se déroulant dans un univers féerique. Vous devrez résoudre des grilles de puzzle en formant des chaînes de joyaux les plus longues possible afin de restaurer la magie des quatre éléments.

game.name: 4 Game Fun Pack : Monopoly, Boggle, Yahtzee, Battleship
42 All-Time Classics
game.desc: This game presents 42 (mostly) well-known games including 18 card games, 12 board games, 4 "variety" games, 5 "action" games and 3 single-player games; although a few of the games must be unlocked before being played. Each game has options that can be used to create further gaming possibilities. All the games are played with the DS touch-screen. Examples of the card games featured include Memory, Blackjack, Rummy and two variants of poker (Five Card Draw and Texas Hold 'Em); board games include Chinese Checkers, Backgammon, Chess and Ludo. There are also DS interpretations of Bowling, Darts and Billiards (9-Ball). There are three options as far as single-player games go: free play (play any unlocked game as you wish), stamp mode (play through the games in order, collecting stamps per performance) and mission mode (play through a set of missions based within the games). Multiplayer games can be played with nearby players or "worldwide" via a wi-fi connection (up to 8 players).

game.name: 50 Jeux Incontournables
game.desc: Redécouvrez sur votre DS 50 jeux classiques et donc incontournables. Alternez entre les échecs, le Solitaire, le Sudoku ou bien encore le Mahjong, les Dames, le Black Jack sans oublier le Poker et autres classiques.

game.name: 7 Wonders II
game.desc: 7 Wonders revient sur DS. Ce jeu de puzzle vous propose de construire les 7 Merveilles du monde à l'aide de petits Égyptiens prêts à tout pour vous aider dans votre tâche. Il faut ainsi aligner des séries de runes pour pouvoir ériger les splendeurs de notre monde. Chaque merveille comporte 6 ou 7 niveaux de difficulté.

game.name: 7 Wonders Of The Ancient World
game.desc: 7 Wonders of the Ancient World is a Bejeweled-type puzzle game. The game boards are set against the fabled 7 Wonders of the Ancient World. In the main Story mode you need to build wonders over time one after another starting with The Great Pyramid in Giza then moving to the mysterious Hanging Gardens of Babylon and other wonders. To do so, you will need to match runes on materials blocks to destroy them. After the wonder was opened in story mode it would be available to play in all other modes. There are around 56 levels in the game and 3 difficulty modes to play. Board size and configuration depend on the wonder you're currently trying to build.

game.name: 8ball Allstars
game.desc: Avec 8Ball Allstars sur DS, prenez place autour d'une table de billard pour des parties relevées, seul ou en multijoueur. Le soft propose de nombreux modes de jeu, comme les différentes ligues ou les challenges en ligne. Également au programme, des face-à-face.

game.name: Ace Attorney Investigations - Miles Edgeworth
game.desc: Ace Attorney Investigations: Miles Edgeworth is the fifth game in the Ace Attorney series. It is an interquel set between Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trials and Tribulations and Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney. This game is a standard "point and click" adventure, with the player controlling Edgeworth's movements and what he interacts with. For each case, the goal is to collect evidence to determine who the perpetrator is, how the crime was committed and their motive. This is presented as a combination of a third-person view showing the characters at the crime scene and through animated close-up images of the characters, annotated by text dialog. In some cases, still images are used to highlight dramatic scenes.

game.name: Actionloop
game.desc: Playing with balls is fun! Magnetica is a fiendish action puzzler game from Japanese developer Mitchell Corporation, and the sequel to the 1998 arcade game Puzz Loop. Marbles will relentlessly roll across twisted tracks and into a hole in its center. When three same-coloured marbles touch each other, they destroy themselves. With the DS Stylus, players must shoot same-coloured marbles into the oncoming rows in order to prevent them from falling down the hole and thus clear a track. The twist is that now, marbles that share the same color will attract each other! Magnetica takes advantage of the Nintendo DS hardware for precise touch-screen functionality and brings a new play mechanic to the famous puzzle. Test your ball-shooting skills in Challenge Mode, Puzzle Mode, Quest Mode and more.

game.name: Addy - Do You Speak English
game.desc: Adi l'Entraîneur : Objectif Anglais sur DS est un titre d'apprentissage destiné aux enfants pour qu'ils apprennent l'anglais tout en s'amusant. Conforme au programme scolaire, la cartouche propose des sessions de jeu courtes et adaptées au rythme d'apprentissage de l'enfant. Adi va conseiller le jeune joueur et l'aider dans sa progression, notamment en proposant un système de récompenses à décrocher pour le motiver.

game.name: Advance Wars - Dual Strike
game.desc: The first entry of the long running Wars series for the Nintendo DS. This turn-based strategy game has you commanding an Allied Nations army against the vile Black Hole.Choose from a handful of COs (commanding officers), each with his own unique CO power

game.name: Advance Wars : Dark Conflict
game.desc: Days of Ruin takes place in an entirely new world where a large-scale meteor shower triggered massive global destruction that eradicated 90 percent of the population. After the catastrophe, the survivors have formed together into militaristic bands that are warring over the last remaining scraps of civilization. You'll take control of Will, a young military cadet (whose hair is admittedly just a little spiky) who quickly becomes embroiled in the conflict at the outset of the game.

game.name: Agatha Christie - The ABC Murders
game.desc: Work alongside the famous detective Hercule Poirot to solve a series of baffling murders committed by an elusive madman. Using the touch screen controls of the DS, players will inspect crime scenes, question suspects and must solve a terrible crime before there is another victim. With multiple play modes to choose from and an investigator's journal to keep notes, Agatha Christie: ABC Murders for DS offers an immersive gaming experience amidst a classic story and detailed graphics.

game.name: Age De Glace 2, L'
game.desc: Retrouvez Scrat, Manny, Sid et Diego dans une aventure complètement gelée avec L'Age de Glace 2 sur DS. Tiré du long métrage éponyme, le jeu vous demander d'échapper au plus grand déluge de la Préhistoire. Vous débutez dans un parc de glace et devez parcourir dix niveaux juchés de pièges, courses et autres mini-jeux pour sauver votre fourrure.

game.name: Age of Empires - Mythologies
game.desc: Inspired by the bestselling PC real-time strategy game Age of Empires, Age of Empires: Mythologies brings the franchise to the Nintendo DS in a turn-based form.Players take command of one of three civilizations (the Norse, the Greeks, and the Egyptians) a

game.name: Age of Empires - The Age of Kings
game.desc: Based upon Ensemble Studios classic Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings, this latest addition to the 'Age' series shifts it from its real time strategy roots to a DS exclusive turn-based strategy title, though the same goals still apply. Command and rule.

game.name: Air Traffic Controller by DS
game.desc: Air Traffic Chaos involves the player taking control of an airport control tower for a period. During this period the player needs to achieve a certain score based on orders given to planes and safe take offs and landings. The game has a total of 15 challenges.

game.name: Alex Rider - Stormbreaker
game.desc: Alex Rider : Stormbreaker est un jeu d'action sur Nintendo DS. Le titre reprend l'histoire du film du même nom et vous permet d'incarner le jeune héros. Enchaînez les phases d'action, ainsi que les mini-jeux, comme des courses à moto ou des parties de billard. Ce sont au total cinq niveaux différents qui vous attendent en mode aventure.

game.name: Alice in Wonderland
game.desc: Based on the movie of the same name, Alice in Wonderland is an action adventure video game that puts players in Alice's shoes. The Nintendo DS version will introduce a new twist as players guide Alice alongside her diverse and enduring friends to combat the legions of the Red Queen's Army. Creating their own path through Underland using an oracle, players lead, protect and help Alice on her quest. The DS version features an innovative art style unique to the platform, a playable character not seen on the home console version, and unique character abilities similar to those of the Wii and PC versions. DSi players will use the system's camera to detect colours mapped to unlockable content when tasks are completed.

game.name: Aliens - Infestation
game.desc: GAME OVER, MAN! The Xenomorph, the ultimate killing machine, returns. Only the Universe's toughest, the Colonial Marines, can exterminate the galaxy's most feared species. Can you fight off the terror of the alien infestation? -Choose you squad and watch the dynamic story system adapt -Pick up where the Aliens crew left off and fight through the U.S.S. Sulaco, planet LV-426, and more! -Load up with iconic weapons from the film, including pulse rifles, smart guns, and flamethrowers.

game.name: Aliens in the Attic
game.desc: Les Zintrus sur Nintendo DS est le jeu vidéo tiré du film du même nom et en suit donc l'histoire. Afin de traverser les 25 niveaux bourrés d'ennemis et de plates-formes du soft, vous devez utiliser les compétences respectives de Tom, Hannah et de leur cousin Jake. Il est également possible de customiser les armes du trio pour les rendre plus performantes.

game.name: All Star Cheerleader
game.desc: All Star Cheer Squad sur DS reprend la base du jeu sur Wii mais sans les accessoires. C'est donc au stylet que vous devez accomplir les mouvements des pom-pom girls pour mener à bien vos chorégraphies afin de passer mettre dans l'art de manier le pompon. Différents jeux sont au programme pour vous faire accéder au poste de majorette incontestée du campus.

game.name: Allied Ace Pilots
game.desc: Revivez les plus grandes batailles aériennes de la seconde guerre mondiale avec Allied Ace Pilots sur Nintendo DS. Utilisez le stylet pour piloter les plus célèbres avions de l'époque. Plusieurs types de missions sont disponibles pour vous permettre de participer à des combats, des bombardements ou simplement de la reconnaissance en territoire ennemi. Un mode campagne vous fait revivre les célèbres batailles d'Iwo Jima et de Midway.

game.name: Alvin and the Chipmunks - The Squeakquel
game.desc: Tiré du film lui même inspiré par le dessin-animé du même nom, Alvin et Les Chipmunks : The Squeakquel arrive en jeu vidéo. Il nous replonge dans les histoires de ces petits êtres mi-homme mi-écureuil sur DS. Traversant les États-Unis pour donner toute une série de concerts en concurrence avec les Chipettes, il faut battre la mesure de la musique jouée par le trio pour remporter le succès tout au long du jeu.

game.name: Alvin Et Les Chipmunks
game.desc: Tiré du film lui même inspiré par le dessin-animé du même nom, Alvin et les Chipmunks arrive en jeu vidéo. Il nous replonge dans les histoires de ces petits êtres mi-hommes mi-écureuils sur DS. Traversant les États-Unis pour donner toute une série de concerts, il faut battre la mesure de la musique jouée par le trio pour remporter un succès considérable, tout au long des 30 chansons du jeu.

game.name: Aly And Aj Adventure, The
game.desc: Alyson Renae "Aly" Michalka and Amanda Joy "AJ" Michalka are a teen pop duo who write music and act in movies. In this game they start a tour to perform in four different cities around the world (Los Angeles, New York, Tokyo, and London). Players take on the role of their new assistant who has to see to all their needs through a collection of mini-games. After creating a customized character, the player needs to complete different mini-games to prepare for the concert. Based on the performance, a thermometer fills up with a ranking of stars. A minimum of stars is needed to enter the final change and all games on the map need to be completed with at least an "A". When all the games in the buildings have been completed, the concert in that city becomes available where a rhythm game needs to be completed in the vein of Elite Beat Agents. The games require the player to clean graffiti, help with the rehearsals through dance sessions and even educate the girls primary school skills by having them recognize their own photographs and match objects. Multiplayer is available for two players and in the A&A Player mode, players can listen to the unlocked songs and play any mini-game.

game.name: American Dragon : Jake Long
game.desc: American Dragon : Jake Long est un jeu d'action et de plates-formes sur Nintendo DS. Il y est question d'un adolescent new-yorkais, passionné de skateboard, qui est capable de prendre l'apparence d'un dragon par des voies magiques inaccessibles au commun des mortels. Coatché par son grand-père, un maître en arts martiaux, il va s'efforcer de défendre sa ville natale contre des créatures monstrueuses tout en prétendant au titre de Premier Dragon Américain.

game.name: Amf Bowling Pinbusters!
game.desc: AMF Bowling Pinbusters! is a bowling sports-based video game. It was released on Wii on November 20, 2007 and was released in America on the Nintendo DS on June 10, 2008.

game.name: Animaniacs - Lights Camera Action
game.desc: Bienvenue dans le monde fou des Animaniacs, personnages phares du dessin animé éponyme des années 90. Dans cette adaptation DS intitulé : Lights Camera Action ! retrouvez Yakko, Wakko et Dot, chacun avec leurs compétences propres et participez à une tonne de mini-jeux en rapport avec la Warner les studios de cinéma. Découvrez six environnements touchant au monde d'Hollywood et faites-y les 400 coups.

game.name: Ankh - Curse of the Scarab King
game.desc: Assil est de retour. Le jeune Egyptien revient sur Nintendo DS dans un remake de sa première aventure. Frappé d'une terrible malédiction par une momie rancunière, il a quelques heures pour trouver une solution. Une quête qui lui fera rencontrer de nombreux personnages délirants et résoudre des énigmes dans la grande tradition des point'n click.

game.name: Anno - Créez Votre Monde
game.desc: Anno: Create Your World on DS is a management game in which you play as a prince who has gone to colonise exotic lands. After choosing an island, he will have to found a colony and ensure the happiness of his subjects. He will then be able to raise taxes and ensure the development of his city and its infrastructure. The game features a Campaign mode and a Free mode allowing you to play customizable games.

game.name: Another Code - Two Memories
game.desc: A pure adventure game for the Nintendo DS platform. You play as teen Ashley. Raised by her aunt Jessica, Ashley believed both of her parents were dead; on the eve of her 14th birthday, she receives a strange letter and a device called a DTS from her father. She and her aunt are summoned to Blood Edward Island, which is where the game begins. Near the beginning of the game, you meet the ghost of a boy who can't remember his past. Over the course of the game, you will uncover the truth of both your own past and this mysterious boy's. Much use is made of the unique features of the DS. You will use the stylus, the microphone, and even the "sleep" feature in addition to more traditional puzzle solutions. Your character cannot die; there are no action or arcade sequences.

game.name: Ant Nation
game.desc: Ant Nation est un jeu de stratégie sur Nintendo DS qui vous propose de contrôler votre propre armée de fourmis. A travers près de 100 niveaux, vous devez aider vos fourmis guerrières et vos ouvrières à atteindre leurs objectifs. De nombreux outils et diverses options permettent d'augmenter ou de modifier les capacités naturelles de vos insectes.

game.name: Apassionata : Die Galanacht der Pferde : Meine Show
Apollo Justice - Ace Attorney
game.desc: It's seven years after the events seen in Trials and Tribulations, and Phoenix Wright has shouted his last "Objection!". Taking his place in the court is a new Ace Attorney, the young rookie, Apollo Justice. Does he have what it takes to clear his clien

game.name: Aquarium by DS
game.desc: Aquarium by DS is a fish tank simulation in which the player can choose from 30 different underwater animals. Additionally, the player can customize their tank in size and add different backgrounds and accessories like plants, rocks or even buildings like the Leaning Tower of Pisa. New fish types can be unlocked by taking good care of the aquariums residents. And that's the aim of the game, taking care of the fish in the tank. They need to be fed, the tank has to be cleaned and water temp and salinity have to be adjusted to create a perfect environment. A wrong environment or an unsuitable mix of animals in the tank will result in the death of the players pets. Instead of swimming dead at the surface or bloody death animations they simply disappear from the screen. Not playing the game for a few days and therefore not feeding, will result in a deadly surprise, too. Using the Wi-Fi-feature of the DS the player can swap fishes with other players.

game.name: Arctic Tale
game.desc: Arctic Tale is based on the National Geography documentary of the same name. Players control a polar bear (both cub and adult) trying to survive in a harsh climate of snowy landscapes. There are eleven stages where the little bear explores the environment, searches for foods and collects paw prints that unlock pictures in a photo gallery and additional chapters. Later, two other animals can be controlled as well: a walrus that is also able to explore underwater environment, the fast Arctic fox able to hunt down rabbits and an orca whale. The levels consist of free-roaming environments, on land or underwater, where the animals need to gather food to avoid having the heart icon fade away. While playing 16 different mini-games can be accessed where the player can earn bronze, silver and golds awards to unlock additional chapters. These games include Ice Slide (obstacle course), Shuffle (slide to the center of a ring), Food Fight, Ice Flow Rodeo (control a broken piece of ice through rough currents), Survive the Cold (cross an icy area using shelters to hide from the cold), Catch-a-Seal, Ice Sheet, Clam Scavenge (find eight hidden clams), Herd Flow (guide an ice block without hitting anything), Walrus Hunt, Orca Race and more.

game.name: Are You Smarter than a 10 Year Old
Arkanoid DS
game.desc: The latest version of Taito's classic game: Arkanoid. It features the classic gameplay of the previous games, the player controls the Spaceship VAUS (a moving platform at the base of the lower screen) and its energy ball to destroy the color block (in the upper screen) through each levels. As usual, there are various power-ups to help through the game (laser, slow ball, duplicate balls, next level, etc.) The game has one player mode, multiplayer and vs COM modes. The one player mode consists of the Clear mode and the Quest mode. The Clear mode is a series of 7 zones of 5 rounds each. There is a total of 28 zones in the game. At the end of the Clear modes, Ananke (the main character and pilot of the VAUS) frees one of his captured friends, these friend's VAUS can then be used in the game. In the Quest mode, each previously played round is available to replay with a specific challenge (Break all blocks of one color within time limit, or ball launch limit, etc.) Each round gives points that can be used at the shop to buy in-game features to customize it (Blocks shapes, VAUS, backgrounds, etc.) The VS Com and Multiplayer are similar. You must defeat either the Com or another friend in either Bust All or Bust Color match. The quickest to achieve the goal wins. There is also new power-ups that hinder the opponent.

game.name: Army Men - Soldiers of Misfortune
game.desc: Army Men : Soldiers of Misfortune sur DS est un jeu de tir à la troisième personne. Le joueur incarne Timmy, un jeune garçon qui va participer à la guerre de ses petits soldats. Ce dernier a à sa disposition une série d'armes et de bonus afin d'accomplir les différentes missions proposées pour aider l'armée verte.

game.name: Around the World in 80 Days
game.desc: Le Tour du Monde en 80 Jours est un jeu d'aventure sur Nintendo DS inspiré du célèbre roman de Jules Verne : le Tour du Monde en 80 Jours. Les principales étapes du périple se situent dans quatre villes : Le Caire, Yokohama, Bombay et San Francisco. Partez sur les traces de Philéas Fogg, 27 ans après son voyage.

game.name: Art - Das Kunstmagazin Puzzle - Echter Puzzlespass Fuer Unterwegs
Art Academy
game.desc: Art Academy is a learning software for Nintendo DS, designed to discover, improve and master drawing and painting. A dedicated tutor, Leo, teaches you step-by-step the different techniques through simple and progressive exercises. Once you've mastered the basics, you'll progress gradually until the final result: the creation of your own works of art.

game.name: Art Of Murder - Fbi Top Secret
Arthur and the Revenge of Maltazard
game.desc: Arthur et la Vengeance de Maltazard sur DS est un party-game inspiré du second volet de la saga de Luc Besson Arthur et les Minimoys. Il propose une trentaine de mini-jeux dans lesquels les joueurs ne sont pas en compétition mais doivent au contraire coopérer pour faire le meilleur score possible.

game.name: Asphalt - Urban Gt 2
game.desc: The sequel to Asphalt: Urban GT continues the fast-paced racing of the original game with various additions. Races take place on eight locations all over the world. While racing, smashing other cars, or avoiding the police, there is cash to collect. Money

game.name: Asphalt - Urban Gt
game.desc: Race through modern city streets in licensed model automobiles in this high-tech racing game that can be played solo or against other competitors. Up to 4 players can race against each other in a selection of wireless multiplayer modes.Speed through the m

game.name: Assassin's Creed - Altair's Chronicles
game.desc: Set in 1190, AltaÃ¯r's Chronicles is conceived as a prequel to the versions for the PS3 and Xbox 360. This time, we learn how AltaÃ¯r becomes an assassin while looking for an artifact through different cities. It is said that this artifact, known as "the

game.name: Assassin's Creed II - Discovery
game.desc: Assassin's Creed II : Discovery sur DS est un jeu de plates-formes/action en vue de profil qui vous plonge dans la peau d'Ezio Auditore Di Firenze. Assassin de son état, l'homme doit se rendre en Espagne, puis dans le nouveau monde, pour sauver ses confrères assassins et déjouer un nouveau complot des templiers.

game.name: Asterix - These Romans Are Crazy!
game.desc: Suivez le célèbre Astérix et sa bande d'irréductibles Gaulois dans cette collection de mini-jeux sur DS. Calqué sur le principe du jeu de l'oie, le soft vous propose de participer à une vingtaine d'activités pour au final, franchir la ligne d'arrivée avant votre adversaire. Un mode deux joueurs permet d'ailleurs de jouer avec un ami à tour de rôle sur la même console.

game.name: Asterix And Obelix Xxl 2 - Mission Wifix
Asterix At The Olympic Games
game.desc: Asterix at the Olympic Games is licensed from the comic and live action film of the same name. In this sports game the player controls Asterix, Obelix or Dogmatix (Idéfix in most countries) from the French comic series Astérix le Gaulois. Unlike the version for Windows, Wii, Playstation 2 and Xbox 360, which is a full fledged 3D action adventure game combined with minigames, the Nintendo DS version focuses completely on the minigames. The plot, combat sequences and puzzle solving have been removed from the game. The game does comes with 120 different Olympic challenges. The challenges are divided in 4 categories: Roman, Greek, Gallic and Egyptian. Each challenged is played by rubbing the stylus over the touchpad in a certain way or in a few cases blowing into the microphone. Challenges range from actual Olympic sports like disc throwing to children's games like hula hoops. Players need to obtain at least a bronze medal to continue to the next challenge.

game.name: Astro Boy - The Video Game
game.desc: Astro Boy sur DS est un jeu d'action tiré du film d'animation du même nom. Vous devez sauver Metro City des robots qui essaient de la détruire, pour cela vous avez à votre disposition un véritable arsenal et vous pouvez parcourir la ville à toute vitesse grâce à vos propulseurs. De nombreux bonus sont à débloquer comme des artworks ou des versions différentes d'Astro Boy.

game.name: Astrology
game.desc: Astrology sur Nintendo DS est un logiciel consacré aux systèmes de croyances. Il permet de découvrir son destin à travers une liste exhaustive des différentes sciences et croyances : horoscope, astrologie, numérologie, voyance, etc. C'est une véritable encyclopédie qui permet, entre autres, de créer votre avatar et de le comparer au jour le jour à celui des gens qui vous entourent.

game.name: Astrology
game.desc: Astrology sur Nintendo DS est un logiciel consacré aux systèmes de croyances. Il permet de découvrir son destin à travers une liste exhaustive des différentes sciences et croyances : horoscope, astrologie, numérologie, voyance, etc. C'est une véritable encyclopédie qui permet, entre autres, de créer votre avatar et de le comparer au jour le jour à celui des gens qui vous entourent.

game.name: Atari Greatest Hits - Volume 1
game.desc: Atari Greatest Hits : Volume 1 est une compilation regroupant près de 50 jeux de légende issus du catalogue Atari sur Nintendo DS. La compilation est en plus dotée de modes multijoueurs inédits censés permettre de contenter les fans.

game.name: Atlantic Quest
game.desc: Atlantic Quest est un jeu de casse-tête sur DS qui propose au joueur de venir en aide au monde marin face à la menace d'une nappe de pétrole. Le jeu comporte 120 niveaux et 12 scénarios et le but est simple : vous devez aligner trois éléments identiques afin de les détruire.

game.name: Atv Quad Frenzy
game.desc: ATV Quad Frenzy is a 3D ATV off-road racing game. It focuses largely on the handling of the vehicles and the way they reacts to the bumps of the track. This means paying attention to the suspension and it also means big air, where you can perform tricks by selecting a trick with the select button, then holding the A and B buttons. There are a variety of ATVs and five modes to choose from. The modes are practice, quick race, championship race circuit, championship pro circuit and a multiplayer head-to-head mode. The game includes a virtual garage in which players can upgrade their ATVs through a touch-screen interface. Tires, suspension, etc can be replaced.

game.name: Atv Quad Kings
game.desc: ATV Quad Kings est un jeu de courses disponible sur Nintendo DS. Aux commandes de divers quads, vous devrez enchaîner les tricks et franchir la ligne d'arrivée en premier dans les 9 environnements proposant un total de 18 circuits.

game.name: Avalon Code
game.desc: Avalon Code is a hack and slash Action-RPG that takes place in a world about to end. Choosing between a male or female avatar, the player is given the Book of Prophecy from which the world will be remade. Everything in the world can be scanned and recorded into the Book of Prophecy, and players can further redefine an entry's properties by mixing and matching pieces of code. Codes in Avalon Code are Tetris-like chunks which fit into each book entry's grid of available code space. Think of these codes like genes in a DNA sequence that you can grab and move with the stylus. For example, elemental properties (such as fire) can be incorporated into a weapon, allowing you to melt ice. Removing codes from enemies allows you to weaken them, making them easier to dispatch. Players string together light combos and can perform charged special moves. Additionally, the player can begin a Judgment Link which juggles the enemy higher and higher (with proper timing) which yields precious HP, MP and Gem bonuses. Dungeons are somewhat unique in that each room is a timed challenge, with requirements such as hitting all switches, defeating all enemies, Judgment Linking xN, and/or various combinations of these.

game.name: Avatar - The Last Airbender - The Burning Earth
Away - Shuffle Dungeon
game.desc: Away: Shuffle Dungeon is an RPG dungeon exploring game mixed with puzzle solving. The player takes control of a young hero by the name of Sword who settles down in Webb village for a nice quiet life. While living there, however, he notices strange happe

game.name: B Team - Metal Cartoon Squad
game.desc: Dans B Team Metal Cartoon Squad sur Nintendo DS le joueur prend le contrôle d'une équipe de soldats dans le seul but d'anéantir tout ce qui se présente au bout de leurs canons. Un jeu de tir arcade où la croix de direction et le stylet suffisent à tout contrôler.

game.name: B-17 Fortress In The Sky
game.desc: B-17 FORTRESS IN THE SKY places the player in the heart of the air war over Germany and the occupied territories in the autumn of 1944. Defend the "Lucky 25" through 25 heart-pounding missions over France, the Netherlands, and deep into the heart of Germany. Man each gunner position, avoid deadly flak encounters, and make sure to drop those bombs right in the o'le "pickle barrel".

game.name: Baby Life
game.desc: Mieux que de jouer à la poupée, prenez soin de votre bébé sur votre DS. Regarder-le grandir et évoluer et aidez-le à devenir le plus adorable des bambins. Avec Baby Life sur DS, découvrez deux jeux en un : pour sociabiliser votre poupon, vous pouvez garder les enfants de vos voisins et devenir la meilleure des baby-sitters. Echangez des photos, habits et accessoires avec d'autres mamans virtuelles via le système sans-fil.

game.name: Babysitting Mania
game.desc: Toute jeune baby-sitter, vous voilà propulsée dans le feu de l'action jusqu'à une vingtaine de petits monstres à surveiller dans Baby-sitting Mania sur DS. Et comme si cela ne suffisait pas, vous devrez aussi vous occuper de remettre la maison en état avant que les parents reviennent.

game.name: Bakugan - Battle Brawlers - Battle Trainer
game.desc: Enter the world of Bakugan, take control of your Bakugan monsters, level-up their G-power and teach them new battle skills with a complete training regimen! Train your Bakugan to excel at all aspects of fighting with an in-depth training mode. Ultimately, send your newly trained Bakugan monsters into battle with a mission to free imprisoned Bakugan from the enemy's hold.

game.name: Bakugan - Defenders of the Core
game.desc: The Bakugan Battle Brawlers DS - Defender of the Core Card Game for Nintendo DS invites you to collect and customise gigantic Bakugans to take part in numerous real time battles. Directly controlling his creatures in destructible environments, the player will have to fend off the onslaught of Spectra and his terrible Vexos armies.

game.name: Bakugan - Rise of the Resistance
game.desc: Bakugan-Battle Brawlers Rise of the Resistance is another game in the Bakugan saga. The story takes place in New Vestroia, which will be invaded by a group of evil Bakugans. It's up to you to help the members of the Resistance.

game.name: Bakugan : Battle Brawlers
game.desc: Answer the call to BRAWL and enter an alternative universe where good and evil fight for domination! Only you can decide the fate of the galaxy. Start off as an untrained Bakugan Brawler and must fight your way to the top of the heap. Combining the drama and story of the cartoon series with the skill and strategy of the card game, players will become completely immersed in this unique title. Throw Bakugan cards onto the battlefield, and then try to carefully shoot your Bakugan balls onto the cards to unleash their monstrous powers. When two Bakugans stand on the same card, they transform into gigantic creatures and fight to the finish! Features ? 24 action packed levels with 8 battlefield environments ? 6 unique arenas ? 35 Bakugans with all new uniques ? Over 200 player cards - 12 NEVER BEFORE SEEN

game.name: Bakushow : Challenge Your Friends
game.desc: Bakushow sur DS est un party-game qui prend son intérêt en multi puisqu'il propose aux joueurs (entre deux et quatre) de s'affronter lors de quizz. Le maître du jeu choisit sa question et l'envoie ensuite aux autres joueurs qui vont devoir y répondre avant de renvoyer le tout. Le gagnant de chaque épreuve propose la suivante, les favoris sont sauvegardés et il est même possible de voter pour les meilleures questions.

game.name: Balls Of Fury
game.desc: Balls of Fury on the DS general design is almost identical to the Wii version, save for some minor differences. The perspective has been heightened, to a more top-down view, although the paddle is still shown from a first-person perspective. Movement of the paddle is entirely done through the stylus, with the buttons used to add additional effect. The tournament mode has been removed and it is replaced by a multi-player mode, with up to two players through a wireless connection. Next to that, the game contains the same modes, characters, venues, options and two additional trophies. An extra mini-game has been added during the credits where the player can swat bees with the head of a spoon like Randy Daytona in the movie. Players need to swat as many bees as possible before the credits end.

game.name: Band Hero
game.desc: Band Hero est un jeu dérivé de Guitar Hero. Avec des accessoires spécialement étudiés pour la Nintendo DS, vous pourrez au choix vous prendre pour le chanteur, le guitariste ou encore le batteur d'un groupe de rock.

game.name: Bandz Mania
game.desc: Bandz Mania est un jeu de réflexion/puzzle-game sur Nintendo DS. En utilisant des élastiques, le joueur doit catapulter des projectiles vers des cages afin de libérer les fameux bracelets en caoutchouc.

game.name: Bangai-O Spirits
game.desc: Bangai-O Spirits is a handheld remake of the original, this version has the player take the role of two Bangai-O pilots, Riki and Mami, as they fly in an omni-directional path across environments, blasting away bad guys. The game is a mix of action, shooter and strategy, as the player can use ten different weapons (Napalm Missiles, Homing Missiles, Bounce Missiles, Break Missiles, Direct Missiles, Freeze, Reflect, Sword, Bat and Shield) with the ability to choose from two different Bangai-O suit classes, each with their own strengths and weakness. The main game is at the bottom of the dual-screen while the top is used for a map, so the player can track their place in the game. Players can also pick up power ups along the way while avoiding vast amount's of bad guys and avoiding special themed traps for each level. There are over 160 levels to play as well as a level editor that the player can use any of the other levels as a template. Players can also play 4-way co-op using Wi-Fi and players can also share data, scores, levels among others using Sound Load technology, where the info is converted into a sound file that is recognized and decoded by other DS' using its microphone and uploaded on the internet where the player can download information through audio devices and played to their own DS' microphone to download the information.

game.name: Barbie - Jet, Set & Style!
game.desc: Barbie Star de la Mode sur DS propose aux petites filles d'habiller, coiffer, maquiller et faire les ongles de clientes ayant besoin d'un relooking complet. Dix villes allant de Paris à Los Angeles en passant par Tokyo et Milan peuvent être visitées afin de trouver de nouvelles victimes de la mode.

game.name: Barbie Cavalière - Stage D'equitation
game.desc: Barbie Cavalière : Stage d'Equitation est un jeu d'aventure et d'action sur Nintendo DS. Incarnez Barbie et entraînez-vous à monter, à sauter et à prendre soin de plus de 15 chevaux différents, chacun possédant ses propres caractéristiques. Le titre propose également les éléments principaux d'un jeu de rôle : exploration, quêtes, récupération d'objets, amélioration des compétences et gestion de la santé et de l'état.

game.name: Barbie Fashion Show : An Eye for Style
Barbie In The 12 Dancing Princesses
game.desc: Barbie au Bal des 12 Princesses est un jeu d'aventure et de plates-formes sur Nintendo DS. En fait, il ne s'agit pas ici d'incarner Barbie mais la princesse Geneviève, la déclinaison aristocratique de la jolie poupée. Vous devez sauver 12 princesses cachées dans quatre zones du château. Tout cela en effectuant de nombreux mini-jeux.

game.name: Barbie Princesse De L'ile Merveilleuse
game.desc: Déjà disponible sur d'autres supports, Barbie Princesse de l'Ile Merveilleuse arrive sur DS. Cette collection de mini-jeux nous plonge dans l'univers de la célèbre poupée blonde qui doit, au cours des 28 mini-jeux disponibles, apprendre à survivre sur l'île déserte sur laquelle elle a débarqué. Le titre se découpe en cinq zones principales que Barbie doit débloquer une à une.

game.name: Barnyard Blast - Swine Of The Night
Batman - The Brave and the Bold - The Videogame
game.desc: Batman : L'Alliance des Héros sur Nintendo DS est un jeu d'action-aventure basé sur la célèbre série animée. Les graphismes en 2D nous font retrouver Batman, ainsi que Robin, Green Lantern, et bien d'autres dans des environnements variés tels qu'un laboratoire mystérieux, des planètes extraterrestres ou une cité souterraine. Le titre propose également un mode coopératif et une connectivité entre la DS et la Wii.

game.name: Battles of Prince of Persia
game.desc: Prince of Persia has long been remembered for its entertaining platform adventures. But now, for the Nintendo DS, it's moving in a new direction. Set during the dark times of The Sands of Time and Warrior Within, the Prince must now lead an army to secure peace in his land, through a unique turn-based strategy design. Players collect cards to increase the power of prestige of their troops, which can be traded with other players. Up to three decks can be saved, but you must choose only one to use in battle. From here, you command your forces through the cards to defeat enemies in each battle.

game.name: Beauty Salon
game.desc: Mon Salon de Beauté est un jeu de gestion sur DS dans lequel vous découvrez le monde des petits soins. Apprenez des techniques de coiffure, de pédicure ou encore de maquillage. Si vous êtes performante, vous pouvez même agrandir votre salon ! Trois modes sont proposés : Carrière, Challenge et Libre.

game.name: Bee Movie Game
game.desc: Bee Movie Game is the Nintendo DS game based on Jerry Seinfeld's Bee Movie. In this game you control Barry the bee as he tries to investigate honey distribution. He can explore 4 large areas of his environment at three different height levels, since he can fly. He can avoid enemies by changing altitude. The game consists of several missions where you have to find and retrieve items, and there are mini-games that make heavy use of the touch screen. The game features the voice of Seinfeld as Barry.

game.name: Beetle King
game.desc: Beetle King sur Nintendo DS propose au joueur de collectionner les insectes et de les croiser pour en obtenir de nouvelles sortes. Le joueur doit explorer l'environnement et utiliser le stylet pour gratter l'herbe et écarter les branches afin de dégoter de nouveaux spécimens. Le jeu offre aussi la possibilité de s'échanger ces charmantes bêbêtes en ligne.

game.name: Bejeweled Twist
game.desc: Bejeweled Twist is a tile matching game, where the player rotates groups of four jewels to create rows and columns of three or more matching gems. In the Classic and Zen modes, the objective is to make enough matches to fill a tube at the left side of the screen to move to the next level. There's a chain meter at the top of this tube, that builds up with matches in a row multiplying the points, and making a fruit jewel appear when full. A box at the tube bottom shows the sequence of matches needed for bonus points. Obstacles appear randomly on the game board. The coal can't be matched, but it can be exploded by one of the power-ups gems. The locked jewel is chained to its place and can't move, but it can be removed with a match. Bomb gems display the number of moves allowed before they explode, destroying the board and ending the game. They have to be matched before their counters reach zero, otherwise a revolving wheel-of-fortune appears that stops in one of two values, skulls or gems, that either detonate or disarm the bomb. This mini-game becomes more difficult every time it comes up. The power-ups appear after making matches of four or more gems. A four jewel match creates the flame gem, that explodes when matched removing all surrounding jewels. A five jewel match creates the lightning gem, that destroys a column and a row at the same time in a cross of fire. With the exception of Classic Mode , the other modes are unlocked with continuous playing. Zen Mode is similar to Classic, but is more relaxed without the bomb and locked jewels. Challenge Mode is a puzzle mode, where the objective is to perform a task, like removing all gems of one color, or making a number of matches in a row. In Blitz Mode, the goal is to accumulate the maximum amount of points possible within a time limit.

game.name: Ben 10 - Alien Force - Vilgax Attacks
game.desc: Ben 10 : Alien Force : Vilgax Attacks sur DS est un jeu d'action-aventure inspiré de la série animée du même nom. Vous incarnez Ben Tennyson, jeune adolescent accompagné de dix super-héros aliens. Vous devez sauver le Monde de l'effroyable Vilgax, pire ennemi de Ben, qui souhaite conquérir l'univers planète après planète.

game.name: Ben 10 - Alien Force
game.desc: Basé sur la série télévisée du même nom, le jeu Ben 10 : Alien Force est un beat'em all à traverser sur Nintendo DS. Confronté à une terrible menace, le héros Ben - maintenant âgé de 15 ans - est contraint de réutiliser l'Omnitrix pour se changer en cinq personnages extraterrestres dotés chacun de super-pouvoirs.

game.name: Ben 10 - Protector Of Earth
game.desc: Ben 10 : Protector of Earth sur DS est un beat'em all tiré de la série animée du même nom. Améliorez les personnages en débloquant plus de 80 combos, découvrez 14 niveaux différents et déverrouillez 4 arènes supplémentaires. Défiez vos amis en mode combat et trouvez aussi du contenu supplémentaire, notamment des costumes de personnages, des clips TV et des esquisses de conception inédites.

game.name: Ben 10 - Ultimate Alien - Cosmic Destruction
game.desc: Ben 10 Ultimate Alien : Cosmic Destruction sur Nintendo DS est un jeu d'action à la troisième personne. Dirigez Ben mais aussi Glacial, Arachno-singe, Énormosaure, Echo Echo et Régénérator dans leurs formes ultimes. L'aventure vous mène de Tokyo à Rome à la recherche d'artefacts Galvins pour préserver la terre d'une tempête cosmique qui pourrait bien l'anéantir.

game.name: Ben 10 : Galactic Racing
game.desc: Ben 10 : Galactic Racing sur DS est un jeu de courses proposant de parcourir 25 circuits sur 30 karts différents. Le joueur peut concourir avec Ben, Kevin ou l'un des 13 aliens de la série pour espérer devenir le champion du Galactic Grand Prix.

game.name: Ben 10 : Omniverse
game.desc: Ben 10 Omniverse est un beat'em all sur Nintendo DS. Que ce soit avec un Ben enfant ou adolescent, vous devez combattre de nombreux ennemis grâce à un système de combos. En jouant au mode Histoire, vous débloquez des niveaux dans le mode Défis.

game.name: Benoit Sokal Last King Of Africa
game.desc: Last King of Africa est un point'n click sur DS, portage du jeu PC Paradise de Benoit Sokal. Vous incarnez la fille du dernier roi de Mauritanie, en exil dans un autre pays et qui reçoit une requête de son père mourant. Ce dernier souhaite voir sa fille une dernière fois. Malheureusement votre avion s'écrase au Nord du pays, non loin d'une ville tombée aux mains des rebelles. C'est ici que l'aventure débute.

game.name: Berlitz : My English Coach
game.desc: Berlitz My English Coach sur Nintendo DS consiste en une méthode d'apprentissage fondée sur la conversation reconnue au niveau mondial. Le logiciel est composé d'exercices d'entraînement et de sessions de révision pour progresser en s'amusant. Chaque jour, une session d'exercices vous est proposée afin d'enrichir votre vocabulaire.

game.name: Best Of Arcade Games Ds
game.desc: La compilation Best of Arcade Games DS regroupe 4 jeux qui ont fait les beaux jours des bornes d'arcade. On y trouve ainsi un flipper décliné en deux tables, un clone de Pac-Man façon S.F., un casse-briques et enfin un Tetris-Like. De quoi passer quelques heures devant sa console.

game.name: Best Of Card Games
game.desc: Best of Card Games sur Nintendo DS est une compilation regroupant quatre des jeux de cartes les plus populaires. Le titre propose de tâter du carton virtuel avec l'indémodable solitaire, un jeu de tarot, du poker en Texas Hold'em ou encore de la belote.

game.name: Betty Boop's Double Shift
game.desc: Starring the animated cartoon character Betty Boop originally introduced in animated films starting from 1930, in this game she is a waitress helping Grampy run Betty's, a jazz club serving not only jazz music but also a selection of candy and milkshakes. With the money she earns, Betty wants a shot at stardom. It is a classic waitress game where the player controls Betty to manage the crowd visiting the club. Gameplay is divided into two shifts. She has to direct customers to seats, take their orders and serve them. Orders include candy, a milkshake or a specific song from the band. Based on the speed Betty fulfils the requests, a tip is awarded. Serving is done through the stylus by matching the correct colours, but Betty also has to keep an eye on the crowd kept outside by doorman Gorilla and the rest the band needs between songs. When the first shift is completed, Betty enters the stage to perform. A bar of notes is shown on the top screen and players need to select the corresponding notes in the correct order on the bottom screen to wow the audience. By doing well through both shifts, a gold star is awarded. It can be used in the following shifts to trigger the power mode where Betty uses her charm to entertain all guests at once. Customers such as Snobby Sally, Goons, Lazy Bones, Slobs, Critics and Military boys all have different characteristics and needs that are to be taken into account. In the multiplayer mode players go head to head in a first shift memory matching game or take the stage in the note tapping second shift.

game.name: Beyblade - Metal Masters - Nightmare Rex
game.desc: Beyblade : Metal Masters est un jeu d'action DS mettant en scène les combats de toupies épiques de la célèbre série. Dans la peau de l'un des 30 personnages disponibles, le joueur doit se battre pour décrocher le titre de Champion du Monde. Il peut également s'entraîner, s'essayer au mode Survie ou modifier ses toupies à l'aide des nombreuses pièces qu'il a débloquées.

game.name: Beyblade Metal Fusion - Cyber Pegasus
game.desc: Beyblade : Metal Fusion est un jeu de combat de toupies sur Nintendo DS. Le titre propose plus d'une centaine de toupies différentes et 13 personnages jouables. De nombreux effets de lumière et de mise en scène sont utilisés afin de rendre les combats intéressants. En outre, le titre adopte un design très manga. Le jeu est jouable seul ou à plusieurs grâce à la fonctionnalité Wi-Fi de la DS.

game.name: Big Bang Mini
game.desc: In Big Bang Mini, your main objective is to use the stylus to create fireworks and destroy the waves of enemies that loom overhead. If you miss, you'll be forced to tackle another challenge: avoiding the sparks created by your falling fireworks. Celebrate the completion of a level by designing the Final Bouquet, a one-of-a-kind masterpiece that will proclaim your victory.

game.name: Big Brain Academy
game.desc: The second title in Nintendo's brain game series. Big Brain Academy is similar to Brain Age, in that it contains a number of brain exercises. There are five different types of brain tests available; thinking, memorization, computation, analysis, and identification. After the completion of each quiz, information is provided to the player. Including brain weight, strengths and weaknesses and a suggested suitable career. Eight player competitive play is also included, where speed as well as brain power will be needed to win and find who has the biggest brain.

game.name: Big Mutha Truckers
game.desc: Big mutha Trucker sur Nintendo DS vous propose de vous mettre au volant de gros poids lourds afin de livrer diverses marchandises, le tout dans le mépris le plus total du code de la route. Destruction de voitures de police, violentes embardées, règlements de comptes avec des bikers hargneux, tout est bon pour livrer dans les meilleurs délais et prouver aux membres de la famille Jackson que c'est vous le patron.

game.name: Bigfoot Collision Course
game.desc: Bigfoot : Collision Course est un jeu de courses de Monster Truck sur Nintendo DS. Montez à bord de votre engin et dévorez les différentes pistes que vous pouvez parcourir à travers le monde sur plusieurs types de terrains : boue, neige...

game.name: Biggest Loser, The
game.desc: The Biggest Loser est un jeu de coaching sur Nintendo DS. Le titre s'inspire d'une célèbre émission de télé américaine et se présente comme une application qui vous fera perdre du poids. Des conseils diététiques vous sont donnés par deux coachs, le but étant bien sûr de gommer tous vos petits bourrelets avant l'été !

game.name: Biker Mice From Mars
game.desc: Help the Biker Mice From Mars, Vinnie, Modo, and Throttle, in their quest to save planet Mars from destruction with the help of the Regenerator, a machine that can create water for the Martians to continue to survive with. With the original Regenerator destroyed beyond repair, the trio must head to planet Earth to rescue Stoker, who can help them create another. Biker Mice From Mars is a hybrid of a racing game, and a side-scrolling beat-em-up. Take the role of Vinnie, Modo or Throttle, and race against opponents as well as beating them up in your quest to rescue the planet Mars. During the racing sections of the game, you can fire rockets at your foes (once collected from crates scattered on the track), or boost ahead of opponents. You're also racing against a time limit, and must make it to the end of the track before time is up. Destroying enemies will add precious seconds to your timer. The beat-em-up sections are fairly straightforward. You walk to the end of each stage, beating up opponents with punches and kicks as you progress. The screen locks into place when a group of enemies appear, and you must beat them before you can move on. The mice can also pick up thrown grenades and throw them back at enemies, as well as climb up and down certain objects to take different paths.

game.name: Billiard Action
game.desc: Avec Billiard Action, faites-vous une petite partie de billard n'importe où sur DS. Avec le stylet, vous pourrez dessiner sur l'écran tactile, écrire vos commentaires ou parier sur les trajectoires des boules. Vous pourrez même affronter jusqu'à quatre amis grâce aux fonctions réseau de la console.

game.name: Bionicle Heroes
game.desc: On the island of Voya Nui, the evil Piraka have stolen the six elemental masks of the Toa. It's up to you to explore the island's temples, retrieve the masks, and defeat the Piraka and their minions. Bionicle Heroes DS is a classic first-person shooter. As a nameless Matoran, you'll travel across 25 themed levels (including jungles, lava-worlds, ancient underground temples) discovering new weapons and new robotic foes to blast apart. Along the way, you'll use the masks' powers to survive the hostile environments as well as collect gears and robot parts to solve simple puzzles by assembling LEGO-style ramps, bridges, and doorways. The levels in the game are populated by a large visual variety of Bionicle-inspired bad guys, including ones that transform, fly, roll, or charge at you with scorpion-like stingers. Fortunately, you'll be able to upgrade your weapons and destroy them with plasma blasts, lightning, and sniper lasers. The game also contains a robust local multiplayer mode that allows up to 4-players to compete in deathmatches in arenas laden with weapon and mask upgrades.

game.name: Bleach - Dark Souls
game.desc: Bleach: Dark Souls for DS is a 2D fighting game that allows us to organize one-on-one or two-on-two confrontations with 44 fighters from the world of the famous manga. Each character has his or her own set of moves as well as formidable Bankai to be triggered with the buttons or stylus. In addition, a system of cards accessible with a simple tap on the touch screen spices up the clashes and a Story mode offers many challenges.

game.name: Bleach - The 3rd Phantom
game.desc: Bleach : The 3rd Phantom est un jeu de rôle tactique sur Nintendo DS. Rejoignez Ichigo et les capitaines du Goteï 13 dans une aventure avec un scénario totalement inédit. Le mode Histoire vous permet de créer et de contrôler une équipe de huit shinigamis. À vous de bien placer vos shinigamis sur la carte pour lancer des attaques dévastatrices.

game.name: Bleach - The Blade of Fate
game.desc: Bleach: The Blade of Fate is a 2D fighting game. It is an English localization of the Japanese release Bleach DS Souten ni Kakeru Unmei. The game is based on the Shounen Jump manga/anime Bleach, and many characters from the series are playable.The action

game.name: Blood Bowl
game.desc: The game is a fantasy version of American football, played between two teams of up to 16 players, each team fielding up to 11 players at a time. Touchdowns are scored by taking the ball into the opposition's end zone, and a team can win either by scoring the most touchdowns, or by violently eliminating the other team's entire roster. The game has both real-time and turn-based strategy modes. Players may choose to play the game in either mode. During the main career mode, the player must start from scratch and build a team; the career mode can go on ad infinitum.

game.name: Blue Dragon - Awakened Shadow
game.desc: Blue Dragon: Awakened Shadow is a role-playing game for Nintendo DS. Oriented towards multiplayer, this game invites you to adventure into the world of Neo Jibral in the company of the heroes of the series. At the start of the adventure, you'll be able to create your own character from head to toe and control the famous shadows with multiple powers.

game.name: Blue Dragon Plus
game.desc: Blue Dragon Plus is a sequel to Blue Dragon. Join Shu once again as he attempts to save the world. The game begins one year after the events of Blue Dragon. A mysterious three-headed dragon named Balaur appears from a cube that was once hidden in the planet's core. Balaur's coming indicates bad times once again, so Shu gathers his friends and they are off to investigate. Battles take place in real-time. Spells are used by summoning each character's shadow. The player can control the game entirely with the stylus.

game.name: Bob the Builder : Festival of Fun
Boing! Docomodake DS
game.desc: Exclusivement sur Nintendo DS, Boing! Docomodake est un jeu de plates-formes basé sur la mascotte de NTT DoCoMo, INC, une société de téléphones portables nippone. Le jour du festival annuel tenu dans la forêt Docomodake, les membres de la famille Docomodake sont introuvables. Papa Docomodake part donc à leur recherche. Pour franchir les nombreux obstacles et défis, il est aidé par ses amis les Minis.

game.name: Bomberman 2
game.desc: Bomberman II by Hudson Soft takes the ingredients that made the success of the famous license. However, this DS opus offers various improvements in terms of graphics and equipment. A new character model also makes its appearance, but the gameplay remains consistent with the original game with an all-new mission progression.

game.name: Bomberman Land Touch ! 2
game.desc: Suite directe du premier volet, Bomberman Land Touch ! 2 sur Nintendo DS reprend le concept de son prédécesseur. Invités dans un parc à thèmes, Bomberman et ses amis doivent réaliser toutes les épreuves proposées d'où seul le plus fort en ressort vainqueur. De nombreux autres bonus sont à débloquer dans ce party-game.

game.name: Bomberman Land Touch!
game.desc: Bomberman Land Touch! is the second Bomberman game for the Nintendo DS (Bomberman being the first game) and it changes the usual gameplay of Bomberman for a mix of adventure and mini-games. In the story mode, all the bombermen travel to Bomber Island, a pirate theme park, invited by Giant Gold (yellow bomberman), whose father is rich and has rented the park for a day. The goal of Giant Gold is to conquer the island with the help of the rest of the bombermen, all of which are named after their colors: Cheerful White (the player), Giant Gold, Cool Black, Kid Blue, Pretty Pink (the only girl) and Bookworm Green. Once the game starts, we control Cheerful White and we can explore the whole island, which consists in 5 different areas: Spades (the starting point), Diamonds, Hearts and Clubs area, where pieces of the same name can be collected, and the castle. This pieces are collected mostly by winning at mini-games, which are usually based on bombs and serve as the attractions of the park, and are used to open new areas of the map. There is also plenty of characters that give you useful information or send you to solve some quest. The rest of the bombermen will also give you info and quests, and sometimes they will wait you at some of the attractions that you finished and challenge you to it. In addition to this game mode, there is the Attraction mode and Battle mode, both multiplayer. In the first one, all the attractions already won can be replayed. In the Battle mode, which is played only with buttons (unlike in the other two modes), the multiplayer mode of the previous Bomberman is recovered. The only difference between both battle modes (as modes, levels, option etc. are exactly the same) is that each of the contenders have to have their own cartridge of the game in the Land Touch version.

game.name: Bomberman Story Ds
game.desc: This game plays like traditional Bomberman games except with an experience system. The player must navigate the map on each planet to locate the dungeon and then the boss. Along the way they must defeat enemies and destroy soft blocks with bombs. Every time an enemy is defeated it will display the experience that was earned by the player. After enough experience is obtained, they will level up and gain a new skill like increased number of bombs or fire power. There are also various types of bombs that can be obtained that have different functions. They are kept in a specific quantity and more can be found from inside soft blocks or defeated monsters.

game.name: Bomberman
game.desc: Bomberman llega en su primera aventura para la Nintendo DS. En la campaña para un jugador de Bomberman, hay 100 etapas para conquistar. Ganarás habilidades en el camino que te ayudarán en tu aventura. Hay Bomb Kick, Remote Bomb, Power Bomb y muchos otros. Si un muro o enemigo se interpone en tu camino, simplemente explótalo. Muchos rompecabezas y jefes te esperan en esta aventura.nnnnLa atracción principal de Bomberman es el modo multijugador. Hasta 8 pueden luchar con una sola tarjeta de juego. Hay 30 etapas para jugar con muchas opciones diferentes para elegir. Si estás solo, aún puedes jugar el modo de batalla contra hasta 7 bots controlados por computadora. También hay etapas controladas por voz que le permiten plantar o hacer estallar sus bombas al sonido de su voz.

game.name: Boogie
game.desc: Players dance, sing and create music videos with this videogame party package that takes advantage of the innovative Wii controls getting gamers off their couch and playing to a new beat. Not only do gamer belt out their favorite tunes or dancing to the latest hit songs, players catch their best dance moves, record their own voice and make music videos with the easy-to-use music video creator. Fun mini-games, co-op gameplay, head-to-head dance battles and karaoke party make Boogie a complete entertainment package for gamers of all ages.

game.name: Bookworm
game.desc: Bookworm is a word-forming computer puzzle game by PopCap Games. From a grid of available letters, players connect letters to form words. As words are formed, they are removed from the grid and the remaining letters collapse to fill the available space. As in Scrabble, players earn more points by creating longer words or words which use less common letters and earn less for smaller words. In November 2006, PopCap Games released a sequel, Bookworm Adventures. Bookworm was released for the Nintendo DS digital distribution service DSiWare on November 30, 2009.[2] It has also been released on the regular Nintendo DS cartridge.[3]

game.name: Boulder Dash Rocks
game.desc: Le légendaire Boulder Dash Rocks arrive sur DS. Rockford, le héros du titre, doit creuser à même le sol pour amasser un maximum de diamants. Il faut en ramasser un nombre exact pour pouvoir changer de niveau. Mais vous n'êtes pas le seul "chercheur de pierres précieuses", puisque Tentacle, une pieuvre assoiffée de diamants, est là pour vous mettre des bâtons dans les roues...

game.name: Brain Age 2 - More Training In Minutes A Day!
Brain Assist
game.desc: Brain Assist sur DS est un jeu de réflexion qui teste notre cerveau et notre perspicacité au moyen de dix exercices. Épreuves d'analyse, de déduction, le titre met également en ébullition votre réflexion et votre logique. La difficulté est croissante, et il est possible d'y jouer en multijoueur jusqu'à 4 participants.

game.name: Brain Buster Puzzle Pak
game.desc: Brain Buster Puzzle Pak features hundreds of puzzles ranging from the hugely popular Sudoku to the latest craze in Japan, Kakuro. Also included are the uniquely challenging and innovative games Light Up, Nurikabe, and Slitherlink. These puzzles have all been created in conjunction with Nikoli, the leading puzzle creators in Japan. Along with the straightforward puzzles in Brain Buster Puzzle Pak, there are added bonuses that can be unlocked as players enjoy solving the mind benders. For example, various monsters and asteroids distract you as you work on puzzle, but by removing them you earn special hints, adding to the fun factor. Wallpapers also become available after completing certain puzzle problems which can then be used to change the background graphic of each game.

game.name: Bratz - 4 Real
game.desc: The Bratz are in their first year of high school! They're going to be the most fabulous friends ever to grace Carry Nation High School! But the school class president has different plans and breaks up the Bratz girls into designated cliques. The girls want to find a way to bring all the cliques in the school together...and what better way than through a fabulous talent show!

game.name: Bratz - Forever Diamondz
game.desc: Bratz : Forever Diamondz sur Nintendo DS met en scène Cloé, Jade, Sasha et Jasmine dans une nouvelle aventure : trouver la créatrice de mode la plus talentueuse. Un voyage où mode et mini-jeux se côtoient pour atteindre le but ultime : remporter le concours Fashion Star America contre les Jumoniaques et la Reine Rose.

game.name: Bratz - Girlz Really Rock
game.desc: Bratz : Girlz Really Rock est un jeu DS mettant en scène Cloé, Jade, Sasha et Yasmin au camp Starshine. Elles peuvent s'exercer aux arts du spectacle, puis finalement intégrer un studio et jouer sur une scène. Le joueur peut les maquiller, les coiffer à la dernière mode et les faire participer à plusieurs mini-jeux : parachutisme, golf miniature, guitare et clavier, etc.

game.name: Bratz - Super Babyz
game.desc: Adaptation vidéoludique d'une aventure des Bratz disponible en DVD, Bratz : Super Babyz sur DS prend la forme d'un jeu d'aventure enfantin, mâtiné d'une petite sélection de mini-jeux. On y suit les Bratz dans leur tentative de repousser une invasion de Martiens dans un parc d'attractions.

game.name: Bratz Ponyz 2
game.desc: Bratz Ponyz 2 sur DS est une collection de mini-jeux centrés autour de l'un des 4 poneys à choisir. Votre but est de permettre à votre animal de remporter le concours organisé au village pour qu'il soit élu premier de sa catégorie en beauté, danse, arts, musique ou mode. La connexion sans-fil de la console permet d'échanger des photos avec d'autres joueurs.

game.name: Bratz Ponyz
game.desc: Bratz Ponyz sur DS vous propose de vous occuper d'une bande de poneys complètement fashion. Choisissez parmi les huit animaux disponibles et parez-le des meilleurs atours : colliers, maquillage, tatouages, rubans... Participez au concours "Passion de la mode" pour débloquer des bonus et avoir l'animal le plus tendance.

game.name: Brave
game.desc: Play as Merida, an expert archer and heroine, from the Disney film "Brave". Go on quests through a magical world and solve puzzles to uncover secrets.

game.name: Brick 'Em All DS
game.desc: This Breakout clone for the Nintendo DS offers touch screen controls for directing your bat. As well as a traditional "Tokoton mode" offering 50 screens of bricks to destroy, it also offers over 3 million random levels to go for a high score. There is also "Quest mode" where you fight through 12 levels and face 8 bosses. Finally "Survival mode" where 8 bats attempt to knock balls at each other's weak point to defeat them. Power-ups are available in Tokoton mode but you select which 4 you wish to use out of a total 8, including bat lengtheners and weapons. It also offers up to 8 player single or multi-card play locally for Quest and Survival mode.

game.name: Broken Sword - Shadow Of The Templars - The Director's Cut
Brothers In Arms Ds
game.desc: Brothers in Arms DS is a handheld addition to the acclaimed WWII action game series from Gearbox Software. Set during the Allied invasion of Normandy, North-Africa and Ardennes in 1944, the player fights through 16 different missions in the single player mode, using authentic WWII-era rifles, pistols, grenades, or machine guns. This 3rd-person action game features intuitive controls enabling the player to shoot, take cover, flank, and out-maneuver the enemy in a variety of battles actually fought in by American paratroopers during the war, while the DS touch-screen allows for squad command. Multi-player features a variety of different gameplay modes for up to four players.

game.name: Build-A-Bear Workshop - Welcome to Hugsville
game.desc: Build-A-Bear Workshop : Welcome to Hugsville sur DS est une simulation de vie qui entraîne les plus jeunes joueurs dans un monde peuplé de peluches. A travers cinq environnements différents, ces derniers découvriront de multiples petites quêtes et une large sélection de mini-jeux.

game.name: Build-A-Bear Workshop - Where Best Friends Are Mad
game.desc: Get ready for the total Build-A-Bear experience on Nintendo DS! Make your own Build-A-Bear, dress it up, play with it in lots of funny activities and mini games! The Bear will be like a virtual extension of yourself and a personal companion you can love like a best friend. You must make sure you satisfy its daily needs as physical affection, fun, food, learning, social life and trendyness are all necessary elements for the Bear to be balanced and happy. A highly interactive and trans-generational game in the true Build-A-Bear spirit!

game.name: Bunnyz
game.desc: Après les chiens et les chats, c'est au tour de l'éducation de lapins d'être importée sur DS. Prenez-les "au berceau", nourrissez-les et faites-les grandir à votre guise. De nombreuses autres interactions sont possibles avec votre animal, jouer avec lui, lui acheter des accessoires, le promener... Un large panel d'actions pour faire grandir son lapin fétiche.

game.name: Burnout Legends
game.desc: First installation of the Burnout-series on handheld consoles combines the best features of the first three games: Burnout, Burnout 2: Point of Impact, and Burnout 3: Takedown. Aggressive racing is still the centerpiece attraction of Burnout Legends and the player's task is not only to win the races but also crash opponent cars as much as possible. Opponent takedowns, drifts, and other stunts award Burnout Points which in turn unlock new cars and other awards. One player games can be played as single events or as a World Tour where the player needs to compete in different races and succeed in them in order to advance through five car classes (Compact, Muscle, Coupe, Sport, and Super). In addition there is the Crash mode, where the goal is to create as much wreckage as possible by ploughing the player car into the traffic. The different race types include Race, Time Attack, Road Rage, Pursuit, Face Off, Eliminator, Burning Lap, and Grand Prix. Multiplayer game modes include Race, Road Rage, Pursuit, special Crash modes Double Impact and Party Crash (all these can can be played as single events or as a tournament), and Collector Challenge where the player has the opportunity to win other player's Collector cars. PSP version game sharing feature allows others to play multiplayer events or single player demo without their own Burnout Legends UMD. DS version Multi-Pak support allows two player games without additional game cards. More than two player games require multiple game cards.

game.name: Bust-A-Move DS
game.desc: Bust-a-Move lands on the Nintendo DS in this handheld entry. As Bub & Bob from the original Bubble Bobble arcade game, your goal is to clear the top screen of bubbles by throwing your coloured bubble into the pack creating a group of 3 or more, which causes them to disappear. This edition allows you to throw the bubbles with the touchscreen and offers over 250 puzzles to play and more to unlock. It also offers multiplayer for up to 5 players over multi card or single card DS Download play. This game is not to be confused with the Japanese only Puzzle Bobble DS, which does not offer the touchscreen controls, was created by a different development studio and includes different levels.

game.name: C.o.p. - The Recruit
game.desc: C.O.P. : The Recruit sur DS est un jeu d'action ancré dans un environnement urbain ouvert, où vous incarnez un jeune repris de justice qui n'a pas d'autre choix que de travailler pour la police. Le jeu propose des phases de courses en voiture et des phases d'action où l'on dirige le personnage à la troisième personne.

game.name: Cake Mania 2 - Jill's Next Adventure !
game.desc: Dans Cake Mania 2 sur Nintendo DS, vous êtes à la tête de votre propre pâtisserie et devez attirer de nombreux clients. Pour ce faire, réalisez les gâteaux les plus gourmands et ne prévoyez aucun temps mort dans les 200 niveaux nécessaires à l'accomplissement de votre tâche. Choisissez bien votre voie car six fins différentes sont possibles. Recevez les clients les plus bizarres qui soient et servez-leur ce qu'ils désirent pour devenir la meilleure !

game.name: Cake Mania
game.desc: Jill is a young baker who acquired her passion for baking from her grandparents in their bakery, Evans Bakery. When she returned from culinary school, she discovered Evans Bakery closed down because a "Mega-Mart" moved in. Jill decides to show the mega corporation what her family's baking is all about and opened her own bakery in order to earn enough money to buy back Evans Bakery. Can Jill handle the pressure of running her own business and beat Mega-Mart? In Cake Mania, your job is to help Jill meet the monthly quota through 48 progressively difficult levels. This is no simple task because you will have to bake quickly as well as serve the customers quickly. There are a variety of different customers to serve. From nice old ladies to impatient holiday icons like Cupid! Each kind of customer have a different patience-level (indicated by the number of hearts). The longer they wait, the lower their patience. If they get too low, they will storm off and cost you money! When a customer first enters your bakery, hand them a menu. Then they will give you their order (in the form of a thought bubble) and you will have to create that cake. If you create the wrong cake (wrong shape or wrong frosting, etc) then you will have to throw it away and start over (costing you more money). You start off with one oven and one frosting machine. Between levels you will have the opportunity to purchase upgrades or new items that will improve the bakery's. For example, you can purchase upgrade your oven to one that bakes faster or you can purchase a T.V. that will help improve customers' patience.

game.name: Call of Duty - Modern Warfare - Mobilized
game.desc: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized is a 2009 first person shooter video game in the Call of Duty franchise, developed specifically for the Nintendo DS. The game takes place in the same setting as Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and features many elements of gameplay typical to the series, including the usage of iron sights, and vehicular missions. It was released by Activision alongside the console versions of the game on November 10, 2009.

game.name: Call of Duty - Modern Warfare 3 - Defiance
game.desc: Call of Duty : Modern Warfare 3 est un jeu de tir à la première personne sur Nintendo DS qui s'inscrit dans le contexte d'une hypothétique Troisième Guerre mondiale. La campagne nous propose d'affronter les Russes à travers 14 missions. Le soft intègre également 10 défis inspirés des niveaux solos ainsi qu'un mode multijoueur complet pour 6 participants.

game.name: Call of Duty - World at War
game.desc: Call of Duty: World at War from Activision for the Nintendo DS brings WWII gameplay to the palm of your hand. Achieve victory in seven unique mini-games as you confront enemies on European and Pacific battlefields. Gameplay employs the Nintendo DS stylus and dual-screen interface for unique control. Transmit secret messages with Morse Code, disarm mines, parachute to safety, heal fellow soldiers, provide artillery support, and more. Connect online in four-player multiplayer action with more than 10 maps available for Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, and Hunter/Prey.

game.name: Call of Duty 4 - Modern Warfare
game.desc: Based on the version for the home consoles and PC, the DS CoD4 follows the story from the point of view of random unnamed soldiers, either S.A.S. soldiers or US marines, performing non-crucial tasks for the story, but parallel to this. Examples of this ar

game.name: Camp Rock - Le Face À Face
game.desc: Camp Rock : Le Face à Face sur DS est un jeu de rythme où vous devez monter votre groupe de rock. Vous débarquez dans un camp entièrement dédié à la musique et devez vous faire une place en tant que bassiste, guitariste ou batteur. Pour cela, il vous faut récolter de l'argent et recruter d'autres membres dans le but d'assurer le spectacle !

game.name: Captain America - Super Soldier
game.desc: Captain America : Super Soldat sur DS est l'adaptation du film du même nom mettant en scène le fameux super-héros américain. Sa mission sera d'arrêter son ennemi de toujours Red Skull en pleine Seconde Guerre mondiale.

game.name: Captain Sabertooth And The Trials By Fire
Carcassonne
game.desc: Carcassonne DS is the classical board game from Hans im Glück adapted to the Nintendo DS platform. It includes the river extension and three specific tiles design for Asiatic, Arabic and Nordic environment. A campaign mode gets you through the basic tactics of this game while also providing you with a storyline to follow and specific challenges to overcome. The goal of the game is to build up the biggest empire consisting of cities, roads and control over fields by using pawns to control the tiles you play. The game include multiplayer options for up to 5 with several cartridges or up to 4 with only one cartridge.

game.name: Cars - Mater-National Championship
game.desc: Cars Mater-National features an all-new international group of racers vying for their chance to compete against Lightning McQueen in the First Annual Mater-National Race Festival, hosted by Lightning's best friend, Mater. Explore the new and improved open world of Radiator Springs, play in the all-new Monster Mode, jump into the fast lane with six new International racing competitors, burn rubber on new tracks, and twist and turn your way through new mini-games like Ramone's Rhythmic Rumble and Fillmore's Fuel Frenzy.

game.name: Cars 2
game.desc: Cars 2 sur DS est l'adaptation du film éponyme. Le mode Histoire nous lance dans une série de courses et d'enquêtes sur les activités du Professeur Z. Devenez un espion et faufilez vous derrière les vigiles ennemis pour obtenir des informations. Le titre est aussi jouable en multi jusqu'à quatre.
