This version features four playable characters (two at the start and two more when the game is beaten), each with their own strengths and weaknesses as well as different storylines for each. The game is told through a series of flashbacks that will give the players clues on how to escape. Players must survive various natural disasters like freak lightning storms and earthquakes that can drain their characters health and stamina. Players can also explore the island and play in one of 20 different minigames such as river rafting and playing with dolphins. Players can explore various different environments on the island from the beach to the jungle interior. There is also online capabilities through either single card play in a series of mini-games or use multi-card play to play a cooking minigame head to head.

game.name: Lost in Blue
game.desc: Lost in Blue is an RPG for the Nintendo DS with several survival-themed mini-games making heavy use of the DS touch screen and microphone. You play as Keith and Skye, two teenagers who wake up on an abandoned island following an ocean disaster. The two must learn to make fire and provisions, gather food, and look for a way to get back home. Mini-games include making fire, digging for shells, trapping, bow hunting, fishing, and cooking. All must be done with a sense of urgency, as your characters' fatigue slowly builds throughout the day as they continually approach starvation. The game is the spiritual sequel to Survival Kids.

game.name: Lost Treasures Of Alexandria, The
game.desc: The Lost Treasures of Alexandria est un puzzle-game sur Nintendo DS nous invitant à relever 200 défis à travers 10 environnements distincts. Dans la peau d'une jeune archéologue, le joueur devra former des groupes de trois sphères colorées ou plus pour atteindre divers objectifs. Quelques variantes de jeu, des sphères spéciales mais aussi des tableaux alternatifs et des pouvoirs spéciaux nous réservent de nombreuses surprises.

game.name: Lostmagic
game.desc: In Lost Magic the player controls Isaac, a young Wizard who initially sets out looking for his missing father. Soon his investigations uncover a threat to the world by the evil Diva of Twilight. Lost Magic is a game that where the primary focus is combat, with little in the way of exploration to interrupt the main theme of the game. The stylus is used to direct the player's allies, (monsters captured by Isaac)and to cast spells. The focus of the game is capturing monsters to later help the Isaac defeat the more powerful foes. Up to 400 different spells can be cast, many in combination with others to create new effects. The challenge lies in using the stylus quickly and accurately to not only combine these spells, but to effectively direct the real time battles. The game supports Wi-Fi as well as both single and multi cartridge versions of multiplayer.

game.name: Love Is... In Bloom - The Flower Shop Garden
Lovely Lisa
game.desc: Lovely Lisa pense à toutes les jeunes filles en quête d'identité. Ici, vous pourrez habiller, coiffer et maquiller à votre guise votre avatar, tout en participant à plusieurs mini-jeux. Des conseils sont donnés pour relooker au mieux les personnages.

game.name: Loving Life with Hello Kitty & Friends
game.desc: In Loving Life with Hello Kitty and Friends you take on the role of Kitty and the whole gang's in tow to join in on the fun: the rabbits of assorted colours, the pink sheep, the penguin and the floating fairy people.

game.name: Luminous Arc
game.desc: Luminous Arc is a strategy role-playing game. The story is set in a world in which there are two groups in apparent opposition: the Luminous church, and the witches. During the course of the story, the player controls a party made up of orphans who have been raised by the Luminous church. They are called the Garden Children, and are tasked with the condemnation of witches. However, soon after the beginning of the story, it becomes evident that things are not as clear-cut as they initially seem. Structurally, the party moves from area to area, and the plot advances as the player progresses through battles. Equipment may be powered up through the use of a vitae forging system. Also, relationships with characters may be strengthened during post-fight "intermissions," leading to some bonuses in future battles.

game.name: Lunar - Genesis
game.desc: Lunar : Dragon Song est un jeu de rôle sur la Nintendo DS. Les événements décris dans le jeu se déroulent 1000 ans avant l'histoire contée dans le premier jeu Lunar, Lunar : The Silver Star. L'histoire tourne autour de Jian Campbell, un jeune homme qui part à l'aventure dans le but de stopper la menace croissante incarnée par une communauté de puissants magiciens qui cherchent à contrôler la déesse Athena afin de conquérir le monde.

game.name: Lunar Knights
game.desc: Many years into the future, a race of vampires have emerged, plunging planet Earth into darkness with an environmental control system called the 'paraSOL'. They now control the planet, with humans living in fear. When all hope seems lost, two boys with amazing power emerge to save the planet. The Dark Swordsman, Lucian, and a rookie member of the vampire fighting 'Guild', Aaron. Lunar Knights is an indirect sequel to the Boktai series of games, which takes place many years after. Its focus is much more on action as opposed to stealth, although some stealth elements from the earlier games remain (for example, you can blow into the microphone to whistle and attract the attention of enemies). Players control the two characters, Lucian and Aaron. Lucian fights with a huge sword called 'Vanagand'. As a result, Lucian has a close combat style. Lucian uses the power of moonlight to fuel his special attacks and moves. The other character is Aaron, a gunslinger for the Guild. He fights by using sunlight to charge up his gun, the Knight, and shoot ranged shots at foes. Aaron's special attacks and moves use up sunlight. Both Aaron and Lucian can use junk materials to increase the level of their weaponry, giving them more power. The main goal of the game is to make your way through the dungeons and purify the vampire at the end. The dungeons themselves are fairly standard - you search for treasure chests, avoid traps and solve puzzles. At the end, you'll fight a boss vampire, and once you've defeated them, the Casket Rocket will be called. Because the vampires have blocked out the sun on Earth, you'll need to take the vampire into space to purify them. At this point, the game becomes a touch screen controlled shooter. To control the ship itself, you drag it around the screen with the stylus. To shoot enemy ships, you tap them with the screen. Once you reach the end, the vampire will be purified by the magnified power of the sun.

game.name: Madagascar - Escape 2 Africa
game.desc: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa DS is a third-person action-platformer based on the movie of the same name. All of the Madagascar characters are available for play, including Alex, Gloria, Melman, and the giant Moto-Moto, each with their own unique moves. Players explore the African savanna, climbing, jumping, swimming, confusing tourists, finding monkeys, and collecting items along the way. The game also includes various minigames, into Mort's Pinball and a humorous sidescrolling, teamwork game featuring the four plotting penguins from the film.

game.name: Madagascar 2
game.desc: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa DS is a third-person action-platformer based on the movie of the same name. All of the Madagascar characters are available for play, including Alex, Gloria, Melman, and the giant Moto-Moto, each with their own unique moves. Players explore the African savanna, climbing, jumping, swimming, confusing tourists, finding monkeys, and collecting items along the way. The game also includes various minigames, into Mort's Pinball and a humorous sidescrolling, teamwork game featuring the four plotting penguins from the film.

game.name: Madagascar 3 : Europe's Most Wanted
game.desc: Madagascar 3 sur DS reprend les personnages du film du même nom dans un jeu d'action très aérien. Alex, Marty, Gloria et Melman doivent en effet faire la publicité d'un cirque à travers diverses villes européennes. Leurs numéros sont variés et mettent en avant les amis du quatuor. On retrouve donc aussi les lémuriens, les pingouins, ou le jaguar.

game.name: Madagascar Kartz
game.desc: Madagascar Kartz is a racing game based on DreamWorks Animation's Madagascar. It was released on October 27, 2009 and the second game on Madagascar's spin-off series. Gameplay[edit] The game is a basic kart racing game, and the player can perform jumps, flips, rolls.[1] There are many different stages from scenes of the franchise.[1] Playable characters include Alex, Marty, Gloria, Melman, King Julien, Mason and Phil, or all four of the penguins.[1] The Madagascar Kartz Wheel is bundled with the Wii version of the game. This wheel is optional. This wheel's look is different from that of the Wii Wheel from Mario Kart Wii.[1] Playable characters include Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Melman the Giraffe, Gloria the Hippotamus, The Penguins, The Chimps, and King Julien from the Madagascar. Two characters from other movies are included alongside the Madagascar, Shrek from Shrek, and B.O.B. from Monsters vs. Aliens, all DreamWorks Animation franchises. Race types include Quick Race, Championship, Time Trial and Checkpoint race. A Championship race is one where the player collects mangoes and tries to finish first place in order to unlock higher speed classes (50cc, 100cc, 150cc, 200cc, the last one is raced in reverse direction/mirror mode), more karts and tracks. In Time Trial, players beat their own times and earn medals (gold, silver and bronze). In Checkpoint Race, players collect as many hourglasses as they can before the time runs out. There are several tracks in the game. Also, in a track, most tracks have 2 shortcuts. "I Like to Move It", sung by Reel 2 Real, is the menu theme. The game's gameplay is similar to those of Mario Kart Wii, by Nintendo. The sequel is Super Star Kartz.

game.name: Madagascar
game.desc: In Madagascar for Nintendo DS, based on the movie of the same name, you play as Marty (zebra), Alex (lion), Gloria (hippo), and Melman (giraffe). Levels require you to switch between the available characters to make use of their special abilities. The DS's touch-screen is used to switch characters, fight, and make some movements. Players must explore levels to find hidden collectibles, some of which are only available after unlocking abilities. The story follows the movie plot, with players exploring New York City's Central Park Zoo as well as Madagascar.

game.name: Madden NFL 06
game.desc: The football masters are back once again and ready to blow you away with some of the best features ever. All new major passing offense and passing upgrades like the all new QB vision. Brand new single-player mode lets you experience the life of an NFL player by earning one of more than 60 Personas ranging from MVP to Movie Star. New robust (online) features: share files via your EA Locker and instantly find a solid match-up with improved matchmaking. Also check your EA SPORTS Fantasy Football stats in game.

game.name: Madden Nfl 07
game.desc: Play and manage football matches between real NFL teams, featuring the latest player lineups of 2007!

game.name: Madden NFL 08
game.desc: Play and manage football matches between real NFL teams, featuring the latest player lineups of 2008!

game.name: Madden Nfl 09
game.desc: L'intégralité de la saison 2009 de football américain est dans cette version de Madden NFL 09 sur DS. Vous retrouverez les joueurs, les entraîneurs, les stades et tout ce qui fait le charme de la NFL.

game.name: Maestro! Jump In Music
game.desc: Discover Presto, the music-loving bird, and make him evolve in a colorful, decibel-filled journey. Use the stylus to scrape, rub, tap and whirl to the rhythm of the level's music and like a good Maestro, stick to the original. Presto will jump or get off a platform in the order in which you strum the string, flying with his small wings to reach the music score.

game.name: Magic Made Fun: Perform Tricks That Will Amaze You
game.desc: Master of Illusion is different from other exercise games. This one is a take on magic, teaching the player but also performing magic tricks against the player itself. There are three different modes including Solo Magic, Magic Show and Magic Training. In Solo Magic, a magician performs parlor tricks such as guessing what card the player has just picked out or guessing by the hand gestures the player makes over the DS screen. In Magic Tricks, there are fourteen different tricks to try where the game is more of an assistant, helping the player out performing your tricks including having a friend pick out a card and drawing a face at the bottom of the screen that will guess the card picked out. It can also guess a person's birthday or where they are going on their vacation. Some of the tricks have the player recite different things through the microphone, for instance the vacation trick, or the player needs to blow into the microphone. The third mode is called Magic Training, which is more of a series of mini-games to help test reaction speed. There are step by step instructions of how to perform tricks and there is also a special deck of cards that comes with the game.

game.name: Magical Starsign
game.desc: Magical Starsign is Role Playing Game about a group of students at the Will O’ Wisp magical academy. When their teacher mysteriously disappears they set out to find and rescue her. As she is on a different planet, this involves space travel. The player starts out alone, but one by one the classmates join the quest. The students are each specialized in a different art of magic, linked to a starsign. As the planets move through the sky (as seen on the 'astrolog') the magic associated with that sign grows stronger and weaker. This applies to the monsters as well, which adds a strategic element to the gameplay. As characters grow stronger, they learn new spells. During combat, players tap on the attacks they want to use and then tap on an enemy to target. By tapping the character's head at the exact moment they release the spell, the attack is extra effective. There are two multiplayer options. The first, tag mode, allows players to exchange data with one another. In the magical rocket, an egg will hatch that will slowly develop into a new unique character. In the amigo dungeon mode up to six people can explore an 'amigo dungeon'.

game.name: Mah Jong Quest - Expeditions
game.desc: Mah Jong Quest Expeditions adapte sur DS le plus populaire jeu de réflexion chinois. Les joueurs doivent restaurer l'harmonie d'un monde déséquilibré en guidant Kwazis (héros adolescent séparé en deux parties, une masculine et une féminine) dans huit pays mystiques et 64 puzzles. Chaque tableau impose un temps limité pour faire correspondre les différents symboles.

game.name: Mahjong - Eine Reise Um Die Welt
game.publisher: dtp young entertainment GmbH & Co. KG

game.name: Mahjong 300
game.desc: Le jeu de société Mahjong 300 sur Nintendo DS permet de retrouver 300 niveaux reprenant le principe de ce jeu ancestral. Cinq modes de jeu sont proposés ainsi que trois niveaux de difficulté. Des bonus peuvent également être collectés afin de se faciliter la tâche en cours de partie.

game.name: Mahjong Mysteries - Ancient Athena
game.desc: Mahjong Mysteries : Ancient Egypt sur Nintendo DS est un jeu de réflexion qui mélange le classique jeu de mah-jong et une quête menant David, un célèbre aventurier, à la découverte des mystères de l'Antiquité. Parcourez 300 niveaux dans différents modes de jeu et percez les secrets les plus énigmatiques de cette époque de l'histoire.

game.name: Mahjong
game.desc: This adaptation of the classic Chinese board game offers 100 level for single-player sessions, with three difficulty levels. The levels can also be played in a campaign mode, with twelve illustrated stations. The main aim of the game is to make pairs of blocks disappear on a board where they are stapled on different layers. Removing matching blocks reveals the ones below, until the entire board is cleared or the player is stuck. The game includes a help function and blocks can be immediately selected using the stylus. There are different themes of blocks to choose from, including classic Chinese characters but also more general symbol. The game keeps track of the remaining blocks, the score, and there is an undo function.

game.name: Mahjongg - Ancient Mayas
game.desc: Mahjongg Ancient Mayas est un jeu de réflexion sur Nintendo DS reprenant le principe du jeu antique chinois du même nom. Activez le mode Aventure et tentez de résoudre l'énigme portant sur l'ancien temple Tikal ou confrontez-vous aux 300 niveaux de Mahjongg disponibles.

game.name: Mahjongg Ds
game.desc: Mahjongg DS adapte un antique jeu de réflexion d'origine chinoise sur la console portable de Nintendo. De nombreux niveaux sont disponibles dans trois difficultés différentes, ainsi que quatre modes de jeu : Classix, Tactics, Time-Attack et Match-Three. Le tout est basé sur un scénario rempli de châteaux, de chevaliers et de dragons.

game.name: Mahjongg Mysteries : Ancient Egypt
game.desc: Mahjong Mysteries : Ancient Egypt sur Nintendo DS est un jeu de réflexion qui mélange le classique jeu de Mahjong et une aventure qui vous conduit au coeur des secrets de l'Egypte ancienne. Des centaines de plateaux et des options spéciales sont de la partie.

game.name: Mahjongg Mysteries : Ancient Egypt
game.desc: Mahjong Mysteries : Ancient Egypt sur Nintendo DS est un jeu de réflexion qui mélange le classique jeu de Mahjong et une aventure qui vous conduit au coeur des secrets de l'Egypte ancienne. Des centaines de plateaux et des options spéciales sont de la partie.

game.name: Mais Ou Se Cache Carmen Sandiego - Mystere Au Bout Du Monde
game.desc: Mais où se Cache Carmen Sandiego ? Mystère au Bout du Monde sur DS est un jeu d'aventure ludo-éducatif dans lequel il va vous falloir déjouer les pièges de cette cambrioleuse diablement agile. Dans la peau de Julia ou Adam, retrouvez trois grands trésors de l'humanité dérobés par Carmen. Partez aux quatre coins du monde et combinez action et réflexion pour résoudre les énigmes posées. Adoptez aussi le bon ton pour interroger les témoins et venir à bout des enquêtes.

game.name: March Of The Penguins
game.desc: Based on the documentary March of the Penguins, this game follows the story of the emperor penguins as they embark on a long journey to breed their young. The game has been divided into twelve chapters, with different gameplay. The penguins need to be navigated through the environment, find a suitable mate, find food, take care of the egg, guard the young ones and finally make it all the way back. A large part of the game is based on the concept of Lemmings. As the penguins march on, players need to help them land softly, melt obstacles, attract them in a certain direction using fish and place trampolines, ramps, slides, bridges and steps to make them access new areas. The levels can be explored using binoculars and the penguins need to collect a certain amount of snowflakes to pass. The penguins cannot die. When they fall off a cliff, they simply restart at the beginning of the level, but the players needs to bring them to the end as a group to succeed. Other levels have the penguins slide down hills with faster gameplay, feature mazes, or take place underwater where predators need to be avoided while collecting food. In the later parts of the game, guarding the eggs adds an new layer of difficulty. As soon as a penguin hits an obstacle it is dropped. There is little time to pick it up again or it freezes. It also need to be taken to a warm spot before the thermometer time runs out. Some educational content has also been included. Next to the habits, more information about the penguin migration in provided in between levels.

game.name: Margot's Word Brain
game.desc: Margot's Word Brain sur DS nous permet de faire connaissance avec une certaine Margot qui invente des puzzles diaboliques (six sets différents disponibles) pour tester le vocabulaire et les compétences de langage des joueurs. Des menus simples d'utilisation rendent le jeu accessible à tous les publics tandis que les tableaux de scores permettent de comparer ses exploits à ceux de ses amis.

game.name: Marie-antoinette Et La Guerre D'indépendance Américaine, Episode 1 - La Fraternité Du Loup
game.desc: Marie-Antoinette et la Guerre d'Indépendance Américaine, Episode 1 : la Fraternité du Loup est un jeu d'aventure sur DS. Se déroulant au cours du 18ème siècle, l'intrigue vous permettra de parcourir quelques lieux historiques en résolvant des énigmes confiées par les personnages du jeu.

game.name: Mario & Luigi - Bowser's Inside Story
game.desc: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story is the third game in the Mario & Luigi series of games. Players control Mario and Luigi simultaneously in the side-scrolling platform environment of Bowser's body, while also controlling the Koopa King himself in the top-down world of the Mushroom Kingdom. Similar to games like Earthbound, enemy encounters are seen as actual enemies that players can avoid or attempt to strike early. The actual battles are a combination of turn-based menu attacks, and timed reactions to enemies during battle. By watching the way an enemy reacts, you can anticipate their attack and avoid it or counterattack.

game.name: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games
game.desc: Two of the biggest icons in the entertainment industry, Mario and Sonic, are joining forces to star in Mario and Sonic at the Olympic Games. Developed exclusively for the Wii video game system and the Nintendo DS system, this momentous agreement marks the first time these two renowned stars have appeared together in a game. Featuring an all-star cast of characters from the amazing worlds of both Mario and Sonic, players will be able to compete as or against a range of familiar characters including Mario, Sonic, Luigi, Knuckles, Yoshi, Tails and more.

game.name: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games
game.desc: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games will take players to Vancouver, Canada, host city of the official 2010 Olympic Winter Games. This gaming experience invites players of all ages and skill sets to face-off in some of the most intense winter competitions. The Nintendo DS brings an intense competitive element using the Nintendo DS wireless capabilities.

game.name: Mario Kart Ds
game.desc: Mario Kart DS is the continuation of the long running racing game series that began on the Super Nintendo. It features 16 new tracks as well as 16 tracks from the previous 4 games, with each set split up into the Nitro and Retro Grand Prix respectively. Eight racers are initially available, each with two go-karts to choose from. A number of characters and additional karts are also available to unlock. New items have been added to the arsenal, including a Blooper squid that squirts ink onto the screens of other players and a Bullet Bill power up that transforms the player into a giant, fast-travelling bullet on autopilot.

game.name: Mario Vs. Donkey Kong 2 - March Of The Minis
game.desc: Mario vs. Donkey Kong 2: March of the Minis is an action/puzzle game where the object is to bring as many Mini-Marios to the exit door as possible by solving the puzzle. All the puzzles are fairly small and take up anywhere from one screen to four screens (2x2) in size. All the Mini-Marios that are collected in each room are then used in the Donkey Kong boss battle at the end of the world. All of the control is done with the stylus; no buttons are used at all.

game.name: Mario Vs. Donkey Kong 2 - Minimini Daikoushin!
game.desc: Mario vs. Donkey Kong 2: March of the Minis is an action/puzzle game where the object is to bring as many Mini-Marios to the exit door as possible by solving the puzzle. All the puzzles are fairly small and take up anywhere from one screen to four screens (2x2) in size. All the Mini-Marios that are collected in each room are then used in the Donkey Kong boss battle at the end of the world. All of the control is done with the stylus; no buttons are used at all.

game.name: Marvel Nemesis - Rise of the Imperfects
game.desc: Marvel Nemesis has two playing modes, a single-player story mode, where players brawl their way through a Mark Millar scripted tale, and a

game.name: Marvel Super Hero Squad - The Infinity Gauntlet
game.desc: Marvel Super Hero Squad : Le Gant de l'Infini sur Nintendo DS est un jeu d'action mettant en scène les héros Marvel dans leur version cartoon. Le mode histoire vous propose d'incarner une petite partie des personnages à la recherches des pierres de l'infini tandis qu'un mode challenge jusqu'à quatre joueurs vous permet de faire votre choix parmi pas moins de trente héros de l'univers Marvel.

game.name: Marvel Super Hero Squad
game.desc: Vous en avez assez de Smash Bros et des Lego, alors Marvel Super Hero Squad sur DS est un jeu qui devrait vous plaire ! Inspiré de la série éponyme de Marvel, Super Hero Squad vous met dans la peau des super-gentils ou des super-vilains pour sauver/détruire la ville Super Hero City dans le mode solo. Un mode combat est disponible dans lequel vous pourrez incarner pas moins de 10 personnages issus de X-men, des Vengeurs et bien d'autres.

game.name: Marvel Trading Card Game
game.desc: Marvel Trading Card Game is a strict electronic conversion of the Vs. System collectible card game rules by Upper Deck. It includes cards from all of the Marvel-based Vs. sets through the X-Men set. The gameplay involves head-to-head battles where players recruit superhero characters with various strengths and powers onto the playfield. Each character has a basic Attack and Defense value which determines the outcome of individual character battles. This basic mechanic is augmented by character powers, Equipment cards (which give the character additional powers/stats), Location cards (which affect multiple cards or game rules while they are face up), and Plot Twist cards (which are often played to change the outcome of individual character battles by boosting Attack or Defense values). The game features two single player campaigns, tutorials, puzzles, and an online mode similar to Magic The Gathering Online. The online mode supports cross-platform play between the PC and PSP versions.

game.name: Mary King's Riding School
game.desc: Mary King's Riding School sur Nintendo DS vous propose d'adopter et d'élever la plus belle conquête de l'homme : le cheval. Bichonnez votre poulain pour faire de lui le meilleur lors des championnats. Nourrissez-le convenablement, dressez-le, soignez ses blessures pour le présenter aux concours dans une forme optimum.

game.name: Matchstick Puzzle by DS
game.desc: Dans Matchstick Puzzle by DS, il faut résoudre de nombreux casse-tête en posant ou en déplaçant des allumettes sur une table avec le stylet. Equations, figures géométriques, jeux de mots, il y en a pour tous les goûts.

game.name: Max And The Magic Marker
game.desc: Max & the Magic Marker sur Nintendo DS est un mélange de plates-formes et de réflexion qui consiste à tracer directement sur le décor les éléments utiles pour progresser. Le jeu propose d'explorer trois mondes constitués chacun de cinq niveaux. Des bonus peuvent également être débloqués.

game.name: Maya
game.desc: Maya l'Abeille sur DS est un jeu d'aventure qui met en scène la malicieuse Maya l'abeille, son ami Willy et Flip la sauterelle. Vous devez partir à la recherche de vos amis qui ont été éparpillés un peu partout dans le champ de blé suite à une énorme tempête. Participez à des mini-jeux et plein de petits challenges pour trouver des indices permettant de localiser les autres abeilles et ainsi les sauver. Le titre, très coloré, est évidemment destiné aux plus petits.

game.name: May's Mysteries - The Secret of Dragonville
game.desc: Les Aventures de May : L'Etrange Disparition est un jeu d'aventure et d'énigmes à destination de la DS. Aidez la jeune May à retrouver son petit frère au coeur de la cité de Dragonville, en interrogeant les habitants et en résolvant 270 énigmes. Si le titre vous propose quelques rares phases de recherche d'objets cachés, l'aventure privilégie tout de même la logique et la réflexion, à la manière d'un Professeur Layton.

game.name: Mechanic Master
game.desc: Mechanic Master est puzzle-game sur DS destiné aux esprits créatifs. Le joueurs doit débarrasser la surface de la Terre des envahisseurs extraterrestres. Pour cela, il peut mettre au point d'étranges engins (inverseur de gravité, pistolet laser, miroirs, vortex...) au fil de la centaine de niveaux proposés, tout en gardant en tête les lois élémentaires de la physique. Un éditeur de niveaux est fourni permettant également d'échanger ses propres puzzles avec ses amis.

game.name: Mechassault - Phantom War
game.desc: MechAssault : Phantom War est un jeu d'action sur Nintendo DS. Vous incarnez un pilote de MechWarrior, une sorte de robot géant suréquipé qui se décline en plusieurs types d'unités. On trouve ainsi différentes sortes de BattleMechs plus ou moins massifs, mais aussi quelques BattleArmors, des armures mobiles plus légères, et même des tanks, ces derniers étant les seuls à pouvoir tirer avec précision grâce à la visée de snipe.

game.name: Mega Man Battle Network 5 : Double Team DS
game.desc: Mega Man Battle Network 5 : Double Team DS regroupe les deux volets Team ProtoMan et Team Colonel déjà sortis sur GBA. Ce jeu de rôle permet de retrouver le jeune Lan et son double virtuel Mega Man alors qu'ils affrontent tous les deux le syndicat du crime Nebula dirigé par le Dr. Regal. En explorant le réseau, Mega Man doit venir à bout de virus qui menacent l'humanité.

game.name: Mega Man Star Force - Leo
game.desc: Mega Man Star Force introduces a new lead character, a boy named Subaru Hoshikawa, who puts on special "visualizer" goggles left to him by his father, triggering a specific wave and summoning the presence of a mysterious alien life form named Warlock. Dangerous creatures from Warlock's planet have come to attack Earth, so they must join together to transform into Mega Man in order to defeat these menacing forces. Specific to the Leo version - turning up the heat, Fire Leo uses a special Flame Burner attack that can incinerate enemies in its path.

game.name: Mega Man Star Force - Pegasus
game.desc: A spin-off of the Mega Man Battle Network franchise, this game brings the franchise back with similar RPG gameplay but with an all-new Mega Man character and storyline to play through. This action RPG blends exploration with fast-paced battles, as players travel between real world and virtual "Wave World." In Mega Man Star Force, players explore towns and interact with people in the real world while the action-packed battles take place in the virtual "Wave World." Enemy encounters take place on a three by five grid in a 3D perspective, where players use a portfolio of Battle Cards that each have distinct attributes and attack powers. As the story progresses, players will acquire additional cards to build an arsenal that reflects their personal strategy. Players can also connect wirelessly via the Nintendo Wi-Fi connection with friends to create a Brother Band network, where they can share cards and get status upgrades.

game.name: Mega Man Star Force 2 - Zerker x Ninja
game.desc: Suivant le modèle de ses prédécesseurs, le jeu de rôle/action Mega Man Star Force 2 sur DS se décline en deux versions différentes. Chacune contient en réalité deux jeux, Berserk et Shinobi pour Mega Man Star Force 2 : Zerker X Ninja, Berserk et Dinosaure pour l'autre. Ces noms correspondent aux transformations dont pourra profiter le héros dans sa campagne contre les forces du mal cybernétiques.

game.name: Mega Man Star Force 2 - Zerker x Saurian
game.desc: Star Force 2 sur DS se décline en deux versions différentes. Chacune contient en réalité deux jeux, Berserk et Shinobi pour Mega Man Star Force 2 : Zerker X Ninja, Berserk et Dinosaure pour l'autre. Ces noms correspondent aux transformations dont pourra profiter le héros dans sa campagne contre les forces du mal cybernétiques.

game.name: Mega Man Zero Collection
game.desc: Mega Man Zero Collection es un conjunto de los cuatro juegos de la serie Mega Man Zero en un solo pack. Incluye: Mega Man Zero Mega Man Zero 2 Mega Man Zero 3 Mega Man Zero 4 Además de los cuatro juegos, Mega Man Zero Collection también cuenta con una galería de arte con obras de los juegos de la serie. Las tarjetas de e-Reader que eran exclusivas de la versión japonesa de Mega Man Zero 3, ahora puedes ir coleccionandolas a lo largo del juego. También se ha añadido la opción de jugar a través de los cuatro juegos en un playthrough continuo, en lugar de tener que seleccionar cada juego individualmente. Por último, un "Easy Mode" incluido hace que el juego sea más accesible para aquellos que no están acostumbrados al difícil nivel de dificultad del juego.

game.name: MegaMan Star Force : Dragon
game.desc: Mega Man Star Force est un jeu de rôle/action prenant place environ 200 ans après la série Mega Man Battle Network. La lutte contre les robots informatiques n'est donc pas terminée et la nouvelle incarnation du héros casqué doit tout faire pour y mettre enfin un terme. A sa sortie sur DS, Star Force est arrivé en trois versions différentes (Dragon, Leo et Pegasus) correspondant aux transformations possibles de Mega Man.

game.name: Mensch Aergere Dich Nicht - Das Beliebte Original
Metal Slug 7
game.desc: The Peregrine Falcon Strike Force, the Ikari Warriors, and the SPARROWS are once again on a search for General Morden and his army. Their mission is to catch General Morden and prevent his attempts at another coup d'état on the government. However, as soon as Morden was defeated, a strange army from the future came to his aid. Now, they must face Morden once again and this time, put a stop to his plans once and for all.

game.name: Meteos
game.desc: Designed by Masahiro Sakurai and produced by Tetsuya Mizuguchi, Meteos was the DS's second big-name puzzle game (after Polarium). Most of the game's action takes place on the bottom of the DS's two screens, where colored meteors plummet downwards towards a planet's atmosphere. There, they form columns that the user can manipulate with either the stylus or a combination of the D-pad and A button. When three or more meteors of the same color are arranged either vertically or horizontally, they "ignite" and rocket up towards the top screen. Rockets carry upwards any other metors that happen to be above them, and by stringing together several ignitions it is possible to lift many blocks at once. The ultimate objective of the game is to lift as many metors as possible back into "orbit" in the top screen; the game is over if the bottom screen fills up completely with meteors. Meteos features many different "planets" that the user can play on, each with subtle variations (such as in gravity) that affect gameplay.

game.name: Metroid Prime - Hunters
game.desc: An episode in the Metroid Prime series which started on the GameCube, this game takes place between Metroid Prime and Metroid Prime 2: Echoes. Interstellar bounty hunter Samus Aran is sent to the distant Alimbic Cluster by the Galactic Federation to investigate a message saying that the source of ultimate power lies in this desolate part of the galaxy, once home to an advanced culture. Samus is not alone, however. Other races have heard this mysterious message, too. Six other bounty hunters, each with unique characteristics, will do everything to get their hands on the Alimbic relics for their own reasons. The single-player mode is more focused on shooting than other Metroid games but also has puzzles in classic Metroid fashion. Unlike previous games, Samus has all her moves from the start, but she still has to look for weapons. The player may also run into other bounty hunters in this mode. The multiplayer mode is similar to Unreal Tournament or Quake games. Players can choose from any hunter that was defeated in single-player mode. There are seven modes in total including: Nodes, Survival, Bounty, Prime Hunter, Battle, Capture, and Defender. Each mode has its own unique rules. There are a vast number of arenas that can be played over local wireless or Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection. When using friend codes, voice chat before and after matches is enabled.

game.name: Metroid Prime Pinball
game.desc: In this pinball game based on Metroid Prime, Samus gets knocked and rolled around the table in Morph Ball form; the table contains Metroids, which can latch onto her and suck away health. Tables include the surface of Tallon IV, the Space Station, the Phazon Mines, and more can be unlocked by searching for artifacts and collecting bounties, which are found by destroying Space Pirates and other dangerous creatures. Metroid Prime Pinball is a pinball game with a Metroid theme. Players can collect power-ups such as missiles and super bombs, which can be helpful when defeating bosses. There are also missions to be completed within a time limit; these missions can involve defeating unique enemies that appear on the table or completing tasks such as wall jumping. Completing missions earns either artifacts or special tokens. The game also features a single-card multiplayer mode. In this mode, up to eight players can play. The game is a race to see who can reach a certain score first. Players lose points if they lose their ball. It is also possible to dump enemies onto opponents' tables to cause trouble for them.

game.name: Miami Crisis
game.desc: Miami Crisis est un jeu d'action/aventure sur DS. Le joueur y incarne tour à tour deux enquêteurs aux compétences complémentaires : Law Martin, de la police de Miami, et Sara Starling, du FBI. Ils doivent unir leurs efforts pour déjouer un complot terroriste. Ce qui passe aussi bien par de l'action (fusillades...) que par des phases de collecte d'indices et de réflexion.

game.name: Miami Nights - Singles In The City
game.desc: Miami Nights : Singles In The City sur DS est un simulateur de vie dans lequel on crée son personnage de bout en bout, que ce soit physiquement mais aussi psychologiquement, puis on le fait évoluer dans Miami. Le but est d'accéder à la popularité, par n'importe quel moyen, le principal étant de se tisser un réseau de contacts. N'oubliez pas de prendre soin de votre avatar si vous ne voulez pas qu'il repousse tout le monde !

game.name: Midnight Mysteries - The Edgar Allan Poe Conspirac
Midnight Play! Pack
game.desc: Midnight Play! Pack is a compilation of five Gameloft mobile games, ported to the Nintendo DS. The games are: 1. Block Breaker Deluxe 2. Midnight Pool 3. Midnight Bowling 4. Midnight Hold'em Poker 5. Platinum Solitaire The Midnight games are 3D versions.

game.name: Might & Magic - Clash of Heroes
game.desc: Might & Magic : Clash of Heroes est un mélange de jeu de rôle et de puzzle-game sur DS. Le titre propose cinq types de héros, disposant de pouvoirs et d'unités spécifiques, à incarner dans le cadre de cinq campagnes scénarisées. Le jeu offre également un mode Libre qui permet de paramétrer des escarmouches, ainsi qu'un mode deux joueurs pour affronter un ami.

game.name: Mijn Droomjob : Verpleegster
game.desc: Emma Infirmière de Choc sur DS est une simulation destinée aux blouses blanches en herbe. Le jeu permet de découvrir les gestes de premiers secours, les techniques d'infirmières et de soigner avec le stylet les coupures, contusions, étouffements et intoxications. Enfilez votre blouse et faites vos premières armes, seringue en main.

game.name: Military History - Commander - Europe At War
game.desc: Military History : Commander : Europe at War est un jeu de guerre à grande échelle sur DS. Revivez la Seconde Guerre mondiale d'une manière totalement inédite grâce à l'utilisation du stylet. Prenez les commandes des forces alliées et de l'axe et vivez une expérience militaire au tour par tour. Six différents scénarios épiques vous attendent allant du débarquement à la grande campagne.

game.name: Mind Your Language : Aprende Espanol!
game.desc: Mind your Language : Aprende Espanol ! sur DS est un jeu éducatif proposant une méthode ludique d'apprentissage des langues. Huit mini-jeux permettent de perfectionner ses connaissances sur les adjectifs, les noms, les verbes... Après l'écrit, entraînez-vous à l'oral avec plus de 1000 phrases enregistrées puis mesurez votre progression grâce au système de prix. Enfin, personnalisez votre apprentissage en créant votre propre dictionnaire.

game.name: Mind Your Language : Learn English!
game.desc: Mind your Language : Learn English ! sur DS est un jeu éducatif proposant une méthode ludique d'apprentissage des langues. Huit mini-jeux permettent de perfectionner ses connaissances sur les adjectifs, les noms, les verbes... Après l'écrit, entraînez-vous à l'oral avec plus de 1000 phrases enregistrées puis mesurez votre progression grâce au système de prix. Enfin, personnalisez votre apprentissage en créant votre propre dictionnaire.

game.name: Mini Ninjas
game.desc: Mini Ninjas sur DS propose de suivre Hiro dans sa quête pour restaurer l'harmonie dans un monde proche du chaos. Tirez profit de vos compétences et de votre entraînement pour combattre une armée magique de samouraïs. Exploitez le pouvoir de votre magie Kuji et utilisez les compétences de vos amis Mini Ninjas pour parcourir un monde semé d'embûches et atteindre la confrontation finale avec le seigneur maléfique, au coeur de sa forteresse.

game.name: Miss Spider's Sunny Patch Friends - Harvest Time Hop And Fly
Moi, Moche Et Méchant - Minions En Folie !
game.desc: Assemble the Minions! Based on Universal Pictures' CGI 3-D feature Despicable Me, Despicable Me: The Game?Minion Mayhem lets players use a Minion army and their abilities to complete dozens of puzzles, missions, and challenges. ? Use the touch screen to command an army of minions to explore locations from the film, use cool gadgets, and overcome extreme obstacles. ? Solve dozens of hilarious brain-bending puzzles. ? Features favorite characters from the film plus all-new minions. ? Collect trophies and become the ?Minion of the Month?.

game.name: Monopoly
game.desc: Experience Monopoly, one of the world's favorite family game brands, right on your Nintendo DS. Up to four players can play this new version of the board game classic together via a wireless Nintendo DS connection. New features, such as property auctions, add new excitement to the classic play. From the cheap motels on Baltic Avenue to the luxurious Boardwalk suites, there is excitement around every corner!

game.name: Monster Bomber
game.desc: The alien monsters have arrived, and it's up to you to destroy them with multicolored bombs. Create bombs on the lower screen, and fling them at the invaders at the top. Match up the colors correctly to destroy an invader, or knock them around to create a chain attack. This makes the game halfway between an action game and a puzzle game. You'll need reflexes to destroy the aliens fast enough, and brainpower to attack them correctly. Monster Bomber features a scenario mode, with a branching series of challenges, (complete with save/load) as well as survival mode and multiplayer.

game.name: Monster High : Skultimate Roller Maze
game.desc: Monster High : Course de Rollers Incroyablement Monstrueuse est un jeu de course sur Nintendo DS. Vous pouvez prendre part à 4 modes de jeu en incarnant plusieurs personnages. Ainsi, en plus de tenter le meilleur temps, il vous sera demandé de participer à un relais tout en choisissant trois types de coureuses.

game.name: Monster House
game.desc: Monster House is an old-school shoot 'em up based on Columbia Pictures' animated movie of the same name. With the help of your touch screen controlled water gun, you explore the house room by room, fighting off waves of enemies (assorted household objects) coming from every direction. You also pick up various power-ups along the way. You can play as each of the three characters from the film - DJ, Chowder, and Jenny. This game is heavily inspired by classics like Robotron and Smash TV.

game.name: Monster Jam : Path of Destruction
game.desc: Monster Jam : Path of Destruction sur Nintendo DS est un jeu de courses de camions dans lequel le joueur a le choix entre 28 véhicules authentiques (Grave Digger, Maximum Destruction ou encore Grinder) ou la possibilité de créer et personnaliser le sien. Huit stades officiels mettent aux prises les Monster Trucks en solo ou à deux.

game.name: Monster Jam
game.desc: Monster Jam sur DS vous installe au volant des engins les plus ravageurs qui soient après la moissonneuse batteuse : les monster trucks. Faites vrombir le moteur de ces engins massifs et défiez vos concurrents en écrasant tout sur votre passage afin de monter sur la première marche du podium. Que ce soit dans des stades, à l'extérieur ou en compétition freestyle, bataillez dur pour devenir le champion du monde.

game.name: Monster Trucks Ds
game.desc: Nintendo DS racing game from Skyworks Technologies and Majesco. Jump behind the wheel of your favorite monster truck and race on 25 different all-terrain tracks in five different environments. Master eight different monster rides, each with different starting attributes. As you complete challenges, you can upgrade your monster trucks in the performance shops between races with the cash you earn by winning the races. Tear-up the tracks and put it all on the line with your friends via a four-person multiplayer mode.

game.name: Moon
game.desc: Renegade Kid returns to the DS with this second game, Moon. After updating the Renegade Engine, used for the first game, Dementium, this new shooter for the DS puts you in the role of Major Edward Kane, Chief of Military Operations for the Extra-Terrestrial Encounter Organization. The year is 2058 and you and your squad are sent to the moon to investigate strange things that have been happening at the new moon bases. An alien hatch has been discovered at the construction site of one of the bases. So you need to take charge and take care of business. As its predecessor, it tries to fill the lack of shooters for Nintendo's handheld. With the stylus for aiming, the D-pad for moving and the shoulder buttons for shooting, Moon revisits the late 90's style of shooter started by the Quake series. The game features 24 episodes, 7 different weapons, various levels of difficulty, bonuses and other game modes to unlock.

game.name: Moorhuhn - Star Karts
game.desc: Moorhuhn : Star Karts sur Nintendo DS vous invite à prendre part une grande compétition de courses de karts. Après un incident dans son laboratoire scientifique, Crazy Chicken perd sa plus grande invention dans les confins de l'espace. Il se trouve que c'est le prix que remportera le gagnant de cette compétition et il doit donc acquérir la victoire pour la récupérer !

game.name: Moshi Monsters - Katsuma Unleashed
game.desc: Le jeu de plates-formes Moshi Monsters : Katsuma Unleashed sur DS entraîne Katsuma dans une série de six niveaux à la rencontre de l'armée de robots Moshlings du Dr. Strangelove. Katsuma peut compte sur différents pouvoirs pour battre ses ennemis et libérer ses potes Moshi.

game.name: Moto Racer Ds
game.desc: In Moto Racer DS, the player races motorcycles in various settings in order to complete the game. The game has races on both dirt and paved roads, and contains a number of different game modes: Moto GP, Traffic, Supercross, and Freestyle. Moto GP makes up the core of the game, where the player races against the computer in a series of different races on pavement. A championship mode inside of Moto GP places the player in a tournament where to advance, they are required to place at a certain level. Multiple people can play each other in races through the multiplayer function in Moto GP.

game.name: Mr Bean
game.desc: Le jeu d'action/plates-formes Mr Bean sur DS se décompose en 12 niveaux. L'histoire, elle, évoque le terrible kidnapping de Nounours que vous ne pourrez récupérer qu'après avoir payé la rançon de 1000 biscuits pour chat.

game.name: Mr. Driller - Drill Spirits
game.desc: Mr. Driller, experienced with the drill, much use his abilities to dig beneath the Earth's crust in a race to the finish in order to save the day. Dangerous traps await as you dig through the puzzle layout to the goal, and be careful of Mr. Driller's air

game.name: Mtv Fan Attack
game.desc: Dans MTV Fan Attack sur DS, c'est vous la star ! Incarnez une célébrité déchaînée, multipliez les excès et faites grimper votre cote de popularité. Mais attention à la rançon de la gloire : vos fans vous pourchassent dans le monde entier. Trouvez le moyen de leur échapper sans pour autant vous faire complètement oublier ! Parcourez les plus grandes capitales de la jet-set à travers 28 niveaux à l'humour décalé.

game.name: Mushroom Men - Rise of the Fungi
Music Monstars - The Ultimate Music Machine
game.desc: Music Monstars sur DS est un jeu de rythme permettant d'accomplir le rêve incarné de toutes et tous... Devenir une Star. Faites évoluer votre groupe de monstres, des débuts modestes dans le garage à la tournée mondiale. Le jeu propose un choix exhaustif de 20 instruments (guitare, batterie, synthétiseur, basse, violon...) pour jouer et chanter sur des musiques variées : de Queen à Tokyo Hotel en passant par Kylie Minogue ou Britney Spears.

game.name: MX vs ATV Reflex
game.desc: MX vs ATV Reflex est un jeu de courses sur Nintendo DS. Il offre une grande variété d'épreuves, au guidon de motos et de quads mais également au volant de 4x4 et de monster trucks. Il propose aussi une jouabilité remaniée sur deux-roues, notamment en ce qui concerne la prise de virages et la gestion des bosses. Enfin, un mode multi à quatre joueurs donne lieu à des affrontements entre amis.

game.name: Mx Vs. Atv Untamed
game.desc: An update from MX vs. ATV Unleashed, Untamed has some of the classic features along with some new ones as well. There are 250 cc and 550 cc bikes and four ATV models, but also monster trucks, offroad dune buggys and trophy trucks. Players can pull off insane stunts and compete in six different racing series (Supercross, Nationals, Opencross, Supermoto, Freestyle and Rally) or in the X-Cross, a tournament of all the series wrapped into one, plus sponsorships can be acquired: good performances have the player receive better bikes. It also features Crash Camera, a super slow-mo breakdown of accidents and crashes, similar to MotorStorm. Some mini-games have been included as well, including ATV hockey, Monster Truck Smash and Tag to name a few. The online mode has the player compete against other competitors. The gameplay is very similar to the console systems, certain buttons for gas, brakes while the Wii remote can be used as well. The DS and PSP versions are almost similar. While the DS has few vehicles and only has a championship mode unlike the many series in the major console versions, it contains ten exclusive tracks and three stadiums. The PSP version is almost similar, but has different series from the consoles: Race, One on One, Time Attack, Stunt Challenge, Stunt Race, Hang-Time, Combo Challenge, Flag Challenge. It also has the X-Cross tournament, but it is named the MX vs. ATV World Tour instead. Games can be played against friends using Wi-Fi.
game.developer: Endgame Studios Pty. Ltd., Tantalus Interactive Pty.

game.name: My Baby - Boy
game.desc: My Baby Boy sur DS propose de devenir un parent virtuel. Occupez-vous de votre bambin virtuel et faites en sorte qu'il ne manque de rien, ni qu'il lui arrive quelque chose. Le stylet et le micro de la console sont mis à contribution et prennent part à l'éducation de votre poupon qui s'étale sur 14 mois. En bonus, il est possible de débloquer le bébé fille pour recommencer le titre.

game.name: My Baby - Girl
game.desc: My Baby Girl sur DS propose de devenir un parent virtuel. Occupez-vous de votre bambin virtuel et faites en sorte qu'il ne manque de rien, ni qu'il lui arrive quelque chose. Le stylet et le micro de la console sont mis à contribution et prennent part à l'éducation de votre poupon qui s'étale sur 14 mois. En bonus, il est possible de débloquer le bébé garçon pour recommencer le titre.

game.name: My Baby 3 And Friends
game.desc: My Baby 3 & Friends sur Nintendo DS vous invite à prendre en main votre bébé afin de le préparer au monde qui l'attend. Vous devrez ainsi le nourrir, vous amuser avec lui, lui apprendre plusieurs choses via des jeux d'éveil, etc. En outre, vous pourrez lui acheter différents vêtements, redécorer sa chambre et faire en sorte qu'il se fasse des amis en allant avec lui au parc ou à la piscine.

game.name: My Boyfriend
game.desc: Real Stories : Amoureux pour la Vie sur DS fait partie d'une gamme de jeux permettant de faire vivre nombre d'aventures et d'expériences à toutes les filles. A travers de nombreux mini-jeux, vivez les plus belles rencontres et faites de votre Don-Juan un Prince Charmant... pour la vie !

game.name: My Dog Coach : Understand Your Dog with Cesar Millan
My Dress-up
game.desc: My Dress-Up is a fashion game for girls on the NDS. The game is played with the DS on its side like a book. It features from over 600 customisable items of clothing. These are split into 9 different categories that include shoes, trousers, tops, dresses and hats. The game also features a T-Shirt creation mode where players are able to make customs tops using unlocked tops and designs. Fancy Dress items can also be unlocked so you can dress your friends up as Fairies, Princesses or even something scary for Halloween. Players are able create over 60 friends and save up to 96 different outfits. The game is part of the My Games series and features the My Games chat feature that enables players to connect with My Make-Up and My Secret Diary for chat sessions. Photos from My Make-Up can also be sent to My Dress-Up to ‘finish the make over’. The game has 9 languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Finnish, Norwegian, Swedish and Danish.

game.name: My Farm Around The World
game.desc: My Farm around the World sur DS est une simulation d'élevage. Si les traditionnels cochons, poules et vaches ne sont plus assez dépaysants, le jeu permet de changer de continent. L'Asie, l'Afrique et l'Australie sont autant de champs d'élevage mis à disposition du joueur afin de diversifier à foison la faune.

game.name: My Friends
game.desc: My Friends est un jeu communautaire sur Nintendo DS. Ce titre propose au joueur de se faire des amis via le mode online. Sorte de Facebook pour les plus jeunes, le soft est centré autour de six environnements dans lesquels les avatars, customisables, peuvent se rencontrer, échanger des cadeaux, ou participer à des mini-jeux.

game.name: My Frogger Toy Trials
game.desc: Team up with Frogger in an all new adventure. Frogger is back but he is not alone. Take on the role of Frogger and the Hero. Control the Hero in the Adventure Map and use Frogger to solve puzzles with the touch pad and microphone. The Hero can also provide Frogger with helpful items such as health and power-ups. Tobi Inc. has created the "Toy Pet", where kids can create a toy pet with a will of its own. All the kids have to do is draw their ideal pet and within a few weeks their toy pet is delivered. Tobi Inc. is holding a competition for the best designed pet, which the Hero and Frogger decide to join. The winner of the competition will be granted one wish that can make all their dreams come true.

game.name: My Happy Kitchen
game.desc: My Happy Kitchen sur DS est une simulation de cuisine à destination des plus jeunes. A l'aide du stylet, il faudra aider Lisa à préparer toutes sortes de plats afin qu'elle ait une chance de remporter un jour le concours de cuisine d'Happy Town. On pourra apprendre de nombreuses recettes mais aussi jouer à quelques mini-jeux durant les rares temps libres de notre petite héroïne.

game.name: My Japanese Coach : Learn to Speak Japanese
My Little Flufties
game.desc: My Little Flufties is a 3D life simulator in the line of Tamagochi. Aimed at children aged 5-9, gamers can choose between 5 imaginary creatures. You must nourish, wash, educate and amuse the creatures to keep the game going. The fairy-like 3D world contains several attractions like swings and slides. Next to that, there are also 5 mini-games available in the game: 1. Mole-o-matic: jump on the head of the moles to stun them. 2. Shoot the balloons: shoot with a peashooter to pop coloured balloons. 3. Fish-o-matic: catch fish with a fishing net. 4. Hopscotch: jump on the good squares to advance. 5. Find the Tweet-Tweet: find 4 birds hidden in the game's world. The game uses a full 3D engine but with a traditional drawing style, similar to Okami.

game.name: My Make-Up
game.desc: My Make-Up is a cosmetic simulation game designed for girls on the Nintendo DS. The game enables players to create their own friends in the game and give them makeovers. Friends will also send messages to the player and ask for certain makeovers for different events. The players are able to apply lipstick, blusher, eye shadow, mascara and change the hairstyles and colour. The fancy dress party requests lets the player paint the entire face. There is a reference image for the player to follow but they are free to create whatever they want. Photos of makeovers can be saved into a photo album and can be send to other players via Nintendo Wireless Communications. Another multiplayer option is the makeover party where players swap characters and perform makeovers. The game is part of the My Games series and features the My Games chat feature that enables players to connect with My Dress-Up and My Secret Diary for chat sessions. The game has 9 languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Finnish, Norwegian, Swedish and Danish.

game.name: My Pet - Zoo Vet
game.desc: My Pet : Zoo Vet est un jeu de simulation sur DS. Le joueur se glisse dans la peau d'un vétérinaire d'un parc zoologique. Vous devez prendre soin, nourrir, et faire grandir différents animaux, des plus petits aux plus massifs. Visitez les différentes zones du zoo, avec notamment la parc aquatique et le monde des oiseaux.

game.name: My Pet Beauty Salon
game.desc: My Pet : Beauty Salon est un jeu de simulation/gestion sur Nintendo DS. La DS pousse encore plus loin le concept du jeu animalier avec ce titre qui vous propose de mettre en place les installations les plus luxueuses pour vos animaux de compagnie.

game.name: My Pet Hotel 2
game.desc: My Pet Hotel 2 sur DS vous place à la tête d'un établissement qui a pour fonction de guérir et de s'occuper d'animaux en tout genre. Les clients vous laissent leurs petits protégés, poissons, chats, chiens. S'ils sont satisfaits de vos prestations, ils n'hésiteront pas à parler de vous et vous accueillerez des animaux de plus en plus gros, comme des chevaux.

game.name: My Pet Shop
game.desc: My Pet Shop est un jeu de gestion sur DS qui vous propose d'ouvrir un magasin d'animaux afin de les offrir aux habitants de la ville de Green Town. A vous d'aider les clients de l'animalerie en accomplissant diverses tâches comme trouver des animaux, s'en occuper, les soigner. Tout ça en vous amusant avec vos petits protégés.

game.name: My Secret World By Imagine
game.desc: My Secret World is a diary for girls in which they can also play games. It serves as a diary in which users can take notes and also plan events using a calendar. Creativity can be expressed with 500 items with which to decorate pages which need to be unlocked first. Using Wi-Fi players can chat with other players and trade avatar items and gifts. The game includes personality quizzes and three other mini-games to play with friends. In Copycat the player must replicate a sticker collage. Another mini-game has the players inflate balloons using the microphone.

game.name: My Spanish Coach - Level 1
game.desc: Mon Coach Personnel : J'Améliore mon Espagnol sur DS vous permet de perfectionner votre maîtrise de la langue grâce à une série d'exercices évolutifs se calquant sur votre niveau. Apprenez à écrire et reconnaître plus de 16 500 mots que vous pourrez par la suite réutiliser dans des conversations au quotidien. Surveillez votre progression grâce à votre coach virtuel qui saura vous motiver afin de continuer votre apprentissage.

game.name: My Spanish Coach - Level 1
game.desc: Mon Coach Personnel : J'Améliore mon Espagnol sur DS vous permet de perfectionner votre maîtrise de la langue grâce à une série d'exercices évolutifs se calquant sur votre niveau. Apprenez à écrire et reconnaître plus de 16 500 mots que vous pourrez par la suite réutiliser dans des conversations au quotidien. Surveillez votre progression grâce à votre coach virtuel qui saura vous motiver afin de continuer votre apprentissage.

game.name: My Stop Smoking Coach With Allen Carr Easyway - Quit For Good
My Vet Practice - In Australia
game.desc: ¡Bienvenido a la naturaleza salvaje de Australia! Tu trabajo consistirá en alimentar y dar cariño a los animales salvajes australianos y así conseguir que se recuperen. Trata a los animales enfermos y heridos sobre el terreno o llévalos a tu refugio. Coge tu todoterreno y ve en busca de animales que necesiten tu ayuda. Encuentra crías de animales perdidas y cuida de ellas hasta que puedas devolverlas a la naturaleza. ¡Haz las maletas para embarcarte en esta emocionante aventura en 3D! ¡Los animales de Australia te necesitan! Cuida de animales salvajes y exóticos: canguros, koalas, numbats, vombátidos, dingos, caballos salvajes y muchos más. Una gran variedad de tareas te están esperando: curar animales enfermos, rescatar a crías abandonadas y mimarlas, entre otras muchas actividades. Utiliza el dinero que ganes para ampliar tu refugio. Convierte las monedas de juego en dinero en el juego.

game.name: My Vet Practice - In the Country
My Weight Loss Coach - Improve Your Health
My Word Coach - Develop Your Vocabulary
game.desc: Mon Coach Personnel : J'enrichis mon Vocabulaire sur DS vous permet de réduire vos fautes d'orthographe tout en vous amusant. La cartouche vous propose un programme d'entraînement personnalisé, adapté à votre niveau avec des exercices ludiques pour s'entraîner et s'amuser autour de plus de 16 500 mots accompagnés de leurs définitions. Un suivi de votre progression selon les objectifs que vous vous fixez est proposé de même qu'un mode multijoueur pour défier vos amis !

game.name: MySims - Agents
game.desc: In MySims Agents players take on the role of a special agent hired to foil the sinister plans of Morcubus, lord of the criminal underworld. By recruiting different MySims, each with their own special characteristics, players can build up their very own crime-busting dream team. From tracking footprints and using forensics to picking locks, hacking into computers, following leads and collecting clues, players must rely on their wits, skills and trusty gadgets to piece together the clues to solve the mystery. Jump aboard the jet to reach an ancient temple, a spooky mansion or an icy mountaintop chalet in search of clues that lead players closer to the sinister Morcubus. Return from the adventure with cool treasures that players can use to construct and customize their headquarters and make it their own.

game.name: MySims - Kingdom
game.desc: Take the Kingdom with you! MySims Kingdom on Nintendo DS adds a new chapter to the saga, challenging you to help the King thwart the plans of evil in a far flung corner of the Kingdom. Many new activities and mini-games are included to help you persuade the King that your island is the ultimate royal destination.

game.name: MySims - Party
game.desc: MySims Party lets you and your friends throw down with the MySims. Up to 4 players can test their wits, quickness and skill in 40+ minigames, each hosted by a different MySim! Each of your friends and you can select a custom team of 4 characters to play the huge variety MySims Party has to offer. Outwit friends by selecting the right team who will carry the day in contests based on strength, endurance, speed and luck. Pick carefully though, the wrong team will give your friends the edge over you. Bragging rights only belong to those who choose wisely and play flawlessly! Real People. Real fun. With the MySims!

game.name: MySims : Racing
game.desc: Race into an all-new adventure with MySims Racing! Test your reflexes, strategy and skill by tricking out cars, completing challenges, and winning championships. Speed up any get-together with 4-player mode. Pick cool race-themed outfits and accessories for your MySim, save Speedville, and come race with us!

game.name: Mysims Skyheroes
game.desc: MySims SkyHeroes est un jeu d'action sur Nintendo DS. A bord d'un avion que vous aurez vous-même monté morceau par morceau, vous devez vaincre Morcubus et ses terribles escadrons. De nombreux bonus à débloquer et un mode multijoueur jouable jusqu'à quatre viennent compléter le tableau.

game.name: Myst
game.desc: You have just stumbled upon a most intriguing book, a book titled Myst. You have no idea where it came from, who wrote it, or how old it is. Reading through its pages provides you with only a superbly crafted description of an island world. But it's just a book, isn't it? As you reach the end of the book, you lay your hand on a page. Suddenly your own world dissolves into blackness, replaced with the island world the pages described. Now you're here, wherever here is, with no option but to explore. Myst is a first-person point-and-click adventure where the player controls a character known as The Stranger. Magically transported into the world described in the book, he needs to explore Myst Island and solve its mysteries. The game is presented as a series of static scenes where the player acts with the environment by clicking and manipulating objects. There are no enemies and it is not possible to die. Through Myst Island, the game is further divided into mini-worlds set in different ages accessed through different books. The PSP version adds new adventure scenarios and includes widescreen support. The DS version includes a completely new age, the Rime Age, and, next to a code rewrite, includes new and re-mastered sound effects and video clips.

game.name: Mysterious Case of Dr. Jekyll & Mr Hyde
game.desc: Enigmes et objets cachés : Dr Jekyll & Mr Hyde est un jeu de réflexion du Nintendo DS. Faites un bond de quelques siècles en arrière et découvrez le Londres des années 1886. Dans le quartier de Soho un riche parlementaire vient d'être retrouvé assassiné. Il va vous falloir l'aide d'un bon médecin légiste sur cette affaire. Heureusement pour vous ce bon Dr jekyll est toujours là pour ses anciens amis.

game.name: Mystery Case Files - MillionHeir
game.desc: Phil T. Rich has gone missing!Players must find this missing millionaire by solving a series of touchscreen, hidden object puzzles on their Nintendo DS. With over a thousand items to find across 30 unique and cleverly-cluttered backgrounds, players must u

game.name: Mystery Case Files - Ravenhearst
game.desc: Dans Mystery Case Files : Ravenhearst, jeu d'objets cachés sur Nintendo DS, enfilez votre costume de détective et explorez plusieurs pièces pour découvrir des indices habilement dissimulés. Il vous faudra trouver les pages manquantes du journal d'Emma qui révéleront l'histoire troublante de Ravenhearst.

game.name: Mystery Detective
game.desc: After young Mackenzie's father died suddenly, she inherited the family detective agency. Now, with the aid of her robotic butler Cromwell and her short but helpful assistant Funghi, she sets out to earn her reputation as the Touch Detective. She'll chase down a stolen dream, search for a missing person, and more, as she attempts to become well known for her detecting skills. Touch Detective is an adventure game in the style of later Sierra adventure games such as Space Quest 6. Players navigate Mackenzie through various screens by touching the area where they want her to move. Mackenzie can interact with certain on-screen objects with another tap of the stylus - depending on the object, she may look at it, pick it up, talk to it (if it can strike up a conversation), or even touch it to see what it feels like. Mackenzie likes to feel objects to understand them, which is why she's the 'Touch' Detective. Mackenzie can also check and combine objects in her inventory. The top screen of the DS always has a close-up of Mackenzie herself. As she talks to other characters, observes objects and so forth, the top screen will display Mackenzie's thoughts - so while she may say one thing to a person ("Sure, I get it..."), she'll be thinking another ("What was that? I wasn't listening!"). It can be interesting (and sometimes insightful) to see the contrast between what Mackenzie says and what she thinks. Touch Detective features four different 'cases' for Mackenzie to tackle. After the first case is completed, players can also choose to take on the Bonus Case. In this case, there is no main story, but Mackenzie can choose to take on small requests from characters, as well as increase her Touch List, which records the feeling of particular objects in the game world.

game.name: Mystery Dungeon - Shiren the Wanderer
game.desc: The legend of the Golden Condor... from village to village and from town to town, everybody speak of it - somewhere, beyond forests and mountains, there lies an idyllic Golden Land, the land of eternal happiness. Many adventurers have tried to find their

game.name: Mystery Stories - Curse of the Ancient Spirits
Mystery Stories
game.desc: Hidden Objects : The Big Journey est un jeu d'aventure point and click sur Nintendo DS dans lequel votre but est de retrouver une multitude d'objets qui se sont perdus dans le décor et qui sont à première vue invisibles.

game.name: Mystery Stories
game.desc: Hidden Objects : The Big Journey est un jeu d'aventure point and click sur Nintendo DS dans lequel votre but est de retrouver une multitude d'objets qui se sont perdus dans le décor et qui sont à première vue invisibles.

game.name: Mystery Tales 2 - The Spirit Mask
game.desc: Mystery Tales 2 : The Spirit Mask est un jeu d'objets cachés disponible sur DS. Aidez la sorcière Mélanie Cygnes à percer le mystère d'un masque troublant. Comme d'habitude, notre but est de retrouver une série d'objets dans des décors fixes, mais un système de runes à tracer permet d'offrir quelques options supplémentaires.

game.name: Nadia Megafun Land
game.desc: Nadia Megafunland sur DS rassemble 30 attractions délirantes dans sept univers différents : Pirate land, Atomik circus, Méga arena, Poney land, Prince land, Sorcery et Ciné land. Une seule cartouche permet de défier ses amis en multijoueur. La maîtrise du stylet et du micro sont nécessaires pour devenir la reine du Megafunland.

game.name: Namco Museum DS
game.desc: A compilation of some classic games. The games included: 1. Pac-Man 2. Galaga 3. Xevious 4. Dig Dug II 5. Galaxian 6. Mappy 7. The Tower of Druaga 8. Pac-Man VS. There is a screen mode selection which allows the use of different screen combinations on the Nintendo DS. There is also wireless battles in Pac-Man VS, which features downloadable play where four players can battle.

game.name: Nancy Drew - The Deadly Secret Of Olde World Park
Nancy Drew : The Model Mysteries
game.desc: Nancy Drew : The Model Mysteries est une compilation de mini-jeux sur Nintendo DS. La célèbre enquêtrice, incarnée par le joueur, mène ses investigations sur le meurtre de Vic, fiancé de son amie Sydney. Pour résoudre ce mystère, le joueur doit passer par des jeux d'objets cachés, des puzzles et retrouver les différences entre plusieurs images.

game.name: Nancy Drew : The Mystery of the Clue Bender Society
game.desc: Nancy Drew : The Mystery of the Clue Bender Society sur DS est un jeu d'enquête dans lequel vous retrouvez la célèbre héroïne de romans policiers pour jeunes filles. Dans cette nouvelle histoire, Nancy tente d'intégrer un club privé regroupant les plus grands détectives, mais pour y arriver elle va devoir faire ses preuves en résolvant des cas riches en challenges et en rebondissements.

game.name: Nanostray 2
game.desc: Nanostray 2 is similar in gameplay to the original Nanostray, but has a few new features. You can play over thirty missions with over six different game modes to play in. You can play the Adventure Mode, which shows cut-scenes to tie into the story or you can skip the story and play Arcade mode and just go for the highest score possible. You can also play in challenge mode, completing a set of four challenges that unlocks a new simulator mode challenge, which is similar to Arcade mode, but with a different scoring system. It has sixteen massive bosses and over one hundred different types of enemies and you can change control styles, using the classic or using the left or right handed touch control. There is also a Nanogauge that fills up when you destroy multiple enemies, earning you bonus multipliers. You can play against a friend in duel mode or play in cooperative mode using multi-cards and can also upload your high scores online using the Wi-Fi connection.

game.name: Naraba World - Le Labyrinthe Des Lumières
game.desc: Naraba World : Le Labyrinthe des Lumières est un jeu de chiffres et plus précisément de calcul mental. Adapté à un jeune public, il propose au joueur d'incarner un garçon dont l'objectif est de redonner toute son énergie à l'île de Bruna. Pour ce faire, il doit enchaîner les puzzles et épreuves basées sur du calcul et ce, adapté à son âge.

game.name: Naraba World - Le Mystérieux Palais
game.desc: Naraba World : Le Mystérieux Palais est un jeu de chiffres et plus précisément de calcul mental. Adapté à un jeune public, il propose au joueur d'incarner un garçon dont l'objectif est de défier un sorcier royal qui a pétrifié le Roi et ses sujets. Pour ce faire, il doit enchaîner les puzzles et épreuves basées sur du calcul et ce, adapté à son âge.

game.name: Naruto - Ninja Council - European Version
game.desc: Naruto : Ninja Council European Version sur DS est un jeu de combat en 2D basé sur l'univers du manga de Masashi Kishimoto. Vous avez le choix parmi 20 ninjas avec leurs techniques propres que l'on découvre dans la série. Le but est d'accomplir des missions confiées par votre village afin de s'en voir confier de plus prestigieuses. Vous pouvez également jouer en multijoueur jusqu'à quatre pour des affrontements dignes du manga.

game.name: Naruto - Ninja Destiny II - European Version
game.desc: Naruto : Ninja Destiny II - European Version sur DS offre la même jouabilité que sa version japonaise (Naruto Shinobi Retsuden II) mais ce jeu de combat en 3D est agrémenté de nouveaux personnages et d'un scénario exclusif. Outre son mode Histoire, le titre offre un mode Quête à débloquer ainsi qu'un mode Combat sans-fil permettant de défier un ami via la connexion wi-fi de la DS.

game.name: Naruto - Ninja Destiny
game.desc: Naruto : Ninja Destiny sur DS est un jeu de combat en 3D se déroulant dans l'univers du célèbre manga. Parcourez le mode histoire pour débloquer des bonus, faites un saut par le mode Combat pour choisir parmi les 16 personnages, utilisez leurs techniques spécifiques et aidez-vous des objets sur l'écran tactile pour vaincre.

game.name: Naruto : Ninja Council 2 : European Version
game.desc: Naruto : Ninja Council 2 - European Version est un beat'em all basé dans l'univers du manga de Masashi Kishimoto. L'histoire correspond à l'arrivée des ninjas d'Oto no Kuni, le quartet du son, et comporte une série de niveaux piégés à traverser aux côtés des personnages emblématiques de la série.

game.name: Naruto Shippuden - Naruto vs Sasuke
game.desc: Naruto Shippuden : Naruto vs Sasuke sur DS est un jeu d'action dans lequel le gameplay est orienté à la fois plates-formes et beat'em all. Le scénario débute avec l'arrivée de Sai et Kabuto et se focalise sur la recherche de Sasuke par Naruto et ses compagnons. Il est possible de switcher librement entre les différents personnages et de recourir à des attaques combinées.

game.name: Naruto Shippuden - Ninja Council 4
game.desc: Naruto est devenu grand et revient sur DS dans un jeu de combat et d'aventure dans lequel vous pouvez mettre hors d'état de nuire vos ennemis en utilisant différents Jutsus. Naruto Shippuden : Ninja Council 4 vous propose de contrôler huit personnages dont Naruto et Rock Lee. Formez votre équipe de trois ninjas et revivez l'aventure du futur Hokage.

game.name: Natalie Brooks : Mystery at Hillcrest High
Natalie Brooks : The Treasures of the Lost Kingdom
Need for Speed - Most Wanted
game.desc: Need for Speed: Most Wanted is a racing game belonging to Need for Speed series. In the Career mode, you have to beat the 15 blacklisters in order to become the Most Wanted. For unlocking the bosses' circuits, you have to win points by winning races, avoi

game.name: Need for Speed - Nitro
game.desc: Need for Speed: Nitro brings the fun and exhilaration of high-speed racing to your Nintendo DS. It brings the Need for Speed franchise's trademark attitude and car culture with deep and thrilling gameplay. Gamers must battle through the mayhem of relentless cops master the art of drifting to gain boost at 150 mph and prove themselves across five mega cities at a gripping 60 frames per second.

game.name: Need for Speed - ProStreet
game.desc: Need for Speed ProStreet on DS is the umpteenth opus of the NFS franchise. This time, bid farewell to rivalry between gangs and bet on clashes in closed urban circuits. Tune up your crates and race into a wide variety of events to dominate the asphalt and become the pro in all categories. Need for Speed ProStreet boasts impeccable precision and impressively detailed photo-realistic graphics, effectively transporting you to the center of the action. It pushes the Autosculp technology to a new level, allowing you to directly impact your car's performance for the first time as well as personalize its appearance.Need for Speed ProStreet is a true taste of raw adrenaline and racing with consequences. Every dent, every scratch and every crumpled body panel is a battle scar, proof of your commitment and competitive mettle. With an aggressive and skilled AI system, you become immersed in an unmatched believable race experience Add in a revolutionary online mode that will redefine the meaning of competitive social play, and Need for Speed ProStreet is the ultimate formula for an emotionally charged street racing showdown.

game.name: Need for Speed - Undercover
game.desc: Need for Speed Undercover est un jeu de courses sur DS. Les poursuites avec les voitures de police sont de retour dans cet opus définitivement orienté vers l'action. L'histoire profite de la présence de la star de cinéma Maggie Q. Elle joue en effet le personnage principal dans les séquences narratives.

game.name: Need for Speed - Underground 2
game.desc: This installment in the Need for Speed series, Underground 2 is a racing game based on illicit, night time races, with the player gaining street credit, cash and access to unique tuner parts by schooling the competition. Taking place in a massive, open city, NFS Underground 2 allows players to explore the city at will, engaging random challengers and moving into the coveted Underground Racing League.
