Fast & Fun, which adds a timer to increase pressure on the player. 4. Head to Head, a two-player challenge. 5. Tournament, in which the player solves a series of puzzles increasing in difficulty from Easy to Pro. In the European version, all puzzles are localized.

game.name: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion
game.desc: Joining Raa Raa on his vocal voyage of discovery are Huffty the elephant, Topsy the giraffe, Crocky the crocodile, Zebby the zebra and Ooo Ooo the monkey. Together this merry band of friends are learning that they can have a lot more fun if they use their communication skills - sounds, gestures, facial expressions and best of all, words!

game.name: Rabbids Go Home
game.desc: Ils sont de retour ! Et cette fois, ils se sont affranchis de Rayman. The Lapins Crétins : La Grosse Aventure sur DS marque le nouveau délire des lapins crétins convaincus que leur planète d'origine n'est pas la Terre mais... la Lune. Aidez-les en amassant le plus de détritus possible pour construire une passerelle jusqu'à leur prétendue maison dans ce jeu de réflexion.

game.name: Race Driver : GRID
game.desc: GRID takes players to dramatic and beautifully realized race locations over three continents to compete in an unprecedented variety of racing events. Packed with the most powerful race cars--new and classic, circuit and drift--players will compete to conquer the most prestigious official race tracks and championships. Then they'll compete in challenging city-based competitions, road events, and urban street races.

game.name: Rainbow Islands Revolution
game.desc: Bubby and Bobby return in this Nintendo DS update to the popular arcade game, Rainbow Islands. The game takes place several years after Bubble Bobble, and the brothers now have the ability to create rainbows to destroy their enemies. However, they'll need this ability, as the residents of the seven Rainbow Islands have been imprisoned, and need to be rescued! The DS version of Rainbow Islands functions differently from the original. Your character is now floating inside a bubble on the touch screen, and the levels can be seen both on the top and touch screens. You can drag your character around the screen by touching them with the stylus, or you can drag the stylus elsewhere on-screen to create a rainbow. If you tap a drawn rainbow, it will fall down vertically, killing any enemies underneath. Finally, there are two special rainbows that can be drawn if you hold the L or R buttons, each with their own special function. Drawing a circle will create a large bubble which you can drag around the screen and hit other enemies with; while drawing a triangle will create a kind of black hole that will suck in enemies, allowing you to take them out in one go. Lastly, there is a special rainbow that can only be drawn when your 'Star Gauge' is full: when it is, this gauge can be tapped, and the player is given a short time to draw a five-pointed star (similar to the 'Healing Touch' in Trauma Center). If successful, all enemies on both screens will be destroyed. In addition to this new style of play, there is also a 'Score Mode'. In this mode, you only have one life, and must earn as many points as possible as a barrage of enemies continues to attack you. The game also has two secret characters to unlock, as well as a Versus Mode where players compete to reach the top of the level first. The special rainbows are not available in either of these modes.

game.name: Ram Racing
game.desc: Nada dice "poder" y "rendimiento", como la legendaria marca Ram. Ahora, se puede subir al volante de este vehículo estadounidense icónico y ponerlo a prueba! Elije entre numerosos modelos interesantes, seleccionalos, dale revoluciones al motor, y pone a prueba los límites de este múltiple ganador del premio "Truck of the Year".

game.name: Ratatouille
game.desc: In Disney/Pixar's animated adventure, a rat named Remy dreams of becoming a great French chef despite his family's wishes and the obvious problem of being a rat in a decidedly rodent-phobic profession. When fate places Remy in the sewers of Paris, he finds himself ideally situated beneath a restaurant made famous by his culinary hero, Auguste Gusteau. Fans will be able to relive some of the film's most thrilling moments and experience the sights, sounds and most importantly, the smells, of Paris a la Remy in this game based on the movie.

game.name: Rayman - Raving Rabbids - TV Party
game.desc: Battle your friends in more than 14 minigames that are playable with one game card. Specifically designed for the DS: Discover new and innovative ways to use the stylus, microphone and dual screen to manipulate those crazy rabbids.

game.name: Rayman : Raving Rabbids
game.desc: They've got their sights set on the world, and with Rayman the only one who could possibly stop them, he is quickly captured.

game.name: Rayman DS
game.desc: The character with no arms and no legs makes his debut on the Nintendo DS. Rayman must defeat the pirates who have enslaved his world. As Rayman, you'll travel through magical worlds where you can explore waterfalls, sea caves, and pirate hideouts. Master Rayman's special moves to progress through each challenging level. The DS's bottom screen let you monitor your progress, track your lums, and keep an eye on Rayman's health.

game.name: Rayman Raving Rabbids 2
game.desc: Ils sont de retour et ils sont encore plus débiles. Avec leur look improbable et leur cri inimitable, les Lapins Crétins font leur seconde entrée sur DS. Toujours orienté party-game, Rayman contre les Lapins encore plus Cretins propose une multitude de mini-jeux à l'image de leurs protagonistes : complètement fous.

game.name: Ready Steady Cook - The Game
game.desc: Ready, Steady, Cook: The Game, is based off of the British cooking show, in which members of the public have to cook a meal from a certain budget of random ingredients. They are split into two teams, the Red Tomatoes and the Green Peppers and both have a celebrity chief to help them out. After they have cooked the meal, the audience then votes for who they thought did the best meal. The game also follows the same routine, but lacks any celebrity appearances.

game.name: Real Adventures - Wild Horses - The Quest For The Golden Horse
Real Crimes - Jack The Ripper
game.desc: Real Crimes : Jack the Ripper est un jeu de réflexion et d'objets cachés disponible sur Nintendo DS. Au coeur d'une cité londonienne plongée dans la terreur, vous devrez résoudre les énigmes auxquelles vous serez confronté pour mettre un terme aux atrocités du fameux Eventreur.

game.name: Real Crimes - The Unicorn Killer
game.desc: Real Crimes: The Unicorn Killer sur DS est un jeu de recherche d'objets cachés. Basé sur une histoire vraie, celui-ci propose de traquer Ira Einhorn, ancien militant pour la paix condamné pour le meurtre de sa petite amie. Le joueur incarne Jennifer Lourdes, détective qui doit rechercher et appréhender l'assassin en cavale en Europe. Celle-ci est doit mener l'enquête afin de trouver des preuves et objets en tous genres menant au tueur.

game.name: Real Soccer 2008
game.desc: Real Football 2008 sur DS est une simulation footballistique sur DS. Retrouvez plus de 70 équipes nationales, une grande sélection de championnats dont l'Allemagne, l'Angleterre, la France, l'Espagne ainsi qu'une vingtaine d'autres. Un mode multijoueur permet de jouer jusqu'à quatre joueurs à condition toutefois que chacun possède sa cartouche.

game.name: Real Soccer 2009
game.desc: Real Football 2009 sur DS est une simulation footballistique qui comprend plus de 200 clubs et équipes et permet de jouer 5 grands championnats européens et de nombreuses coupes continentales et internationales. Le joueur contrôle ses poulains à l'aide de la croix directionnelle de la console mais peut dessiner des gestes techniques sur l'écran tactile pour enchaîner les dribbles. Enfin, la cartouche propose un mode multijoueur en multi-cartes où 4 utilisateurs peuvent s'affronter.

game.name: Real Stories - Best Friends - My Horse
game.desc: Real Stories : Mon Poulain, Mon Cheval fait partie d'une gamme de jeux permettant de faire vivre nombre d'aventures et d'expériences à toutes les filles. C'est ici en compagnie de plus beaux chevaux que le jeu va emmener les joueuses -et les joueurs-, pour remplir de nombreuses épreuves (brosser votre bête, la chevaucher dans différents environnements, etc).

game.name: Real Stories - Passion 4 Fashion
game.desc: Real Stories : Fashionshop sur Nintendo DS transforme la joueuse en patronne de boutique fashion à New-York. Il faudra relooker les demoiselles en quête de la tenue ultime pour leurs soirées mondaines. Vous pourrez décider de leur look en piochant parmi 1600 vêtements et accessoires, et trouver la coiffure, le maquillage et la manucure appropriée.

game.name: Red Bull BC One
game.desc: Red Bull BC One is a Nintendo DS game based on a break dancing competition with the same name. It's a mix of a rhythm action game and a puzzle game where players get to compete against different break dancers from around the world. Before starting the game players gets to design their own dancer. This is done in the dressing room where the players can customize their characters in different categories. It's possible to choose different body styles, hairstyles and clothing. Playing the career mode will let players unlock more clothing that their character can use. The actual gameplay consists of performing different dance moves. These moves are shown on the top screen and are done by playing a simple connect the dots puzzle game on the lower screen. Dots of different colour are shown across the screen and the player has to create shapes by connecting at least three dots of the same colour using the stylus. For each turn the player need to create as many shapes as possible before the time runs out. There is also special star shaped dots. If these are included in a shape the player will perform special moves and gain more points. It's also possible to create perfects, which is the largest possible shape of the turn. By creating multiple perfects the player will gain multipliers that will multiply the overall score. There's a couple of game modes. The main one is the career mode where players get to battle against different b-boys with the goal to reach the final of the Red Bull BC One competition. There's also the free mode where players can improve their scores of a specific battle. The game also has a multiplayer mode where players can compete against friends in a one-on-one battle via multi card play.

game.name: Resident Evil - Deadly Silence
game.desc: Take the core story and gameplay of the original Resident Evil in all its blood soaked glory, and add a touch screen twist. That's Deadly Silence, a new and updated version of the original horror title.The story is much the same as the entire Resident Evi

game.name: Retro Arcade Toppers
game.desc: Retro Arcade Toppers est une compilation de jeux arcade sur Nintendo DS. Vous avez le choix entre un casse-briques, un puzzle-game et un shoot'em up pour tenter d'établir les plus gros high-scores.

game.name: Rhapsody - A Musical Adventure
game.desc: This is a remake of the original PSone game. While this version still sports the same storyline it features new additions and tweaks to the gameplay to suit the DS.The player uses the D-pad or the stylus to move their character and using the "X" button t

game.name: Rhythm 'n Notes
game.desc: Rhythm'N Notes sur DS est un petit titre qui propose un apprentissage musical simplifié à base de mini-jeux. Apprendre à reconnaître des notes puis des accords en les écoutant, maîtriser le sens du rythme, voilà le programme qu'on nous propose à travers de multiples exercices qui se dérouleront sur des percussions et un piano virtuels.

game.name: Rhythm Paradise
game.desc: Get ready to feel the rhythm! Rhythm Heaven is a game based entirely around musical rhythm and timing. The game is a collection of games based around a song, where the player must perform actions in time to the music to successfully complete the game. All games are based around the simple motions of tapping, sliding and flicking the stylus. As each game varies from each other, at the start of each game, you're given a brief tutorial to get the hang of how the game you'll be playing works. Tasks for games include (but are not limited to) flicking to construct machinery, releasing the stylus at the right time to belt out a loud note, sliding to rub a lizard's tail in time to a mating dance beat, tapping to gulp down dumplings, tapping and flicking to harvest vegetables and get rid of moles, and more. After every four games, a special "remix" game appears, which combines the previous games into a hectic mix, where you never know what will be up next.

game.name: Ridge Racer Ds
game.desc: Ridge Racer DS is a remake of Ridge Racer 64 with some changes and additions. All the same levels are there, but there are plenty of new cars, including Namco- and Nintendo-themed vehicles. There is also some new music that was not in the N64 version. The Touch Screen on the Nintendo DS is put to use all throughout the game, including navigation through every menu and even a revolutionary new control where the player steers the steering wheel with the stylus or thumb ring. Another addition to the game is the use of the Nintendo DS's Wi-Fi capabilities. Using wireless communication, up to 6 players can race against each other. In fact, up to 6 players can play with a Game Card in only one of the systems. The other 5 players don't even need the game. There will be more items, such as cars, available to play with if all of the systems have a Ridge Racer DS Game Card in though. So there is an advantage to having multiple Game Cards.

game.name: Rijexamen Training 2008 - Code de la Route 2008
game.desc: Devenez un as du volant et du guidon grâce à Code de la Route Auto-Moto Edition 2008 sur DS. Le solo comprend le mode Examen, une épreuve de 40 questions tirées d'une base de données qui en comprend 800. Des questions sur l'ASSR sont également disponibles et à la fin de chaque épreuve un moniteur vient mettre en avant vos points forts et vos faiblesses. Travaillez équitablement et vous aurez vos chances pour obtenir le petit papier tant convoité par les conducteurs en herbe.

game.name: Ringling Bros. Circus Friends - Asian Elephants
game.desc: Ringling Bros. Circus Friends : Asian Elephants est un jeu de gestion sur Nintendo DS. Vous devrez vous occuper de nombreux pachydermes en leur donnant à manger, en leur faisant faire de l'exercice, en faisant en sorte qu'ils ne s'ennuient jamais, etc.

game.name: Rio
game.desc: Rio sur Nintendo DS est un jeu de rythme utilisant l'écran tactile. Il est inspiré du film du même nom qui raconte l'histoire de Blu, le dernier perroquet de son espèce, qui décide de quitter le Minnesota pour s'aventurer au coeur du Brésil, à Rio de Janeiro.

game.name: Rise of the Guardians
game.desc: Adapté du film d'animation du même nom, le titre vous propose d'emmener les héros dans leur quête pour retrouver la foi des enfants face au vil Pitch. On gagne de nouvelles techniques en montant de niveau.

game.name: Roary - La Voiture De Course
game.desc: Destiné à un jeune public, Roary : La Voiture de Course est l'adaptation de la série animée éponyme sur Nintendo DS. On y trouve plusieurs mini-jeux musicaux, d'arcade mais aussi des défis faisant appel à votre logique et à vos réflexes.

game.name: Robots
game.desc: Based on the Blue Sky film (distributed by Fox) of the same name, Robots takes players on an adventure to save Robot city. When Rodney Copperbottom travels to Robot City to meet Big Weld, the famous inventor, he finds that something is wrong. Big Weld is missing and the evil Ratchet has taken over Big Weld Industries. With the help of his friends the Rusties, Rodney puts an end to Ratchet's villainous ways and restores order to the city. Robots uses a unique perspective that combines 2D side-scrolling with 3D views. The game takes the player to locations from the movie like Robot City, Big Weld's Mansion, the Outmode, and Madame Gasket's Chop Shop. Using the invention mode, players build and upgrade Rodney's weapons including the wrench, scrap gun, electro zapper, and magno grenade. With a combination of navigation, jumping, and combat skills, players can make their way though the world of Robots and bring an end to Ratchet's tyranny. In addition to the main story line, players will find robots in need all over the city. The parts these poor robots are missing can be found hidden in the numerous maps and returning the correct part rewards the player with power-ups and weapon upgrades. All of the maps are interconnected, so players can easily find their way back to a previous area to uncover additional secrets.The maps are connected with a transit ball mini-game, just like the transit system in the movie. The DS version of the game features a map that can be annotated by the player, a unique 3D version of the transit ball game that utilizes the stylus for control, and 3D menus. In addition to the new features, the DS also includes high resolution maps that include more detail than the GBA version.

game.name: Rock Band 3
game.desc: Rock Band 3 sur Nintendo DS est un jeu de rythme qui vous invite à créer votre propre groupe et à interpréter différents morceaux. En sautant d'une piste à l'autre, le joueur peut suivre les pistes des différents instruments ou joindre une partie multijoueur dans laquelle chacun choisira son arme.

game.name: Rock Revolution
game.desc: Like the console versions, Rock Revolution for the DS simulates the various instruments of a band. Songs can be played using a guitar (strum on the touch screen), bass (pluck the right string at the right time), drums (tap the right drum at the right time), and vocals (sing into the DS's microphone). Each of the 20 tracks can be played with any instrument. Included is a Rock School, which is a tutorial for the four instruments, a free play mode, a media player, a multiplayer mode, allowing either competitive or cooperative play, and a career mode. The career mode starts you with no money and a garage band. Earn money by playing in gigs, and spend it on better equipment. Some gigs have special rules, like concerts which play two songs in a row.

game.name: Rollin' Rascals
game.desc: Rollin' Rascals est un puzzle-game sur DS qui vous demande de réunir des animaux identiques deux par deux. Avec le stylet, vous pouvez faire rouler des pandas, des cochons ou encore des chiens sur l'écran tactile, votre objectif étant de les rassembler par paire. 4 modes de jeux et plusieurs niveaux de difficulté différents permettent de prolonger la durée de vie.

game.name: Rooms : The Main Building
game.desc: Rooms : The Main Building sur DS est un jeu de réflexion dans lequel vous devez sortir de pièces dans lesquelles vous êtes enfermé en faisant coulisser les salles à la manière d'un taquin. Le joueur doit se servir des objets mis à sa disposition pour passer d'une salle à l'autre jusqu'à la sortie. A noter qu'il est possible créer ses propres niveaux et de les échanger avec d'autres joueurs.

game.name: Runaway - A Twist Of Fate
game.desc: Runaway : A Twist of Fate sur DS constitue le troisième chapitre des aventures de Brian Basco et Gina Timmins. Ce célèbre jeu d'aventure en point'n click se base sur des décors façon dessin animé, des personnages atypiques et des dialogues amusants. Cet épisode ne constitue pas la suite du deuxième volet mais bien une histoire à part, sans pour autant négliger les clins d'oeil et références aux opus précédents.

game.name: Runaway : The Dream of the Turtle
game.desc: At the end of Runaway Brian and Gina finally had the time to be together on a tropical island called Mala, but the good times don't last long. One day they decide to go on a trip and fly over the island in a plane. Everything goes well until the engines s

game.name: Rune Factory - A Fantasy Harvest Moon
game.desc: As a wanderer in a town called Kardia, you are discovered by a mysterious girl named "Mist". She, seeing potential in your skills, offers you a house to live in as long a you work and maintain the farmland.As in other "Harvest Moon" titles, you grow and m

game.name: Rune Factory 2 - A Fantasy Harvest Moon
game.desc: Dans Rune Factory 2 : A Fantasy Harvest Moon, vous incarnez un jeune garçon qui a perdu la mémoire et qui se trouve recueilli par Mist, une fermière qui lui offre le gîte et le couvert contre son aide pour les travaux agricoles. Le héros développe ses capacités dans la capture et l'élevage d'animaux. Mais cette vie ne semble guère lui convenir. Et si sa destinée était ailleurs ?

game.name: Safecracker - The Ultimate Puzzle Adventure
game.desc: Safecracker sur DS est un jeu de réflexion dont l'objectif est de percer des codes de coffres-forts. Vous êtes engagé par une famille richissime pour retrouver un testament dans une magnifique villa. Récemment décédé, le patriarche à l'étrange sens de l'humour a rangé le document dans l'un des 35 coffres de la propriété. Ouvrez-les un par un jusqu'à la découverte du précieux sésame.

game.name: Samantha Swift and the Hidden Roses of Athena
Sarah - Die Hueterin des Einhorns
game.desc: La Licorne Magique sur DS est un jeu d'aventure dans lequel vous incarnez une jeune fille devant rassembler des éclats de cristaux afin de repousser les forces du mal. Il lui faut également s'occuper de la ferme léguée par son oncle mais aussi d'une licorne trouvée devant chez elle. Gérez les tâches fermières, prenez soin du cheval à corne, apprenez des sorts, explorez quatre mondes pour trouver les pierres précieuses et rétablissez l'ordre dans le pays de Sarah.

game.name: Sarah - Die Hueterin des Einhorns
game.desc: La Licorne Magique sur DS est un jeu d'aventure dans lequel vous incarnez une jeune fille devant rassembler des éclats de cristaux afin de repousser les forces du mal. Il lui faut également s'occuper de la ferme léguée par son oncle mais aussi d'une licorne trouvée devant chez elle. Gérez les tâches fermières, prenez soin du cheval à corne, apprenez des sorts, explorez quatre mondes pour trouver les pierres précieuses et rétablissez l'ordre dans le pays de Sarah.

game.name: Scene It Twilight
game.desc: Scene It ? Twilight sur Nintendo DS est un quiz cinématographique qui regroupe des centaines de questions portant sur les films de Catherine Hardwicke. Attendez-vous aussi à décortiquer des extraits vidéo de la série Twilight et à reconstituer des puzzles basés sur des images des films.

game.name: Science Papa
game.desc: Science Papa est un jeu éducatif sur DS proposant de réaliser une trentaine d'expériences scientifiques sous l'oeil attentif et avisé d'un professeur. Plusieurs modes de jeu permettent d'apprendre la science en s'amusant avec même un mode multijoueur pour défier un ami.

game.name: Scooby-Doo! : Unmasked
game.desc: Dans le jeu de plates-formes Scooby-Doo! : Démasqué sur Nintendo DS, Jed, le cousin de Fred, a disparu. Ses Animatronics sont devenus incontrôlables et attaquent tout sur leur passage. Scooby-Doo et sa célèbre équipe partent à sa recherche et vont tenter d'élucider cette mystérieuse disparition.

game.name: Scooby-Doo! : Who's Watching Who
game.desc: Mystery Inc. are the stars of a hit reality TV show about ghost hunting. However, when rival show team GSI (Ghost Scene Investigators) question Mystery Inc's "unscientific" methods of ghost detection, the challenge is on to see who can debunk the most ghosts! Scooby, Shaggy and the gang will travel cross-country visiting spooky locations and unmasking classic ghosts. Are their "old-fashioned" methods up to the challenge?

game.name: Scribblenauts
game.desc: Scribblenauts is a side-scrolling action game based on puzzles. The goal is to have the character Maxwell overcome obstacles by summoning objects based on a dictionary of more than 20.000 words, partly based on the concept of the real-life game Mad Libs. This is done by writing an object's name on the touchscreen, letter by letter. When the word is recognized, the object spawns in the world, where it can be manipulated or act on its own. This leads to an endless amount of possibilities to progress through the game. For instance, when an item needs to be retrieved from a tree, you could summon a ladder to get it out, a football to hit it, or just a helicopter or an albatross to fly over there. There are also more bizarre examples, such as summoning a time machine, going back in time to fetch a dinosaur egg, make it hatch and then use it in the future to defeat an army of robot zombies. The list also includes weapons, historical people, and even references to popular cultures and internet memes. Profanity and trademarked objects are not recognized. There is also a spelling checker included to offer suggestions. This game is a logical sequel to the gameplay mechanics of Drawn to Life, an earlier title by 5TH Cell, relying on the same concept of emergent gameplay, where the actual game is more of a toolbox, shaped through the player's interaction and different in each session. During the game Maxwell needs to collect starites. To do this, two to four objects are often summoned at the same time. There are general, slow puzzle levels, but also faster action levels filled with enemies, platforms, switches and traps. Often, the summoned objects and characters need to interact with each other. Players can earn "merits" for not using weapons in a level for instance and finding a more creative approach. When a level is completed, a silver star is awarded and the Free Play mode for the level is unlocked. When the level is then completed three more times, using a different approach each time, a gold star is provided. By solving puzzles, Ollars are awarded, the game's currency. It can be exchanged for different avatars or visual changes. The game includes a level editor and support for Wi-Fi to share the levels. The existing levels can also be edited and the way certain summoned objects interact with each other can also be modified.

game.name: Scurge - Hive
game.desc: Scurge Hive sur DS est un jeu d'action dans lequel vous incarnez la chasseuse de prime Jénosa Arma, envoyée pour enquêter sur l'émission de détresse d'un laboratoire étudiant un organisme terriblement virulent, le "Scurge". Armée de gants à projectiles top-secrets et d'une combinaison de combat, elle doit affronter plus de 50 sortes de créatures pour sauvegarder la technologie et empêcher le "Scurge" de se répandre.

game.name: Sea Monsters - A Prehistoric Adventure
game.desc: Sea Monsters is based on the National Geographic CGI documentary of the same name, where earth's underwater world from millions of years ago is portrayed as a dangerous environment with different kinds of predators keeping the ecosystem intact.Players tak

game.name: Secret Files - Tunguska
game.desc: Nina Kalenkow, a beautiful woman living in Berlin, Germany, reaches her father's workplace at the Museum one night just to find out he has disappeared without a trace. After finding out the carelessness of the police department about the case, she then de

game.name: Secret Files 2 - Puritas Cordis
game.desc: Secret Files 2 : Puritas Cordis est la suite directe de l'aventure point'n click Secret Files : Tungunska sur DS. Nous retrouvons l'héroïne Nina ainsi que Max qui enquêtent cette fois sur un prophète annonçant la fin des temps et sur des catastrophes naturelles survenant un peu partout dans le monde. Intrigues croisées, énigmes et réflexion sont au rendez-vous.

game.name: Secret Flirts
game.desc: Que toutes les adolescentes en quête d'amour se rassurent, Secret Flirts est la cartouche DS qui leur permettra de rencontrer l'élu de leur coeur. Plusieurs activités les attendent pour simuler la vie de tous les jours dont des sorties entre copines, des virées aux magasins ou bien sûr des rencontres avec les garçons.

game.name: Secrets of the Titanic 1912-2012
game.desc: Les Secrets du Titanic 1912 - 2012 est un jeu d'objets cachés disponible sur Nintendo DS. Vous incarnez Eva, une jeune femme faisant une croisière avec sa famille et découvrant un médaillon qui lui permet de voyager dans le temps. A intervalles réguliers, on la retrouve dans la peau d'Elizabeth, sa grand-mère, partie en voyage sur le Titanic.

game.name: Sega Superstars Tennis
game.desc: Sega's many franchises come together for a tennis tournament spanning the varied worlds created by them in the last twenty years. Sixteen characters over fifteen different Sega game series are represented, as are ten different courts based on those same franchises. Exhibition and Tournament modes are included in the game. The first is a simple vs mode, whereas the tournament allows the player to unlock new characters and courts over a series of matches and other challenges, all related to tennis but also drawing heavily on the video game represented. Singles and doubles can be played by either humans or AI, with the player being able to choose his or her doubles partner. Version differences are notable, as the Wii game misses out on online play in exchange for three different control modes utilising the Wii Remote (much like in Wii Sports tennis, the Wii Remote and nunchuck or the Classic Controller. Online play is included in the 360 and PS3 versions. Each character has a special move to aid them with their tennis match, relating to the character. For example, Beat from Jet Set Radio has a power that allows the ball to grind against the net and shoot off at a random point, making it difficult to return. Minigames are included as both one-offs and part of the tournament. These include a Target-hitting game, The House of the Dead zombie killing game (hit moving zombies around a court before the timer runs out), a Space Harrier game, a Puyo Puyo game, a Virtua Cop game and a Samba De Amigo-related game.

game.name: Seigneur Des Anneaux - La Quête D'aragorn, Le
game.desc: Le Seigneur des Anneaux : La Quête d'Aragorn sur Nintendo DS est un jeu d'aventure à la troisième personne. Le soft vous propose de revivre l'histoire et les meilleurs moments de la trilogie du Seigneur des Anneaux dans la peau d'Aragorn. De nombreux combats vous attendent, que ce soit au corps à corps à l'épée, à distance à l'aide d'arcs ou encore lors de chevauchées fantastiques.

game.name: Settlers, The
game.desc: The Settlers is a remake of The Settlers II: Veni, Vidi, Vici for the Nintendo DS. The premise of the game is set to ancient Rome, with you taking control of the Romans in the main campaign, or additionally the Vikings, Nubian and Asian empires in Free Play mode. The game works very differently from most general strategy games. Your goal is to reach the gateway at the end of each map, usually hidden amidst the enemy lines. You must build military buildings to expand your borders that you can reach the resources that are initially out of your reach. Eventually reaching the gateway to proceed onto the next level. Your city needs roads to optimize the trade routes and allow different buildings to get the resources they need for production. The game is highly based on gathering resources and optimizing the roads to provide maximal resource gathering. In example, you need a woodcutter to provide a sawmill with logs in order for the builders to build new structures and harbors to build ships for your expeditions. The game is almost a 1:1 recreation of the original Settlers II game, but it adds few new things to the game such as new music and new GUI to support the stylus.

game.name: Shamu's Deep Sea Adventures
game.desc: Shamu's Deep Sea Adventures sur DS est un jeu d'action dans lequel vous incarnez un orque. Affrontez le diabolique Kraken ainsi que Poseidon le terrible dieu de la mer. Battez-vous pour débloquer des pouvoirs spéciaux, provoquez en duel de nombreuses et redoutables créatures sous-marines et explorez la cité de l'Atlantide pour découvrir tous ses secrets.

game.name: Shaun The Sheep - Off His Head
Shaun White Snowboarding
game.desc: Shaun White Snowboarding is a snowboard racing game. To be able to win, you need to ride the way Shaun White does, meaning you have to score big tricks to gain speed boosts. You can choose up to 6 different characters and a variety of board with specifics statistics The snowboarder is entirely controlled with the stylus. Move the stylus up to ride faster and precisely control the radius of your turns with the analog touch screen. Once in the air, perform trick by drawing patterns on the touch screen. The choose your path system let you draw the path you want to ride down. Use it on four different mountains to complete races and challenges. Pick up decals on the slopes and stick them on your board to finely tune your board. Play with friends on different sets of events. You can also share and trade the decals you have collected with your friends.

game.name: Sherlock Holmes DS : The Mystery of the Mummy
game.desc: Sherlock Holmes DS : Le Mystère de la Momie est un jeu d'aventure sur Nintendo DS. Vous y jouez le rôle du maître lui-même qui va cette fois devoir faire la lumière sur une affaire de disparition à la demande sa cousine Elisabeth Montcalfe. Le tout se déroule en vue subjective et vous serez amené à résoudre différentes énigmes afin de progresser dans les nombreuses pièces du manoir.

game.name: Sherlock Holmes DS and the Mystery of Osborne Hous
Shin Megami Tensei - Devil Survivor 2
game.desc: Le cadre de Devil Survivor 2 couvre tout le pays du Japon. Il raconte l'histoire de lycéens japonais qui réalise dans un pacte leur permettant d'invoquer des démons et de combattre des créatures mystérieuses envahissant et détruisant le pays. L'intrigue peut se dérouler différemment selon les actions du joueur qui assume le rôle d'un jeune dompteur de démons silencieux impliqué dans cet incident. Devil Survivor 2 est un jeu de rôles tactique qui suit son prédécesseur, il implique de contrôler plusieurs dompteurs de démons dans leurs combats contre différents ennemis et d'acquérir de nouvelles compétences dans le processus. Le jeu a de nouveaux ajouts tels que le système de destin où le joueur peut interagir avec d'autres acteurs ainsi que les compétences raciales évolutives.

game.name: Shrek - La Fête Foraine En Délire - Mini-jeux
game.desc: Shrek : La Fête Foraine en Délire : Mini-Jeux est un party-game sur Nintendo DS. Dans ce titre, Shrek et ses amis visitent une fête foraine organisée par les 7 nains. Au programme, plus de 28 jeux différents, dont le lancer d'anneaux de Pinocchio, la Balle-grenouille, la Cloche, le tiré par les cheveux ou bien encore la Boule de poils. Les joueurs peuvent coopérer ou s'affronter en équipes, en tête-à-tête ou en défis de groupes.

game.name: Shrek - Ogres & Dronkeys
game.desc: Your ogre and dronkey are ready for an adventure! Take them out into Shrek?s fun and exciting fairytale land. Explore Shrek?s swamp, the candy-filled world of Gingyland, Dragon?s Castle and more with your favorite Shrek characters. Shrek, Donkey, Fiona and all of your fairytale favorites lend a hand to help you raise the ogres and dronkeys. Use the skills you teach them to solve wacky puzzles and overcome challenges on the adventure of their lives! Discover cool new toys on your journey into exciting new lands!

game.name: Shrek - Super Slam
game.desc: Shrek : SuperSlam sur DS est un jeu de combat reprenant l'univers déluré et déjanté de l'ogre vert. A vous les joies du bourre-pif chaotique avec les personnages emblématiques de la série. Le jeu propose de se castagner avec vingt personnages dans treize arènes différentes.

game.name: Shrek Smash N' Crash Racing
game.desc: Shrek Smash N' Crash Racing has you racing through 12 environments with gameplay similar to Mario Kart, but set in the Shrek universe. Play as one of 12 different characters each with its own unique mount, such as Shrek and a Swamp Beast, Gingy and a Cup Cake Horse and Red Riding Hood and the Wolf. Battle your way around the tracks against 5 opponents with a range of different pick-ups such as pixie dust, ogre strength and swamp gas, both defensive and offensive, to help you fight your way to the lead. The tracks have many dynamic elements, large jumps and forks with multiple routes.

game.name: Shrek The Third
game.desc: Shrek the Third para Nintendo DS es el único juego basado en la película del mismo nombre que no sigue su trama. Este juego de acción en 3D hace un uso intensivo del micrófono y el panel táctil. Puedes jugar como Puss in Boots, Prince Artie y, por supuesto, Shrek. Los controles del reproductor se basan casi por completo en la pantalla táctil. Cada personaje tiene su propia habilidad especial, por lo que debes resolver acertijos y cambiar de personaje para poder continuar. El juego cuenta con multijugador local, lo que permite jugar hasta 3 jugadores y cada uno controla un personaje diferente. La jugabilidad multijugador es la misma que para un jugador.

game.name: Sight Training : Enjoy Exercising and Relaxing Your Eyes
game.desc: Si travailler toute la journée devant un écran ou proche du soleil fatigue vos orbites, alors Gym des Yeux : Exercer et Relaxer vos Yeux sur DS est la cartouche qu'il vous faut. Grâce à ce titre, vous allez participer à une multitude de mini-jeux et autres épreuves qui ont pour but d'évaluer l'âge de vos yeux pour ensuite vous aider à progresser et vous faire retrouver votre vue de jadis. Il faut donc jouer du stylet avec habileté et réagir vite afin d'obtenir les meilleurs scores.

game.name: Sightseeing Puzzle - Echter Puzzlespass fuer Unter
Simanimals Africa
game.desc: SimAnimals Africa was released for Wii and Nintendo DS on October 27, 2009 with these known animals: African Bush Elephant Lowland Gorilla African Lion Nile Crocodile Black Rhinoceros Thomson's Gazelle Masai Giraffe Plains Zebra Nile Hippopotamus

game.name: Simanimals
game.desc: In SimAnimals, players can engage with the wild world of animals in their natural surroundings in an immersive and tactile way. In this game you are challenged to engage, touch, move and try to control more than 60 animals as you journey deeper and deeper into the forest. You control an on-screen animated hand that allows you to reach out and touch, pick up and move everything in the game from foxes and bears to trees and flowers. Cohabitate with these animals in their natural surroundings, and based on how you treat them, the animals will come to know and love ? or dislike you! Have fun developing relationships with wild animals and their families, and experience the humor and drama of surviving in the wilderness.

game.name: SimCity - Creator
game.desc: SimCity Creator for the DS is a continuation of the long-running SimCity series. Build up or destroy your city; you are the mayor, and whatever you say goes. This version features both the classic free-play mode, where there are no goals, and challenge mode, where you control your city from prehistoric times to the future. Each new era adds complexity, easing newcomers into the challenges of leadership, and changes the appearance of the buildings. By completing challenges, you'll unlock new time-periods and buildings for free-play. Through the DS' wireless feature, you can send your friends pictures of your city, as well as sharing unlocked buildings.

game.name: SimCity DS
game.desc: SimCity DS brings the classic series to the handheld consoles. As the Mayor placed in charge of running their own city, players use the touchscreen to build up and run their town, providing commercial, residential and industrial zones, protection against crime and fire, entertainment areas and even airports, highways and railways for the SimCitizens to travel. Players also have to contend with natural (and unnatural) disasters, the pressures of an ever-expanding city, and of course, public opinion, which can make a job very difficult if things get out of control. New to this version is the inclusion of wireless communication with other Mayors via a Post Office. Players can send letters to each other, giving a short summary of the state of their city. When players send letters to each other, they earn special monuments for their cities. Additionally, when disaster strikes, the Mayor can take a more hands-on approach in directly rescuing their SimCitizens.

game.name: Sims 2 - Animaux And Cie, Les
game.desc: Avec Les Sims 2 : Animaux & Cie sur DS, commencez une carrière dans le soin des animaux. En effet, vos Sims peuvent maintenant adopter des compagnons ) poil, les élever et surtout jouez avec eux. Prenez soin des animaux de la ville avec des nouveaux choix de carrière : vétérinaire, dresseur, promeneur... Emmenez-les partout ou restez chez vous pour améliorer votre intérieur.

game.name: Sims 3, Les
game.desc: Les Sims 3 est un jeu de gestion et de simulation de vie humaine sur Nintendo DS. Le personnage, immergé dans un quartier ouvert, doit interagir avec les autres Sims via un nouveau système de personnalité plus abouti. Absolument tout l'environnement peut être personnalisé à l'envi. Au joueur de créer la maison de ses rêves et d'offrir à son Sims la vie qu'il veut.

game.name: Skate It
game.desc: Skate It has Nintendo players riding with the skate pros, owning the best spots in San Vanelona and pulling off the sickest tricks using the popular FlickIt controls. The game unleashes the FlickIt revolution on to the Nintendo platforms, letting gamers use the Nintendo DS stylus to string together their best tricks for the ultimate skate line.

game.name: Smiley World - Island Challenge
game.desc: Smiley World : Island Challenge sur DS est un party-game proposant 14 activités différentes. Abandonné sur une île inconnue, le joueur doit partir explorer les lieux en évitant soigneusement les pièges tendus par des habitants belliqueux. Le jeu intègre des options multijoueurs avec la présence d'un mode Duel.

game.name: Snk Vs. Capcom - Card Fighters Ds
game.desc: A unique strategy card fighting game with RPG elements and baseball card trade-ability. All-New Card Fighters game for the Nintendo DS. Use strategic card arrangements to win. Over 300 different cards to use, collect, and trade, Know your character and their special abilities and combine them for added value and strength.

game.name: Sofie - Josefines Lillesoester - Hoensefoetter Og Guleroetter
Sofie - Josefines Lillesoester - Syng, Lek Og Laer
Sokoban DS
game.desc: Sokoban DS es una versión moderna del clásico Soko-Ban, lanzado por primera vez en Japón en 1982. Conocido como un juego de rompecabezas de transporte basado en laberintos, el jugador tiene que mover varias cajas a las posiciones designadas en el mapa. Debido a las limitadas posibilidades de movimiento y los diversos obstáculos, este trabajo requiere lógica para lograr el objetivo. La versión Sokoban DS contiene un total de 250 niveles de dificultad variable y tiene un uso completo de los gráficos DS 3D, lo que permite una panorámica y un zoom gratuitos dentro de los niveles. Para los principiantes, la mecánica básica del juego se explica en un tutorial incluido. También incluye una función de deshacer / rehacer, caracteres individuales y repeticiones.

game.name: Solatorobo - Red The Hunter
game.desc: Get ready to suspend reality and be brought into a world of floating islands where personal robots are a necessity and pirates and vicious monsters roam the skies. You'll see many dogs and cats along the way, but don't expect your furry friends to be on all fours – they're anthropomorphs. With his cigarette-like bone sticking out of his mouth, Red Savarin, an overconfident teenager, and his specialized robot Dahak have made a name for themselves by taking on odd jobs. Red's curiosity gets the best of him when he comes across a mysterious medallion. Ruh-oh, strange artifacts? This can't be going anywhere good. But before Red runs off with the medallion, he comes across Elh, a sullen, enigmatic creature who shares an unknown link with the medallion for Red to uncover.

game.name: Solitaire
game.publisher: dtp young entertainment GmbH & Co. KG

game.name: Sonic & Sega All-Stars Racing
game.desc: Sonic & Sega All-Stars Racing sur Nintendo DS est un jeu de courses regroupant tous les personnages emblématiques de l'univers de SEGA. Tous ces personnages se donnent rendez-vous sur des circuits improbables pour des courses d'anthologie. De nombreux objets et bonus viendront pimenter la course et apporteront des moments inattendus et d'incroyables retournements de situation.

game.name: Sonic Chronicles - The Dark Brotherhood
game.desc: Sonic Chronicles: The Dark Brotherhood is a Nintendo DS console role-playing game based on the Sonic the Hedgehog series. It focuses on the events surrounding the kidnapping of Knuckles the Echidna and the disappearance of the Chaos Emeralds, which leads into a much larger story. This game is notable for being the first (and so far only) RPG in the Sonic series. The story of Sonic Chronicles: The Dark Brotherhood is split into ten chapters. The first six take place in Sonic's world, with the team attempting to find Knuckles, and trying to stop the Master Emerald from being taken by the Marauders. The final four sees Sonic and the team traveling to another dimension, called the Twilight Cage, in order to stop a new threat to their own world and confront the alien species that reside there.

game.name: Sonic Classic Collection
game.desc: Sonic Classic Collection is a set of four games from the Sonic series on one cart. The games included on the cart are: 1. Sonic the Hedgehog 2. Sonic the Hedgehog 2 3. Sonic the Hedgehog 3 4. Sonic and Knuckles The compilation also includes Knuckles in Sonic the Hedgehog 2 and Knuckles in Sonic the Hedgehog 3, which were originally accessed by connecting Sonic 2 or Sonic 3 into the Sonic and Knuckles cart. All multiplayer modes in the games have been removed, making this a single player only game. In addition to the main game, an art gallery can also be accessed. This gallery features promotional art from Sonic 1, Sonic 2, Sonic 3, Sonic Spinball and Sonic Drift.

game.name: Sonic Colours
game.desc: An extraordinary amusement park has been seen orbiting around the home planet of Sonic the Hedgehog, and rumors are spreading that an alien race of Wisps, who have a unique colorful energy, are being held captive there by the evil Dr. Eggman. Soon after arriving at the amusement park, Sonic discovers he is able to use these mysterious alien forces to help the Wisps escape!

game.name: Sonic Rush Adventure
game.desc: While flying in their plane across the ocean, looking for a strange energy source, Sonic and Tails' plane is struck by lightning! They plunge into the murky depths of the ocean...and awaken on a small island. A local, a raccoon named Marine, informs them that they are on Southern Island. With Marine and Tails' help, Sonic sets about to explore the nearby islands. Sonic Rush Adventure is a side-scrolling adventure game, and the sequel to Sonic Rush. Sonic's goal through these platform levels is to zip through as quickly as possible. By pressing the B Button while in the air, Sonic can increase his Tension Gauge by performing aerial tricks. Pressing Y uses a Super Boost, which will allow him to plow through anything in his path at amazing speed, but drains the Tension Gauge. When Sonic reaches the treasure chest at the end of each level, he will be given a material that can be used for construction of ships and other devices. At first, Sonic is stranded on Southern Island, but after the construction of the waterbike, he can travel to other islands and explore them. Similar to The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass, the player must plot a path to the next island using the stylus, and then provide limited control over the ship as it travels. However, Sonic has different ships, each of which are notably different from Link's steamboat. Sonic Rush Adventure also features a Battle Mode, where players can either play locally with a friend, or across the world through Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection. Players can take each other on in a one-on-one race through various levels as each player aims to get to the end first.

game.name: Soul Bubbles
game.desc: Soul Bubbles is very similar to Bubble Ghost and requires the player to save lost Spirits by transporting them in bubbles to the exit of each level. The player takes over the role of a Spirit Herder who is tasked with ferrying souls to the underworld. To move the Spirits and keep them relatively save, they need to be be enclosed in soup bubbles. The Spirit Herder then can blow those bubbles through the level, deflate them if they are too big and even cut them into two bubbles and rejoin them later when required. If a bubble bursts, the Spirit will slowly suffocate and eventually die if the player can't draw a new bubble around it fast enough. But the way to the Gateway Cube isn't an easy one and it's not just as simple as blowing the bubbles from start to finish in the 40 levels. Besides the natural dangers in form of rocks, plants or hungry critters that all destroy the bubble, there are also environment puzzles waiting to be solved like activating a switch which requires a big bubble. There is also Star Dust and so-called Calabash waiting to be collected. While the Star Dust will increase the light emitted by the Spirits and can be collected by simply drawing a new bubble around it, the Calabashs are well hidden but once the player found them all, he will unlock the eighth World called Agartha, the Land of the Dead. To help with the search, the Spirits will change their shape to heart if a Calabash is near or turn into yellow triangles if there is imminent danger.

game.name: Space Camp
game.desc: Space Camp sur DS est une collection de mini-jeux ayant tous un rapport à l'espace. Vous pourrez poser une navette spatiale ou encore réaliser des expériences en apesanteur. Un jeu vous permettra aussi de défendre la Lune d'une pluie d'astéroïdes.

game.name: Space Invaders Extreme 2
game.desc: Space Invaders Extreme 2 follows in the footsteps of last year's critically acclaimed Space Invaders Extreme, which was regarded by many as the best remake of the original classic. This year the iconic Invaders are back again and this time the action is even more extreme! The game combines the essence of the original game with a stunning alliance of futuristic graphic design and cutting-edge audio, overhauled gameplay and a whole new range of amazing power-ups.

game.name: Space Invaders Extreme
game.desc: The pixelated aliens are back to celebrate their 30th anniversary! Taking a cue from other recent arcade classic updates, Space Invaders Extreme takes the gameplay of the 1978 classic, and reinvents it, giving power-up blasters, boss aliens, and an electronic soundtrack that plays in sync with the onscreen action. Basic gameplay remains the same: Players guide a ground based cannon either left or right, blasting an oncoming fleet of invaders before they reach the ground. The main objective is to get as many points as possible before running out of lives. Space Invaders Extreme introduces new elements, such as invader fleets that break pattern from their left to right descent, boss aliens that require several hits to destroy, power-ups that enhance the cannon, allowing the player to wipe out multiple invaders at once, while racking up combos. Wi-Fi play is also possible, allowing player to team up cooperatively, or compete against the other. The Nintendo DS version also has a feature for online ranking.

game.name: Spider-Man - Friend Or Foe
game.desc: Un nouveau mal a fait son apparition dans le monde de Spider-Man qui doit du coup s'allier avec ses anciens ennemis. Dans le jeu d'action Spider-Man : Allié ou Ennemi, retrouvez les familiers de l'univers Marvel en compagnie de notre monte-en-l'air préféré. Parcourez différentes zones géographiques mondiales avec l'aide de Nick Fury et du SHIELD. Combattez à deux simultanément, entraidez-vous et lancez des attaques groupées pour vous débarrasser de vos assaillants et rétablir l'ordre.

game.name: Spider-Man - Shattered Dimensions
game.desc: Spider-Man : Shattered Dimensions est un jeu d'action sur Nintendo DS. Le titre offre quatre versions différentes de Spider-Man dont chacun de ces univers est menacé par un basculement entre l'Ordre et le Mal.

game.name: Spider-Man : Web of Shadows
game.desc: Spider-Man : Web of Shadows est un jeu d'action sur Nintendo DS. Le titre vous permet de pouvoir alterner entre l'agilité du costume rouge ou la puissance du costume noir de Spider-Man. Vos choix ont un impact direct sur l'histoire et sur la façon dont vous êtes vu par les habitants. Il est également possible de débloquer des pouvoirs surpuissants et de créer de nouveaux combos.

game.name: Spider-Man 2
game.desc: A pseudo 3D (game is played on a 2D plane, but the stages will rotate around Spider-Man at certain points) beat-em-up/adventure game. Vicarious Visions' first title on the Nintendo DS, the game puts the player into the role of Peter Parker (AKA Spider-Man) playing through various missions with varying objectives and pitting him against the likes of Mysterio, The Vulture, and the main villain, Doctor Octavius. The missions themselves vary from missions requiring you to find all hostages to bomb defusal missions and fast paced boss battles.

game.name: Spider-Man 3
game.desc: Basada en la película de 2007, Spider-Man 3 pone al jugador a cargo del hombre araña en su misión de mantener a salvo la ciudad de Nueva York del nuevo Duende Verde, Sandman y Venom. Este título se caracteriza por ser un juego 2.5D, es decir, de scroll lateral con elementos 3D. Las acciones del juego dependen principalmente de la pantalla táctil. Los jugadores usan el stylus para combatir e interactuar con objetos. El juego también permite a los jugadores explorar nuevas historias que introducen a clásicos villanos de los comics. Una de las características de este juego es la adición del traje negro del Hombre Araña mostrado en la película. Cuando el medidor de furia se llena, el traje automáticamente toma el control, permitiendo al jugador ser más poderoso.

game.name: Splinter Cell Chaos Theory
game.desc: Splinter Cell Chaos Theory sur DS est un jeu d'infiltration dans lequel vous incarnez une nouvelle fois Sam Fisher. De Panama à la Corée en passant par les USA, le but reste sensiblement le même, s'approcher le plus discrètement possible de sa cible grâce à une panoplie de mouvements étendue. Accrochez-vous au plafond puis suspendez-vous au-dessus d'une voie truffée de lasers détecteurs de mouvements. A moins que vous préfériez vous glisser dans ce petit conduit étroit ?

game.name: Spongebob And Friends - Battle For Volcano Island
Spongebob Squarepants - Creature From The Krusty Krab
Spongebob Squarepants - The Yellow Avenger
game.desc: After a bungled attempt by the Dirty Bubble to kidnap the heroes to show off for the Super Villain Reunion, Bikini Bottom becomes plagued by hundreds of fiendish

game.name: SpongeBob's Boating Bash
game.desc: SpongeBob's Boating Bash est un jeu de courses Bob l'Eponge sur Nintendo DS. Retrouvez Bob l'Eponge et tous ses amis dans ce jeu de courses déjanté où vous devez arriver premier et éviter les requins qui patrouillent sur les circuits.

game.name: Spongebob's Surf And Skate Roadtrip
game.desc: Bob L'Eponge : Surf & Skate Roadtrip sur DS est un jeu de sport. Celui-ci permet au joueur d'incarner tous les héros du dessin animé dans des épreuves de surf, de skate et de snowboard.

game.name: Spore Créatures
game.desc: Life begins as a simple Oogie, a primitive hatchling that falls into the ocean from a fallen spaceship. Soon, this helpless Oogie is thrust into a new world and must evolve to face its challenges. In Spore Creatures, players must find new body parts and customize their creature to help survive the often-harsh environment. The game's Creature Creator offers a near-infinite number of possibilities with hundreds of options that can improve and alter your creature. Players can choose to create aggressive carnivores, cute and cuddly herbivores, or anything in between. As the story unfolds, your creature will discover six new planets to explore, as well as dozens of bizarre species to befriend, intimidate, or eliminate. Spore Creatures is entirely touch screen based, with activities for dancing, cuddling, and fighting other species. Players can also collect 50 achievement badges to unlock new game modes, parts, and features. Spore Creatures allows players to upload their favorite creatures to the internet using the Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection. Other players' species will "pollinate" the Nintendo DS game, appearing throughout the game's story.

game.name: Spore Hero Arena
game.desc: Spore : La Bataille des Héros sur DS est un jeu d'aventure dans lequel vous prenez le contrôle d'une créature. Vous naviguez de planète en planète où vous affrontez de dangereux ennemis et accomplissez différentes missions afin de récupérer de nouveaux éléments utiles à l'évolution de votre créature.

game.name: Sports Collection
game.desc: Sports Collection sur Nintendo DS est une compilation d'activités sportives. Vous pourrez vous adonner à 15 épreuves différentes, en utilisant uniquement le stylet de la console. Trois tournois sont accessibles, et un multijoueur accessible à 2 avec deux cartouches complète l'aventure.

game.name: Sports Island DS
game.desc: Sports Island est un jeu Nintendo DS multi-épreuves mettant à profit le stylet. Le titre permet de se mesurer à ses adversaires au travers de 10 épreuves : beach volley, football, badminton, basket, tir à l'arc, curling, snowboard, patinage artistique, motocross et karting. Il vous est permis de jouer seul ou en multi.

game.name: Sprung - A Game Where Everyone Scores
Spyro - Shadow Legacy
game.desc: The first Spyro game for the Nintendo DS brings rpg-lite features to the series. Spyro's friends have been sucked into the Shadow Realm and their magic is slowly being drained. Spyro must use his flame and ice breath, his magic, and his chi abilities in

game.name: Squinkies - Surprize Inside
game.desc: Basé sur une franchise de jouets populaires outre-Manche, Squinkies nous invite à collectionner plus de 250 créatures virtuelles sur notre DS. Dans la peau d'une princesse, on devra réussir des mini-jeux afin de libérer ses petits compagnons et de compléter un beau catalogue animé.

game.name: Star Trek - Tactical Assault
game.desc: In Star Trek Tactical Assault, you play either a Starfleet or Klingon captain who must wade through a high volatile situation between the Klingons and Romulans. As captain, your decisions will change how other captains react, either as potential allies or

game.name: Star Wars - The Clone Wars - Republic Heroes
game.desc: Inspiré par la série télé Star Wars The Clone Wars, le jeu d'action Les Héros de la République sur DS se charge de décrire les événements qui conduiront à la deuxième saison. Vous contrôlez ici des chevaliers Jedi et des soldats de l'Armée des Clones au service de la République Galactique. Une petite sélection de missions vous attendent et mêlent des combats au sabre, des fusillades à coups de laser et de petites énigmes.

game.name: Star Wars - The Force Unleashed II
game.desc: Star Wars : Le Pouvoir de la Force II est un jeu d'action sur Nintendo DS. Vous incarnez Starkiller qui fuit son ancien maître Dark Vador et l'usine de clones dont il était prisonnier. S'ensuit un parcours initiatique en quête de son identité sur des planètes hostiles, dans un univers tout en 2D.

game.name: Star Wars - The Force Unleashed
game.desc: Star Wars : Le Pouvoir de la Force sur DS est un jeu d'action situé quelque part entre l'épisode III et l'épisode IV de la célèbre franchise Star Wars. Le titre raconte l'histoire d'un apprenti Sith formé par Dark Vador dont la mission est d'éliminer les Jedi jusqu'au dernier afin d'assurer l'ascension de son maître. Maîtrisez la Force et affrontez de puissants ennemis.

game.name: Star Wars : The Clone Wars : Jedi Alliance
game.desc: Star Wars The Clone Wars : Jedi Alliance est un jeu d'action sur Nintendo DS. Le titre reprend l'univers de La Guerre des Etoiles et particulièrement de la série d'animation en 3D Clone Wars. Revivez l'intégralité de la série et entrez au coeur de la légende. Vous pouvez associer les pouvoirs des Jedi pour créer vos propres combos et affrontez les nombreux ennemis qui se dressent sur votre chemin.

game.name: Star Wars Battlefront - Elite Squadron
game.desc: Disponible sur DS, Star Wars Battlefront : Elite Squadron est un jeu d'action qui vous embarque dans l'univers Star Wars. Dans cet opus, les chasseurs X-Wing, les croiseurs stellaires et les Jedi sont bien présents. Le titre vous permet d'incarner un personnage de votre choix et de sélectionner ses armes parmi celles pré-définies pour l'envoyer dans des batailles épiques sur terre et dans l'espace. Succomberez-vous au côté obscur de la force ?

game.name: Star Wars Episode 3 - Revenge Of The Sith
game.desc: Star Wars Episode III : La Revanche des Sith sur DS vous entraîne au coeur de la trame obscure du film, aux côtés d'Obi-wan Kenobi ou d'Anakin Skywalker. Force et sabres lasers seront de mise, face à des hordes d'ennemis prêts à en découdre. Votre personnage évolue grâce à des points d'expérience octroyés à la fin de chaque niveau.

game.name: Starz
game.desc: Les étoiles sont tombées du ciel ! Dans Starz, jeu de réflexion sur DS, aidez-les à regagner leur vitalité en retrouvant leur éclat éparpillé dans des puzzles. Jouez du stylet sur une centaine de niveaux différents afin de repeupler le ciel. Il ne tient qu'à vous de faire briller les cieux à nouveau.

game.name: Steel Horizon
game.desc: Steel Horizon sur DS est un jeu de stratégie mettant en scène des navires pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Choisissez votre bateau au départ et vous voilà aux commandes de votre flotte, prêt à mettre à mal celle d'en face. En dehors des 21 missions disponibles il est possible d'affronter un ami en mode multi.

game.name: Stratego Next Edition
game.desc: Stratego sur DS est un vieux jeu de stratégie et de réflexion opposant deux adversaires sur un plateau. Le but de la partie est de trouver et de capturer le drapeau ennemi. Pour cela chaque joueur dispose de troupes et d'unités spécialisées qu'il déplace au tour par tour.

game.name: Strawberry Shortcake - The Four Seasons Cake
Sudoku Ball : Detective
game.desc: Sudoku Ball : Detective sur DS vous propose un concept original : mener une enquête policière tout en résolvant des grilles de sudoku ! Le titre comprend 240 puzzles différents échelonnés sur 3 niveaux de difficulté, et une vingtaine de chapitres à parcourir en mode Aventure. Résolvez les énigmes et aidez le détective à trouver le meurtrier de Jonathan Coleridge !

game.name: Sudoku Gridmaster
game.desc: Devenez champion de sudoku avec Sudoku Master sur DS. Le jeu de réflexion s'invite chez nous avec pas moins de 400 grilles originales pour des heures et des heures de réflexion. Jouez de manière intuitive et progressive grâce aux quatre niveaux de difficultés disponibles et aux différents conseils et astuces qui vous seront fort utiles en cas de blocage.

game.name: Sudokuro - Sudoku And Kakuro Games
game.desc: Sudokuro is a puzzle game featuring two different puzzles in the same game, which are Sudoku and Kakuro. Each kind of puzzle has different difficulty levels and all of them are automatically generated, with thousands of puzzles to choose from. You can enter the numbers to solve the puzzles using the buttons to add them or just write them with your stylus. In Sudoku the player has to put numbers in a grid in a way that no number is twice in a single row or column. In Kakuro the numbers have to be placed so that lines and columns equal the number next to it when all values are added together.

game.name: Suikoden - Tierkreis
game.desc: The 108 Stars of Destiny are back! In this game the player takes on the role of the young hero from Citro Village, and with Marica, Liu and Jale (and other more), the player will explore the world looking for the True Chronicles and stop the evil forces of The Order of the One True Way, lead by the One King! Suikoden Tierkreis is a classical turn-based console Role Playing Game with some interesting Ideas, like mini-quest using specific (or not) character for complete it. The world is completely 3D and the game focuses on story elements. Movement is done with the directional pad or stylus. Like most console RPGs the game has the player interacting with NPCs and fighting random encounters. Items and characters can be exchanged with other players through Wi-Fi.

game.name: Suite Life Of Zack And Cody, The - Circle Of Spies
Super Black Bass Fishing
game.desc: Super Black Bass Fishing sur DS est une simulation de pêche qui se joue au stylet. Vous incarnez un jeune homme qui décide de participer à un concours de pêche mais qui se fait recaler à l'entrée. A vous de faire vos preuves en choisissant les bons appâts, les bons leurres et les coins de pêche qui regorgent de poissons. Maniez le stylet comme une canne à pêche et devenez un grand de ce sport.

game.name: Super Fruit Fall
game.desc: Super Fruit Fall sur DS est un puzzle-game au concept original. Le but est de faire disparaître les fruits en les déplaçant à travers la grille jusqu'à ce qu'ils soient tous regroupés. Ils doivent être soit au-dessus, à gauche ou à droite d'un autre fruit similaire pour pouvoir disparaître. Un bonus est accordé si l'on fait disparaître un groupe de plusieurs fruits en même temps.

game.name: Super Mario 64 Ds
game.desc: Mario, Luigi y Wario han ido al Palacio de los Champiñones por algunos de los famosos pasteles caseros de la Princesa Peach. Sin embargo, cuando no regresan, le toca al heroico dino Yoshi descubrir qué está mal. En esta nueva versión portátil del Super Mario 64 original, puedes jugar como personajes diferentes de la franquicia de Mario. Wario, Yoshi, Luigi y, por supuesto, Mario. Cada personaje tiene diferentes habilidades para utilizar durante la búsqueda ampliada de los juegos. El juego ahora cuenta con 150 estrellas para recoger de las 120 anteriores, nuevas etapas con nuevos jefes, cambios a las viejas etapas y jefes, y un modo multijugador en el que el jugador compite para obtener la mayor cantidad de estrellas. El juego también incluye más de dos docenas de minijuegos que utilizan ambas pantallas y el panel táctil. La pantalla táctil DS se puede utilizar para imitar el control analógico.

game.name: Super Princess Peach
game.desc: For once, Bowser has changed his tactics. Instead of grabbing the Princess every chance he gets, he's gone straight to the source of all his problems this time around. The two people who always get in his way and halt his chances of owning Mushroom Kingdom all himself. Mario and Luigi are suddenly whisked away, and only one person can save them... Princess Peach, always the one in distress, will use all her unique abilities and items to travel the length of the Kingdom to save her heroes. Her main attack uses a parasol on enemies, which can also double as the perfect way to float down from the heights. Princess Peachs' emotions will also come into play. Make her cry to drench enemies or help plants grow to reach higher ground, meanwhile her happy singing can distract many foes and open up further areas.

game.name: Super Scribblenauts
game.desc: Super Scribblenauts for Nintendo DS expands the innovative elements from the award-winning first title with inventive new features, including an adjectives system and upgraded controls to create an incredibly fresh and entertaining gameplay experience. Created and developed by 5TH Cell, players use the stylus and touch screen along with their imagination to help Maxwell, the game's hero, solve robust puzzles and challenges in redesigned levels to acquire the ?Starite.? In Super Scribblenauts, players now have the ability to write any object that comes to mind and modify it in any way they desire, using adjectives to reach the goal in each level. Adjectives can change the color, size, elements, behaviors and many other aspects of the object they are describing. Multiple adjectives can be combined together to produce incredibly creative objects, allowing the player's imagination to run wild for a truly unique and individualistic experience. Features ? Brand New Levels: Experience 120 brand new, in-depth levels that include task such as finding a cure for the plague, populating an office or identifying animals with shells. ? All-New Adjectives System: Create a shy green polar bear or an angry zombie pear! 10,000+ adjectives reflect real life behaviors, personalities and characteristics when applied to objects. ? Multi Layered Hints: Just can't figure that puzzle out? Purchase more explicit hints at a decreasing Ollar cost over time. ? Universal Feedback System: Visualize progress throughout each level! Relevant objects summoned get a thumb up, while irrelevant objects get a thumb down. ? Updated Dictionary: Summon more than 800 all-new, customizable objects to solve puzzles and earn Starites. ? New Control Schemes: Control Maxwell with the D-pad or with updated and more precise new Stylus controls! Weight, buoyancy, friction have all been reworked to make objects interact better to the player's input and reflect any adjective that is applied to an object. ? New Level Editor: Create both puzzle and action levels to build your very own custom playground. The unique new template system allows players to create all kinds of objectives for their levels with ease. ? Innovative UI: An exciting new UI gives players more control over gameplay, with more detail on how to navigate through new levels in the game.

game.name: Superman Returns
game.desc: Based on the movie of the same name, Superman Returns puts you behind the cape of the man of steel as he returns to the earth after his exile in outer space. Your main objective is to protect Metropolis from the attacks of several enemies ripped right from Superman's comics. The main campaign gives you a hexagonal map of Metropolis which pinpoints your location as well as your current enemy's location and any disaster areas he may have caused. Since Superman himself is invulnerable, Metropolis itself has a health bar that keeps track of just how much damage the city is enduring, and which measures your level of success/failure.Your objective thus is to move around the map each turn to try and take control of each disaster area which triggers a timed 3rd person perspective sequence in which you control Superman as he flies through the city and uses his powers to solve whatever task is at hand (blowing out fires with his super-breath, destroying mind-control beacons with his heat vision, saving people, etc. etc.) catching up with your enemies triggers a fight sequence in which you must input the correct button-presses on cue to defeat your opponents. In between these rounds story segments that follow the movie's plot play out, which involve a unique 3D action sequence that mimics the movie's counterpart. Features a single-player campaign as well as two wireless multiplayer modes in which you can face-off against four other Supermen in unique disaster areas to see who gets to clear the objectives faster than the rest. Also includes a gallery of Superman comic covers that are unlocked by collecting Krypton crystals in the game.

game.name: Surf's Up
game.desc: Surf's Up is based on the 2007 animated film of the same name, featuring surfing penguins and wacky hijinks. Surf's up for DS and PSP is a racing game that brings the player through an interesting adventure featuring all the characters from the CGI movie. The player can choose from a bunch of the movie characters and compete in races against other movie characters. Each character has their own specific skills and their own surf boards. The different levels/races contain jumps/ramps which enables the player to perform tricks using either the stylus to draw objects (DS) or repeating a button sequence (PSP). Performing tricks will give you a speed boost which might just help you finish the race first and move on to the next round. The levels also contain shortcuts and the race track is populated with different objects that can be used to gain a speed boost, distract or hit opponents and ultimately will help you finish the race first. The game also offers a multi-player mode which enables you to play with friends who have the game and even friends who don't have the game (but have a console).

game.name: Sushi Academy
game.desc: Time management game. Old Sushi Master, runs a world-famous restaurant. His snacks are enjoyed by an array of fans who would love to know the secrets of sushi making. Under the Master's guidance, learn to chop vegetables, cut fish and decorate and serve meals. Create more complicated dishes, and maybe you will surpass your master.

game.name: Sweet 16
game.desc: Imagine : Sweet 16 vous permet d'incarner une lycéenne pas comme les autres car la nuit elle organise des soirées populaires. Construisez votre réseau d'amis et discutez sur messagerie instantanée, faites des soirées inoubliables et remportez le coeur du garçon le plus convoité.

game.name: Syberia
game.desc: You are Kate Walker, a lawyer that has been entrusted by the Universal Toy Company to negotiate the takeover of an old luxury toy and automaton factory. Over the centuries, the factory has been developing clockwork devices, specializing in perpetual mechanical movement. The factory's ambitions, however, are ill-suited to the contemporary economic climate, and the elderly Anna Voralberg, at the helm of the Valadilene factory for more than half a century, has decided to sell up. It turns out that the takeover might not be as straightforward as expected. The day that Kate Walker arrives, Anna Voralberg is being buried. What is more is that she has left an heir – her brother Hans. But Hans had left the valley at the end of the thirties and never returned, and was actually believed to be dead. However, a letter written by Anna in the days leading up to her death reveals that Hans is well and truly alive and living somewhere in… Siberia! Valadilene's elderly notary entrusted to take care of Anna's affairs suggests that Kate find Hans Voralberg as he is now the only person in a position to ratify the sale of the family business. You are on your way...

game.name: Tak - The Great Juju Challenge
game.desc: Tak : The Great Juju Challenge sur DS est un jeu d'action/plates-formes dans lequel vous incarnez Tak et Lok pour des épreuves délirantes. Les dix meilleures équipes du monde se rejoignent pour participer au Grand Défi ! Avec des puzzles, de la réflexion stratégique, des combats et des pouvoirs magiques, défendez l'honneur de votre tribu ! Jouez seul ou en coopération avec un deuxième joueur dirigé par la console ou par un ami.

game.name: Tales To Enjoy Puss In Boots
Tales To Enjoy! - The Three Little Pigs
Tales To Enjoy! - The Ugly Duckling
Tamagotchi Connection - Corner Shop 2
game.desc: Tamagotchi Connexion : Corner Shop 2 est un party-game sur Nintendo DS qui propose une multitude de mini-jeux afin d'aider Memetchi et Kuchipatchi à ouvrir leurs propres magasins dans un centre commercial en perpétuelle expansion. Ces mini-jeux permettent au fur et à mesure d'atteindre les quatre seuils d'agrandissement nécessaires pour chaque boutique.

game.name: Tamagotchi Connexion - Corner Shop
game.desc: The three Tamagotchi - Mametchi, Kuchipatchi and Memetchi - are itching to get into business! And you get to partner up with them! Choose your favorite Tamagotchi, and start up your very own shop together - work hard to earn a good reputation with your

game.name: Tamagotchi Connexion : Corner Shop 3
game.desc: Tamagotchi Connexion : Corner Shop 3 sur DS propose toujours au joueur de gérer des boutiques. Au programme : 13 nouveaux magasins à gérer, dont le boulanger et le marchand de glaces, mais aussi un parc à décorer et à visiter, et la possibilité d'échanger par Wi-Fi des objets ou des journaux tenus par les joueurs.

game.name: Tank Beat
game.desc: Tank Beat is entirely stylus-based. As you draw tracks and fire on the DS's bottom screen game map, your tank appears and responds on the top screen. Players engage in a variety of missions and commandeer a full range of tanks: from tiny scrappers, to missile carriers, to giant Panzers.

game.name: Tecktonik World Tour
game.desc: Tecktonik sur DS vous propose de plonger dans le mouvement Electro made in France. Dans cette simulation de danse, affrontez dans des battles endiablés les meilleurs danseurs de Tecktonik : Treaxie, Blind et bien d'autres ! Votre objectif est d'être dans le rythme pour effectuer les plus beaux mouvements possible et ainsi progresser dans la hiérarchie des danseurs. En augmentant votre notoriété, vous devenez une figure incontournable du mouvement et intégrez une team officielle : Eklesiast.

game.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles - Arcade Attack
game.desc: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Arcade Attack sur DS permet d'incarner les quatre célèbres tortues mangeuses de pizzas. Utilisez les capacités propres à chacune et battez leurs ennemis jurés dans un beat'em all endiablé.

game.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3 - Mutant Nightmare
game.desc: Different from its console cousins, this one is reminiscent of the old side-scrolling days of the arcade and NES versions, but with the same story. There are 50 stages to play and not only includes fighting, but also utilizing the stylus and dual screen

game.name: Teenage Zombies - Invasion Of The Alien Brain Thingys
Telly Addicts
game.desc: Telly Addicts is a TV show, where the aim of the game is to correctly answer as many questions as possible to win the game. As you play, you'll progress through a series of quiz rounds, collecting points as you go, with the aim of accumulating the most points to win the game.

game.name: Tenchu : Dark Secret
game.desc: Tenchu : Dark Secret sur DS est un jeu d'action/infiltration dans lequel vous incarnez un duo de ninjas : Rikimaru et Ayame. Votre but est de protéger la fille d'un puissant seigneur avide de pouvoir. Utilisez votre équipement de shinobi, votre discrétion et votre lame pour réussir. Il est également possible de fabriquer son propre inventaire ou de s'échanger des objets via les fonctions sans-fil de la console.

game.name: Tennis Elbow
game.desc: Tennis Elbow sur Nintendo est, comme son nom l'indique, un jeu de tennis qui propose au joueur d'affronter l'ordinateur dans l'un des 90 tournois proposés. Il est possible de personnaliser son joueur (gaucher, droitier, couleur de cheveux...) et de remporter la victoire sur 5 surfaces différentes.

game.name: Tennis Masters
game.desc: Tennis Masters sur DS vous envoie sur les terrains affronter des adversaires redoutables. Que ce soit sur terre battue, sur gazon ou sur terrain artificiel, faites preuve de réflexes et de rapidité pour remporter la victoire. Choisissez entre les modes Exhibition et Tournament et lancez-vous dans des matchs haletants, à base d'effets de balle et de montées au filet.

game.name: Tetris DS
game.desc: At its base, Tetris DS is the same Tetris gameplay that's been around for years: rotate and arrange Tetriminos to create full lines and make them disappear. However, it also has a style very different from earlier Tetris games, new play modes, and online play. Graphically and aurally, Tetris DS is based on classic NES games.
